text: Albania is generally a **mountainous** country, with a **Mediterranean** climate and vegetation. In between the hills and mountains, you can sometimes find more flat, agricultural valleys. The mountains are usually quite green, sometimes with patches of exposed rock visible.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞通常是個 **多山** 的國家，擁有 **地中海型** 氣候和植被。在丘陵和山脈之間，有時會發現較為平坦的農業谷地。山區通常相當翠綠，有時可見裸露的岩石區塊。

text: A couple of small roads northwest of Vlorë can be recognised by the very coastal-looking **Aleppo pine forest**.
text_zh: 在夫羅勒（Vlorë）西北方的一些小路上，你可以看到極具海岸風情的 **阿勒坡松林**。

text: Most of Austria is **mountainous** and covered in forests. However, some areas in the east and northeast are much more flat and agricultural.
text_zh: 奧地利大部分地區**多山**且被森林覆蓋。然而，東部和東北部的一些地區則較為平坦且以農業為主。

text: Many wooden utility poles, particularly in the eastern parts of Bolivia’s Street View coverage, are noticeably **curvy **and look like they are made from locally sourced tree trunks.
NOTE: While you may see slightly bent poles in other places, extremely curvy poles are a very good clue for Bolivia.
text_zh: 許多木製電線桿，特別是在玻利維亞東部街景覆蓋區域，都明顯**彎曲 **，看起來就像是用當地樹幹製作的。
注意：雖然你可能在其他地方看到稍微彎曲的電線桿，但極度彎曲的電線桿是玻利維亞非常好的線索。

text: Northeastern Brazil can be identified by its **dry soil, shrubs and succulents** (the [Caatinga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caatinga) landscape). In rainy season coverage, the shrubs are still recognisable, but can be deceptively green.
text_zh: 巴西東北部的特徵是**乾燥的土壤、灌木和多肉植物**（[卡廷加](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caatinga)地貌）。在雨季的街景中，灌木仍然清晰可辨，但可能會呈現出具有欺騙性的翠綠色。

text: The **Amazon** is a dense rainforest that comprises 40% of Brazil’s total area. Not many roads are within it, but those that are, mostly go through either biodiverse forest or grassy hills with sparse trees.
text_zh: **亞馬遜**是一片茂密的雨林，占巴西總面積的 40%。裡面的道路不多，但有的話，大多穿過生物多樣性豐富的森林，或是樹木稀疏的草丘。

text: Acre has a unique landscape of **small grass hills** and sparsely growing trees. The roads often do not cut around the hills like in most of Brazil, but ride the hills instead. A similar landscape can also be seen near Maraba in the state of Pará.
text_zh: 阿克里州（Acre）擁有獨特的**小草丘**與稀疏樹木景觀。這裡的道路通常不會像巴西大部分地區那樣繞過山丘，而是直接順著山丘起伏。在帕拉州（Pará）的馬拉巴（Maraba）附近也可以看到類似的景觀。

text: These distinct trees, called **Paraná pines**, have long horizontal branches with leaves only at the end. They grow mainly in the southern Brazilian states of Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 這些獨特的樹木被稱為**巴拉那松**，擁有長長的水平樹枝，葉子僅長在末端。它們主要生長在巴西南部的巴拉那州（Pará）、聖卡塔琳娜州（Santa Catarina）和南里奧格蘭德州（Rio Grande do Sul）。

text: Coconut palm trees have long leaves, **can grow very tall, and have thin trunks**. They are common across the north eastern states and sometimes further west or south along the coast.
NOTE: Coconut palms grow across the world and are not unique to Brazil.
text_zh: 椰子樹有長葉，**可以長得很高，且樹幹較細**。它們在東北部各州很常見，有時在沿海更偏西或偏南的地方也能看到。
註：椰子樹生長於世界各地，並非巴西特有。

text: Carnaúba palms have short but strong **fan-like leaves**, and a trunk that is smooth at the top and spiked at the bottom. They are commonly seen in Ceará, Piauí, and Rio Grande de Norte, but are also around the town of Xique Xique in Bahia.
text_zh: 巴西蠟掌（Carnaúba）有短而堅韌的**扇形葉片**，樹幹頂部光滑，底部帶刺。它們常見於塞阿拉州（Ceará）、皮奧伊州（Piauí）和北里奧格蘭德州（Rio Grande do Norte），但也出現在巴伊亞州（Bahia）的 Xique Xique 鎮附近。

text: Babassu palms have long, robust leaves comprised of many leaflets. Trunk length can vary from short to tall. They are found throughout the Amazon, or more rarely, down the east coast.
text_zh: 巴巴蘇棕櫚（Babassu）擁有由許多小葉組成的長而強壯的葉子。樹幹高度從矮到高不等。它們遍布於亞馬遜地區，較少見於東海岸一帶。

text: Açai palms produce fruits that are popular globally. Most of these palms are found near Belem, but can be seen across the Amazon. They are distinct in the way the **leaflets droop downward** along with their unusually thin trunks.

NOTE: Most açai palms are found in the Amazon. However, some [visually similar açai subspecies](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qiyQrPPTzgZqcnz88) can rarely occur along the east coast from Santa Catarina all the way to Bahia.
text_zh: 巴西莓樹（Açai）結出全球盛行的果實。這些棕櫚樹大多位於貝倫（Belém）附近，但在整個亞馬遜地區都能看到。它們的特徵是**小葉向下垂掛**，以及異常細長的樹幹。
註：大多數巴西莓樹位於亞馬遜地區。然而，從聖卡塔琳娜州一路到巴伊亞州的東海岸，極少數情況下也會出現一些[外觀相似的巴西莓亞種](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qiyQrPPTzgZqcnz88)。

text: Moriche palms have leaves with a **rounded fan shape**, and often the bottom leaves can be seen **dead and drooping down**. They are most common in Roraima, Amazonas, Tocantins, Goias, and the Amazonian states, but random clusters can be found quite far away from this region.
NOTE: These palms can additionally be found very commonly in the [Amazonian parts of Colombia and Peru](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/71/Distribution_of_Mauritia_flexuosa.png).
text_zh: 模里西棕櫚（Moriche）的葉子呈**圓形扇狀**，通常可以看到底部的葉子**枯死下垂**。它們最常見於羅賴馬州、亞馬遜州、托坎廷斯州、戈亞斯州和亞馬遜地區各州，但在距離這些區域相當遠的地方也能找到零星的集群。
註：這些棕櫚樹在[哥倫比亞與秘魯的亞馬遜區域](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/71/Distribution_of_Mauritia_flexuosa.png)也極為常見。

text: Macaw palms have **thin leaves** compared to other palms, and often have a visible** spear** **shaped** top. They are very common around Mato Grosso do Sul, northern Tocantins, and around Belo Horizonte, but can be seen much further out sometimes. These palms should be used with caution, and single trees are much less of an indicator than multiple trees.
NOTE: [Queen palms](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FqKSDoQwW74P3ES89) can look similar sometimes, but there are less leaves and it looks less dense.
text_zh: 與其他棕櫚樹相比，大花果棕（Macaw palms）擁有**細長的葉子**，且頂部常有明顯的**矛****狀**結構。它們在南馬托格羅索州、托坎廷斯州北部和貝洛奧里藏特（Belo Horizonte）周圍非常常見，但有時在更遠的地方也能看到。使用這種棕櫚樹做判斷時要謹慎，單棵樹的參考價值遠低於多棵樹。
註：[皇后葵](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FqKSDoQwW74P3ES89)有時看起來很像，但葉子較少且看起來沒那麼茂密。

text: This species of plant, with **long stems** and many leaves growing up, are very common in Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, and Paraíba. In the dry season, you can still make out the distinct long stems without leaves.
text_zh: 這種具有**長莖**且許多葉子向上生長的植物品種，在塞阿拉州、北里奧格蘭德州和帕拉伊巴州（Paraíba）非常常見。在旱季時，即使沒有葉子，你依然能辨認出其獨特的長莖。

text: **Very tall grass** can be often seen in the centre of the country, most notably in the Tocantins, Goiás, Bahia, and Minas Gerais states.
text_zh: 在該國中部經常可以看到**非常高聳的草**，尤以托坎廷斯州、戈亞斯州、巴伊亞州和米納斯吉拉斯州最為顯著。

text: **Eucalyptus Grandis**, when fully grown, is a very tall tree with plantations all over Brazil. You can find them in both large and very small plantations., as well as randomly growing anywhere. You can see them all over the south, but there are some large plantations in Amapá too.
text_zh: **巨桉（Eucalyptus Grandis）**完全長成後是非常高大的樹木，巴西各地都有種植園。無論是在大型或微型種植園，還是在任何地方隨機生長，都能找到它們。你在整個南部都能看到它們，但阿馬帕州（Amapá）也有一些大型種植園。

text: **Sugarcane plantations** are by far most common in the state of São Paulo, and are common in Paraná, Mato Grosso do Sul, and in the coastal north eastern states.
text_zh: **甘蔗種植園**在聖保羅州最為常見，在巴拉那州、南馬托格羅索州以及東北部沿海各州也很普遍。

text: **Soybeans** appear as small, leafy soil grown plants. They are most commonly grown in Mato Grosso, Paraná, and Goiás.
text_zh: **黃豆**呈現為矮小、多葉的土生植物。它們最常種植於馬托格羅索州、巴拉那州和戈亞斯州。

text: **Coffee beans** are by far the most common in Minas Gerais, but also can be found in Espírito Santo and northeastern São Paulo.
text_zh: **咖啡豆**在米納斯吉拉斯州最為常見，但在聖埃斯皮里圖州和聖保羅州東北部也能找到。

text: The Pará section of the 163 is often **hilly, curvy, dry, and sometimes hazy**. It has a wide range of amazonian vegetation. The road is frequently trafficked, usually by transportation trucks. It is covered by the blue Generation 4 car in the north and the Smallcam car in the south.
text_zh: 163 號公路帕拉州路段通常**多丘陵、多彎道、乾燥且有時霧濛濛**。它有著豐富的亞馬遜植被。這條道路車流量大，通常是運輸卡車。北方由藍色 4 代車覆蓋，南方由 Smallcam 車覆蓋。

text: Yukon has a very northern, **boreal landscape** that is mostly **hilly**,** **sometimes** **with [large mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/j7jVz8vNP3EczZRF8)** **in the distance. Coniferous** **trees line the roads and the further north you go, the thinner and shorter** **the trees get. Older [Generation 2 coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/EuhTiy8inFfLy7BF8) is common in this region.
text_zh: 育空擁有非常偏北的**寒帶景觀**，地形多為**丘陵**，** **有時** **遠處會有[高山](https://goo.gl/maps/j7jVz8vNP3EczZRF8)** **。針葉** **樹沿著道路排列，越往北走，樹木就越稀疏矮小** **。較舊的 [Generation 2 街景覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/EuhTiy8inFfLy7BF8) 在這個地區很常見。

text: The landscape in the interior of southern British Columbia, mostly centred around the towns of **Kamloops and Kelowna**, has a distinct look. It is generally hilly and a little more arid than the rest of BC. The vegetation consists of sprawling brown grasslands, and pine tree forests on the hillsides.
text_zh: 英屬哥倫比亞省南部內陸地區（主要以**甘露市與基隆拿**等城鎮為中心）的景觀非常獨特。這裡總體多丘陵，比英屬哥倫比亞省的其他地區稍微乾旱一些。植被由廣袤的褐色草地和山坡上的松樹林組成。

text: The **Great Plains** are mostly flat, with some rolling hills. There is a lot of agriculture, very few trees, and it is very sparsely populated. The landscape gets drier the further south-southwest you go, with the driest parts near the border with the US state of Montana.
text_zh: **大平原**大多地勢平坦，帶有部分起伏的丘陵。當地農業發達，樹木極少，人口非常稀少。越往西南方走景觀越乾燥，最乾燥的區域靠近美國蒙大拿州的邊界。

text: Canola is grown in the **central southern** prairies, and it can be found almost nowhere else in Canada. It is visually similar to a field of bright **yellow flowers**.
NOTE: Canola is also very common in the US state of North Dakota.
text_zh: 芥花種植於**中南部**大草原，在加拿大其他地方幾乎看不到。視覺上它看起來就像是一整片鮮**黃色的花海**。
註：芥花在美國北達科他州也非常常見。

text: The region around Rouyn-Noranda in northwestern Québec can mainly be characterised by the **north-south grid, **along with the **slightly hilly** landscape featuring many agricultural fields nestled between the forests, which have many shorter trees as well as thin birches.
text_zh: 魁北克省西北部魯安-諾蘭達周邊地區的主要特徵為**南北向的網格狀道路，**以及**微起伏的丘陵**地形，森林之間鑲嵌著許多農田，森林中有許多較矮小的樹木與纖細的樺樹。

text: **Aspen trees** are common in the forested parts of Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta. They are recognizable by their white, birch-like trunks. In most seasons, they have regular green leaves, but in fall coverage, they turn a characteristic bright yellow colour.
text_zh: **顫楊**在曼尼托巴省、薩斯喀徹溫省和亞伯達省的森林地區很常見。牠們可透過類似樺樹的白色樹幹來辨認。在大多數季節裡牠們長著普通綠葉，但在秋季街景覆蓋中，會轉變為特有的鮮黃色。

text: The **Québec City-Windsor Corridor** is the most densely populated part of Canada. It is mostly flat and green, with a patchwork of agriculture and occasional forest cover.
NOTE: This area can look similar to the Great Lakes region in the US.
text_zh: **魁北克市-溫莎走廊**是加拿大人口最密集的區域。當地大多平坦且一片綠意，交織著農田與偶爾出現的森林覆蓋。
註：這個區域看起來可能與美國的五大湖地區相似。

text: The **Balsam Fir **is a very common** **species of tree found in Newfoundland. It has a Christmas tree-like appearance.

NOTE: While most commonly found in Newfoundland, the Balsam Fir can also grow in other parts of Eastern Canada and the US. For an overview, see [this](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d8/Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png/1280px-Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png) map.
text_zh: **香脂冷杉**在紐芬蘭是非常常見** **的樹種。它的外觀看起來像聖誕樹。
註：雖然香脂冷杉最常見於紐芬蘭，但它也會生長在加拿大東部其他地區與美國。如需概覽，請參見[這張](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d8/Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png/1280px-Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png)地圖。

text: Poles in Arica feature **white** paint with a black number, while the other cities in the Atacama Desert feature poles with [**yellow**](https://goo.gl/maps/xfQm8JHGpC6VCDR47) paint. Keep in mind the paint may have faded, making it look white.
text_zh: 阿里卡 (Arica) 的電線桿特色是漆成**白色**並帶有黑色數字，而阿他加馬沙漠的其他城市則是漆成[**黃色**](https://goo.gl/maps/xfQm8JHGpC6VCDR47)的電線桿。請記住，漆料可能會褪色而看起來像白色。

text: The Paphos Forest nature reserve consists of windy mountain roads with red soil on the sides, passing through the mostly uninhabited Mediterranean forest. You will not see any bollards in the reserve, with few exceptions.
text_zh: 帕福斯森林（Paphos Forest）自然保護區由多風的山路組成，兩側帶有紅土，穿過幾乎無人居住的地中海森林。在此保護區內除了少數例外，你看不到任何路樁。

text: Rural roads surrounded by hedges blocking the view, reminiscent of the British Isles, are primarily found in the northwest, particularly in Normandy.
NOTE: Hedges by themselves are not sufficient for recognizing this area and are common all over France.
text_zh: 被樹籬環繞、視線受阻的鄉村道路讓人聯想到英倫三島，主要分佈在西北部，特別是諾曼第。
注意：單靠樹籬不足以辨認這個地區，因為樹籬在整個法國都很常見。

text: [**Stone pines**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone_pine) are commonly found along the southern coast, often planted alongside urban roads. You may however find them as north as Nantes.
text_zh: [**義大利石松**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone_pine)常見於南部海岸沿線，經常種植在城市道路旁。不過，你最北甚至可以在南特找到它們。

text: Forests made up entirely of Maritime pines ([pinus pinaster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_pinaster)) are found in the southwest of the country (Gironde and Landes departments). The whole area will be fairly flat, which is not typical of other areas with such pines.
text_zh: 完全由海濱松（[pinus pinaster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_pinaster)）組成的森林位於該國西南部（吉倫特省和朗德省）。整個地區將相當平坦，這在擁有此類松樹的其他地區並不典型。

text: France is the second largest wine producer in the world, with many famed wine regions. The most common include the area [around Bordeaux](https://maps.app.goo.gl/m8uNroZ9jJLd3QAK9), [southern coast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HTsrjHu2c5PRFyf66) and [Champagne](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qtGYHb1vJigF6dhh8), East of Paris. Other regions include, but are not limited to, [Loire Valley](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DfoQ5ieYBdvu3Gwj6), [Alsace](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VZ83XTNAHMGyYnpo7) and [Corsica](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1LfT57wVaQ6dhW4f7).
NOTE: This map is highly simplified, see [this map](https://vineyards.com/photos/maps/France%20Wine%20Map.png) for more detailed and extensive description.
text_zh: 法國是世界第二大葡萄酒生產國，擁有很多著名的葡萄酒產區。最常見的包括[波爾多周邊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/m8uNroZ9jJLd3QAK9)、[南部海岸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HTsrjHu2c5PRFyf66)以及位於巴黎以東的[香檳區](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qtGYHb1vJigF6dhh8)。其他產區包括但不限於[羅亞爾河谷](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DfoQ5ieYBdvu3Gwj6)、[亞爾薩斯](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VZ83XTNAHMGyYnpo7)和[科西嘉島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1LfT57wVaQ6dhW4f7)。
注意：這張地圖經過高度簡化，請參閱[這張地圖](https://vineyards.com/photos/maps/France%20Wine%20Map.png)以獲取更詳細和廣泛的描述。

text: **Sunflowers** are mostly found in the southwest of the country, particularly around Toulouse.
text_zh: **向日葵**主要分佈在該國西南部，特別是在土魯斯周邊。

text: **Lavender fields** can be found in the southeast, appearing as [small grey bushes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Mm9eUmvDpzN6izC57) when not fully grown.
text_zh: **薰衣草田**分佈在東南部，未完全長大時看起來就像[灰色的矮小灌木叢](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Mm9eUmvDpzN6izC57)。

text: Markings on poles and trees, consisting of one black stripe in-between two white ones, are common in Tamil Nadu.
text_zh: 電線桿和樹木上的標記由夾在兩個白條之間的一條黑條組成，這在 Tamil Nadu 邦很常見。

text: Within Indonesia, oil palm plantations are mostly concentrated in **Sumatra **and **Kalimantan**. Palm plantations can rarely be seen in Sulawesi.
text_zh: 在印尼國內，油棕櫚園主要集中在**蘇門答臘**與**加里曼丹**。棕櫚園在蘇拉威西非常少見。

text: The majority of rice production is concentrated in **Java**, but can sometimes be found in other provinces, namely South Sulawesi and South Sumatra. They can rarely be found in other provinces as well. For a full overview, see [this page](https://www.fas.usda.gov/data/production/id).
text_zh: 大部分的稻米生產都集中在**爪哇**，但有時也可以在其他省份找到，即南蘇拉威西省和南蘇門答臘省。它們也很少在其他省份被發現。如需完整概覽，請參見[此頁面](https://www.fas.usda.gov/data/production/id)。

text: The Nusas are **drier **than other regions in Indonesia. Vegetation tends to look less tropical, but instead lower and shrubbier.
NOTE: While less common, other regions such as Java can look similarly dry. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 努沙登加拉群島比印尼其他地區**更為乾燥**。植被看起來比較沒有熱帶風情，反而較為矮小且多灌木。
注意：雖然較少見，但像爪哇這樣的其他地區看起來也可能同樣乾燥. 在猜測之前，請務必尋找其他線索。

text: This **savannah** landscape is occasionally seen on north Sumba.
NOTE: In Generation 3, you will always see a [white car](https://goo.gl/maps/Dz8hDHNHviJTvKiCA).
text_zh: 這種**莽原**景觀偶爾會在松巴島北部看到。
注意：在第三代相機中，你總是會看到一輛[白車](https://goo.gl/maps/Dz8hDHNHviJTvKiCA)。

text: **Steeply** **pitched** roofs made of palm tree leaves can sometimes be seen on Nias Island, south west of North Sumatra.
text_zh: 印尼北蘇門答臘西南方的尼亞斯島（Nias Island）上，有時可以看到用棕櫚樹葉建造的**陡峭**斜屋頂。

text: Italy has a **Mediterranean landscape** with a lot of agricultural fields on rolling hills, and forested mountain valleys.
text_zh: 義大利擁有**地中海景觀**，起伏的山丘上有許多農田，以及長滿森林的山谷。

text: The landscape on the southeastern peninsula surrounding Bari has many **olive plantations**, which are often seen together with **bright** **rock walls**. The dirt in the region typically has a noticeably red colour.
Beware that a similar landscape can also be found in [southeastern Sicily](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aRgNqNdsccanmo3m8).
text_zh: 巴里周圍東南半島上的景觀有許多**橄欖園**，經常與**明亮的** **石牆**一同出現。該地區的泥土通常具有明顯的紅色。
請注意，在[西西里島東南部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aRgNqNdsccanmo3m8)也能找到類似的景觀。

text: **Cacti** in Italy are most common in the south, particularly in Sicily, southern Sardinia and the south of Apulia.
text_zh: 義大利的**仙人掌**最常見於南部，特別是在西西里島、薩丁尼亞島南部和普利亞（Apulia）南部。

text: **Citrus plantations** are primarily found on eastern Sicily and the southern tip of Calabria.
text_zh: **柑橘園**主要分佈在西西里島東部和卡拉布里亞（Calabria）的最南端。

text: **Rice** is mainly produced in the western and central parts of Po valley, and less commonly in Sardinia.
text_zh: **稻米**主要產於波河平原西部和中部，在薩丁尼亞島較少見。

text: The island of Pantelleria is a volcanic island southwest of Sicily. Dark volcanic rocks can be seen in the many rock walls of the island, as well as on some houses. It is fairly common to see **yellow lichen** covering the rocks. The island also has a very large amount of cacti.
text_zh: 潘泰萊里亞島（Pantelleria）是西西里島西南部的火山島。島上許多石牆以及一些房屋上都可以看到深色的火山岩。看到覆蓋岩石的**黃色地衣**相當常見。該島也有大量的仙人掌。

text: The Aeolian islands are a volcanic archipelago north of Sicily. Here you will find a mix of volcanic soil and rocks with mediterranean vegetation, like stone pines or olive trees. Like in Sicily, cacti are fairly common.

In the mountains of the islands it is very common to see [touristic white villas](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.4821375,14.9501444,3a,33.7y,13.97h,96.75t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shlfKkMyHDc-zTzWKFLh70g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 伊奧利亞群島（Aeolian islands）是西西里島北部的火山群島。在這裡你會發現火山土壤和岩石與地中海植被（如石松或橄欖樹）的混合。就像在西西里島一樣，仙人掌相當常見。
在群島的山區裡，看到[觀光白色別墅](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.4821375,14.9501444,3a,33.7y,13.97h,96.75t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shlfKkMyHDc-zTzWKFLh70g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)非常普遍。

text: These artistically painted poles, made to resemble **birch trees**, are unique to the city of Date in Hokkaido.
text_zh: 這種彩繪成**白樺樹**外觀的電線桿，是北海道伊達市獨有的。

text: Many species of **eucalyptus **are commonly found in Kenya. They can be identified by their long, often clumped leaves, and smooth bark.
NOTE: Eucalyptus trees can be found in other countries. Use this information to help reinforce your country guess.
text_zh: 肯亞常見許多種**尤加利樹**。它們的特徵是長形的葉子（通常呈叢生狀）以及光滑的樹皮。
注意：其他國家也有尤加利樹。請利用這項資訊來輔助你判斷國家。

text: The northwest part of the country has very limited coverage, most of which is on the A1 or in Sibiloi National Park. It has faintly **tan soil **and sparse** low trees**. A lot of the coverage in this area is very flat, but you can also see hills or mountains.
NOTE: Most of this coverage has a [dirty exposed car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AVaanekywEYdiAqm6).
text_zh: 該國西北部的街景覆蓋非常有限，大部份位於 A1 公路或希比洛伊國家公園（Sibiloi National Park）內。這裡有著淡淡的**棕褐色土壤**與稀疏的**低矮樹木**。這區的大部分街景非常平坦，但你也能看到丘陵或山脈。
注意：此覆蓋的大多數街景都有[髒污的外露車身](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AVaanekywEYdiAqm6)。

text: Coastal Kenya can be identified by the presence of **coconut palms**, with rare areas in Taita-Taveta County also containing them.
text_zh: 肯亞沿海地區可以透過**椰子樹**的存在來識別，泰塔塔韋塔郡（Taita-Taveta County）中也有少數地區看得到。

text: **White flowers**, especially when they are in large numbers, are commonly found east of Chyulu Hills National Park, as well as in Tsavo National Park and near the A109 south of Nairobi.
text_zh: **白色花朵**常見於丘尤魯山國家公園（Chyulu Hills National Park）以東、察沃國家公園（Tsavo National Park）以及奈洛比以南的 A109 公路附近，特別是當它們數量龐大時。

text: The western part of the C34 is a flat, **east to west** road. There are two long, straight sections with an abundance of **sugar cane**. Furthermore, you will see a large **mountain range** **north** along the entire mentioned stretches of road.
text_zh: C34 的西部是一條平坦、**東西走向**的道路。這裡有兩段長且筆直的路段，並有大量的**甘蔗**。此外，在上述整段路程的**北方**，你會看到一座巨大的**山脈**。

text: This stretch of the B8 just north of Kibaoni has many **succulents **on the side of the road.
text_zh: 這段位於 Kibaoni 北邊的 B8 路段，路旁有許多**多肉植物**。

text: In Kyrgyzstan, you will often see trees and concrete poles that are **painted white** on the bottom.
text_zh: 在吉爾吉斯斯坦，你經常會看到樹木和混泥土電線桿的底部被**漆成白色**。

text: The mountains here can be characterised by **steep rocky cliffs** that can have a slight **purple or red** tint to them. Not much vegetation grows on these mountains - only some grass and shrubs. A small river also runs alongside the road. You can also spot these [brown metallic electricity pylons](https://goo.gl/maps/oscB5ajzy2rpkMi26) and [curved concrete guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/4nGewnwYYuPECDwa8) on the sides of this road.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 這裡的山脈特徵是**陡峭的岩壁**，可能帶有微弱的**紫色或紅色**調。這些山上沒有生長太多植被，只有一些草和灌木。一條小河也沿著道路流過。你還可以在這條路的兩側發現這些[棕色金屬電塔](https://goo.gl/maps/oscB5ajzy2rpkMi26)以及[彎曲的混凝土護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/4nGewnwYYuPECDwa8)。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: Going further west, you will encounter a very **hilly** landscape. The landscape features a lot of **vegetation** - tall grass, trees, bushes. This road uses these [concrete barriers](https://goo.gl/maps/KP2sH81R7BDqb2wx5) as guardrails, notice the cement above the gaps.
The general southeast to northwest driving direction on this road is also worth noting.
text_zh: 再往西走，你會遇到非常**丘陵**起伏的景觀。這裡的景觀有大量的**植被**——高草、樹木、灌木。這條路使用這些[混凝土護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/KP2sH81R7BDqb2wx5)作為護欄，注意看縫隙上方的水泥。
這條路大致由東南向西北的行駛方向也值得注意。

text: This divided road north of Bishkek, that leads up to the international airport, uses unique **yellow-and-black curbs** on the median, which consists of mostly grass. Some sections have small planted trees, and poles with red-and-yellow paint on the bottom. The [horizontal section](https://goo.gl/maps/3NtVfKr8wvp3ibU48) west of the airport has a lot more trees.
text_zh: 比什凱克北部這條通往國際機場的分隔道路，在主要由草地構成的分隔島上使用了獨特的**黃黑相間緣石**。有些路段種植了小樹，還有底部漆成紅黃相間的電線桿。機場西側的[水平路段](https://goo.gl/maps/3NtVfKr8wvp3ibU48)有更多樹木。

text: **Dry mountains** with a lack of trees are seen around Podgorica, and to the south of it. Vineyards are also commonly seen in this region.
text_zh: 波德里查周邊及南部一帶可以看到缺乏樹木的 **乾燥山脈**。這片地區也很常見到葡萄園。

text: **Pine forests** can be found in the north and a small area north of Nikšić, but most commonly in the **east**.
text_zh: **松樹林** 分布在北部、尼克希奇（Nikšić）以北的一小片區域，但最常見於 **東部**。

text: The C34 looks like darker streaks of black sand surrounded by more sand as far as the eye can see. Some coastal shrubbery, and even the [coast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iYzuJD2UtEKEzAh27) can be seen in some parts. [Unique white bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A9USD6ywaLZWggcN8) with two yellow reflectors on the front, and one red in the back can also be seen along the road at regular intervals.
text_zh: C34 看起來像是被更多沙子包圍的深色黑沙條紋，一眼望去盡是沙子。某些路段可以看到一些沿海灌木叢，甚至還能看見[`海岸`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iYzuJD2UtEKEzAh27)。沿著道路也可以看見[`獨特的白色路樁`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A9USD6ywaLZWggcN8)，其正面有兩個黃色反光片，背面有一個紅色反光片，以固定間距排列。

text: The Otago peninsula east of Dunedin is recognizable from its combination of plants such as [cabbage trees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cordyline_australis), [yellow flowered bushes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ulex_europaeus), small groves of [cone-shaped pine trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/62xUM4q8p2f4hsad7), and [New Zealand flax](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phormium_tenax). Additionally, the peninsula’s poles often have [off-centre crossbars](https://maps.app.goo.gl/twAx6yizxoiVJ3rm6).
text_zh: 達尼丁以東的奧塔哥半島可以透過其植物的組合來識別，例如[菜棕](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cordyline_australis)、[黃花灌木](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ulex_europaeus)、成群的小型[圓錐形松樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/62xUM4q8p2f4hsad7)以及[紐西蘭麻](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phormium_tenax)。此外，半島上的電線桿通常有[偏心的橫木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/twAx6yizxoiVJ3rm6)。

text: The general landscape of North Macedonia consists of relatively **dry grasslands**, and small hills and scattered trees.
text_zh: 北馬其頓的整體景觀由相對**乾燥的草原**、小山丘和散落的樹木組成。

text: Most roads are paralleled by fences that are partly or fully made out of small trees. The rest of the fence posts are also almost always wooden.
text_zh: 大多數道路旁都有部分或全部由小樹組成的圍籬。其餘的圍籬柱也幾乎都是木製的。

text: **Green tropical landscapes** with palm trees and very tall grass** **are common around Colón and Panama City.
text_zh: **綠意盎然的熱帶景觀**，伴隨棕櫚樹與非常高的草，**在科隆和巴拿馬市周邊很常見。**

text: A mountainous** **landscape with **pine trees**, **volcanic rocks**, **dry grass**, and gravel roads can be found northeast of Volcán.
text_zh: 沃爾坎（Volcán）東北方可以找到多山的**地景**，有**松樹**、**火山岩**、**乾草**和碎石路。

text: **Bollards **in Qatar are only found on a few roads, and you can easily tell them apart.
- The horizontal [road just west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gTG4kNoWi6Nvgzgd9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) uses black and yellow centre lines.
- The horizontal [road south of Madinat al Ka`ban](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8zw6N5R1F83nVcoE7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has a lot more greenery and, the coverage is also very overcast.
- The [coastal road south of Fuwayrit](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TccRhQzayTorZkmP9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has coastal shrubs all around, and you can often see the coast.
- If the road doesn’t fit the above descriptions, guess on [the long vertical road west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zc4PecYmyuGQXYju7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng).
text_zh: 卡達的**路樁**僅在少數幾條道路上找到，你可以輕鬆地將它們區分開來。
- 位於 [Qatar 地圖標籤正西方的橫向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gTG4kNoWi6Nvgzgd9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 使用黑黃相間的中心線。
- [Madinat al Ka`ban 南側的橫向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8zw6N5R1F83nVcoE7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 有更多綠色植物，且街景覆蓋非常陰暗多雲。
- [Fuwayrit 南側的沿海道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TccRhQzayTorZkmP9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 周圍環繞著海岸灌木叢，且經常可以看到海岸線。
- 如果道路不符合上述描述，請猜 [Qatar 地圖標籤西側的長縱向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zc4PecYmyuGQXYju7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)。

text: Trees and poles will often have **white painted bottoms**.
NOTE: This is also common in Ukraine and parts of Russia.
text_zh: 樹木和電線桿通常會有**漆成白色的底部**。
注意這在烏克蘭和俄羅斯部分地區也很常見。

text: Birch trees, identified by their white peeling bark, have a wide range in Russia. Notably they are almost never found far south or far north in the western part of the country.
text_zh: 樺樹以其會剝落的白色樹皮為特徵，在俄羅斯分佈廣泛。值得注意的是，在該國西部，它們幾乎不會出現在極南或極北地區。

text: Birches very close together, as well as forests consisting of **only birches**, are indicative of areas east of the Urals, most commonly between Chelyabinsk Oblast and Novosibirsk Oblast.
text_zh: 非常靠近的樺樹，以及**僅由樺樹組成**的森林，是烏拉山脈以東地區的指標，最常見於車里雅賓斯克州與新西伯利亞州之間。

text: Siberian larches are one of the dominant tree species in much of eastern Russia, recognized by their unique **needle-like leaves**. Generally speaking, they become more prevalent the further east you go in the country, as well as at high elevations.
text_zh: 西伯利亞落葉松是俄羅斯東部大部分地區的主要樹種之一，可透過其獨特的**針狀葉子**來識別。總體而言，越往該國東部走以及海拔越高，它們就會越普遍。

text: Spruce trees are an **evergreen tree** that can be identified by their dense and droopy or parallel branches, and generally are darker in color than most trees.
A similar evergreen tree, a [caucasian fir](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1XKsGPrBJaZiuSXn9), exists in the Caucasus Mountains. It has much more well organized and straighter branches.

NOTE: Larches have branches which point up and are less dense. Some [larches](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jmi4vRoWbfEr8TD37) can look very similar, but can be thought of as having much more unruly branches and look less “healthy”. Nonetheless, use with caution, especially on rounds that look eastern.
text_zh: 雲杉是一種**常綠樹**，可以透過其濃密且下垂或平行的樹枝來識別，且通常顏色比大多數樹木更深。
一種相似的常綠樹 [高加索冷杉](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1XKsGPrBJaZiuSXn9)，存在於高加索山脈。它的枝條更有條理且更筆直。
注意：落葉松的枝條朝上且較不濃密。有些 [落葉松](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jmi4vRoWbfEr8TD37) 看起來非常相似，但可以把它們想像成枝條更加凌亂且看起來比較「不健康」。儘管如此，請謹慎使用，特別是在看起來像東部的回合。

text: [Giant butterbur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petasites_japonicus) (commonly referred to as Sakhalin cabbage) is very common in Sakhalin Oblast, particularly in the southern half. Related plants can very rarely be found in [Adygea](https://goo.gl/maps/wWv1UwyS1XfNpC4v6).
text_zh: [巨蜂斗菜](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petasites_japonicus)（通常被稱為庫頁島白菜）在庫頁島州非常常見，特別是在南部地區。其近親植物在[阿迪格共和國](https://goo.gl/maps/wWv1UwyS1XfNpC4v6)則非常罕見。

text: This type of white flower ([heracleum sosnowskyi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heracleum_sosnowskyi)) is most commonly found around Moscow, Komi Republic, and Perm Krai.
text_zh: 這種白色的花（[索斯諾夫斯基歐防風](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heracleum_sosnowskyi)）最常分佈在莫斯科、科米共和國和彼爾姆邊疆區一帶。

text: Large amounts of the pink or red flower fireweed ([Chamaenerion angustifolium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chamaenerion_angustifolium)) typically indicates a northern region of Russia. Similarly, most places north of Moscow commonly have fireweed.
text_zh: 大量的粉紅色或紅色花朵雜草——柳葉菜（[Chamaenerion angustifolium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chamaenerion_angustifolium)）通常代表俄羅斯北部地區。同理，莫斯科以北的大多數地方也很常見到柳葉菜。

text: **Sunflowers **are common along the border with Ukraine as well as more eastern oblasts like Ulyanovsk, Samara, and northern Orenburg.
text_zh: **向日葵**在烏克蘭邊境一帶以及烏лья諾夫斯克（Ulyanovsk）、薩馬拉（Samara）和奧倫堡（Orenburg）北部等較東邊的州相當常見。

text: [Blue-pod lupines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lupinus_polyphyllus) appear very commonly in northern Vladimir Oblast, eastern Ivanovo Oblast, and southwestern Kostroma Oblast. It can also be found less commonly elsewhere in Kirov Oblast and towards the Baltics.
text_zh: [多葉羽扇豆](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lupinus_polyphyllus)非常常見於弗拉基米爾州北部、伊萬諾夫州東部以及科斯特羅馬州西南部。在基洛夫州的其他地方以及朝向波海三國的方向也能找到，但較為少見。

text: The **black poplar** is commonly found south, near the border with Ukraine, as well as toward the western border with Kazakhstan.
text_zh: **黑楊**常見於南部靠近烏克蘭邊境的地區，以及朝向與哈薩克西部邊境的方向。

text: The [Russian olive](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elaeagnus_angustifolia) is typically found along the Kazakhstan border.
text_zh: [沙棗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elaeagnus_angustifolia)通常分佈在哈薩克邊境沿線。

text: **Lined oak trees**, often with a single white stripe around the trunk, are extremely common in Kaliningrad.
text_zh: **列植橡樹**的樹幹上通常帶有一道白色的環狀漆線，這在加里寧格勒極為常見。

text: Sparsely **planted larches** along the road with open rolling fields is common in Tatarstan and adjacent federal subjects.
text_zh: 道路旁稀疏**種植的落葉松**配上開闊起伏的田野，常見於韃靼斯坦以及相鄰聯邦主體。

text: **Lush** and diverse forests in a **hilly** landscape characterises the noticeably warmer region around Vladivostok. Most of the coverage is overcast and has a white car with a long antenna. Further south, near the tri-border, you will find a more open [rolling hill landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/ErMpfen9KCE4HGHE7).
text_zh: **蒼翠**且多樣的森林搭配**丘陵**景觀，是海參崴周邊明顯較溫暖地區的特徵。大多數街景覆蓋都是陰天，並有一輛帶有長天線的白車。再往南走，靠近三國交界處附近，你會發現更開闊的[起伏丘陵景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/ErMpfen9KCE4HGHE7)。

text: The landscape in Buryatia is very unique, containing open grassy landscape with shrubs and mountains. It is lusher near Baikal, but the mountains persist.
text_zh: 布里雅特（Buryatia）的地景非常獨特，包含了帶有灌木與山脈的開闊草地景觀。貝加爾湖（Baikal）附近較為蒼翠，但山脈依然存在。

text: This **forest fire haze** is found near Lake Gusinoye, southwest of Ulan-Ude in Buryatia. While similar to the haze found near [Mirny](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kZY7oWKZW3bHoFp5A), the Buryatia haze coverage can typically be recognised by the **open rolling landscape**, which is not found near Mirny.
text_zh: 這種**森林大火煙霧**（forest fire haze）可以在布里雅特烏蘭烏德（Ulan-Ude）西南方的古西諾耶湖（Lake Gusinoye）附近找到。雖然它類似於[米爾內](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kZY7oWKZW3bHoFp5A)附近的霧氣，但布里雅特的霧霾街景通常可以透過**開闊的起伏地景**來辨認，這是米爾內附近所沒有的。

text: The landscape in the far north can be recognised by the relatively **flat** landscape, with **very low vegetation**.
text_zh: 極北地區的景觀可以透過相對**平坦**的地形以及**極矮的植被**來辨識。

text: The coverage in Omsk Oblast is some of the most recognizable in Russia. It is typically summer Generation 4 and has a distinct landscape consisting of green agricultural fields, which are interrupted by isolated patches of (primarily) birch forest.
Note that in Generation 3, this landscape can be seen in a much larger area of Russia.
NOTE: This combination of coverage and landscape spills over slightly into the neighbouring Tyumen and Novosibirsk Oblasts (in the south, and near Tatarsk, respectively).
text_zh: 鄂木斯克州（Omsk Oblast）的街景覆蓋是俄羅斯辨識度最高的地方之一。通常是夏季的 Generation 4，並擁有獨特的景觀，包含綠色的農田，其中穿插著（主要為）樺樹林的孤立塊狀林地。
請注意，在 Generation 3 中，這種景觀可以在俄羅斯大得多的區域看到。
注意：這樣的街景覆蓋與景觀組合會稍微延伸到鄰近的秋明州與新西伯利亞州（分別位於南部，以及塔塔尔斯克附近）。

text: **Grassy fields**, with **bushy vegetation**, in early spring Generation 4 coverage is typical for Dagestan. The landscape can either be completely [flat](https://goo.gl/maps/aagmDRf8TAcokMkn9) or [mountainous](https://goo.gl/maps/ZbWrv4FiuSGLBzHq9). [These flowers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P26tJd6Lf73upk4G8) are also quite common in the Generation 4 Dagestan coverage.
text_zh: 在早春的 Generation 4 街景覆蓋中，帶有**叢生植被的草地**是達吉斯坦的典型特徵。景觀可能是完全[平坦](https://goo.gl/maps/aagmDRf8TAcokMkn9)或是[多山的](https://goo.gl/maps/ZbWrv4FiuSGLBzHq9)。[這些花朵](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P26tJd6Lf73upk4G8)在達吉斯坦的 Generation 4 街景中也相當常見。

text: An open, hilly landscape with low shrubbery and [fireweed](https://goo.gl/maps/jQxpJeqbas286g7i7) usually indicates Murmansk. The lower the shrubbery, the more north it generally is.
text_zh: 開闊的丘陵景觀、低矮的灌木叢以及[柳葉菜](https://goo.gl/maps/jQxpJeqbas286g7i7)通常指向莫曼斯克。灌木叢越低，通常代表位置越偏北。

text: **Eucalyptus **are very commonly found in Rwanda. They can be identified by their long, often clumped leaves, and smooth bark.
NOTE: Eucalyptus can be found in Kenya and other countries. Use with caution.
text_zh: 盧安達非常常見到**尤加利樹**。其特徵為長而常呈叢狀的葉子以及光滑的樹皮。
注意：肯亞和其他國家也能找到尤加利樹。請謹慎使用。

text: Banana plants are common throughout Rwanda.
text_zh: 香蕉樹在整個盧安達都很常見。

text: **Tea plantations **are common in Western Rwanda, and a couple other pockets.
text_zh: **茶園**在盧安達西部以及其他少數地區很常見。

text: Northeastern Rwanda has less extreme elevation compared to the rest of Rwanda. It more so consists of rolling hills and open agricultural land or undeveloped grassland.
text_zh: 盧安達東北部的海拔起伏比起盧安達其他地區沒那麼極端。它主要由綿延起伏的丘陵、開闊的農田或未開發的草原組成。

text: The Nyungwe Forest National Park goes through a **lush** and **hilly **landscape, which has 2 distinct covered roads; The yellow NR10 is paved, with roadlines. **French style bollards** and** green lamp posts** can be seen on the sides of the road. The[ white NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) going south is mostly paved, except for the [southernmost section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6). No roadlines are present.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.
text_zh: 紐恩威森林國家公園（Nyungwe Forest National Park）穿過一片**蒼翠**且**丘陵起伏**的地貌，這裡有 2 條不同的覆蓋道路：黃色的 NR10 是柏油路，有道路標線。道路兩側可以看到**法式路樁**與**綠色路燈**。往南的[白色 NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) 大部分是柏油路，除了[最南端路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6)外。沒有道路標線。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

text: These **small yellow signs** advertising tree felling are commonly found on utility poles and lamp posts in the suburbs of Stockholm. While the phone code for Stockholm is usually written on the signs, it is often difficult to make out [from a distance](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vu1DKvwVwfjsGnEd9).
text_zh: 這些宣傳砍樹的**小型黃色標誌**常見於斯德哥爾摩郊區的電線桿和燈柱上。雖然斯德哥爾摩的電話區號通常寫在標誌上，但[從遠處](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vu1DKvwVwfjsGnEd9)往往很難看清。

text: The Provincial Highway 20, specifically the part that runs through **Yushan National Park**, features tall mountains covered with coniferous trees. The road also utilises these tube-like double guardrails.
NOTE: This road is only covered in Generation 2 and 4. The Generation 4 coverage is very overexposed and features sunny weather.
text_zh: 台 20 線（南橫公路）行經**玉山國家公園**的路段，兩側是覆滿針葉樹的高山，並採用這種管狀雙層護欄。
註：這條路只有第二代與第四代街景覆蓋。第四代的畫面曝光過度，且是晴天拍攝。

text: The road that leads up to Taipingshan National Forest in Yilan is distinct due to it often being **very foggy** when covered. Other features of this road include the coniferous trees and a guardrail with red legs.

NOTE: Certain parts of the roads feature a [sunset](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=Guivd71mf24KYdvORBDNSA&viewpoint=24.515398%2C121.583108&heading=223.98270208148256&pitch=13.883893360213435&fov=133.16346058432444) in Generation 3.
text_zh: 宜蘭通往太平山國家森林遊樂區的道路特徵明顯：拍攝時經常**濃霧瀰漫**。此外還有針葉樹以及紅色支柱的護欄。

註：部分路段在第三代街景中會拍到[夕陽](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=Guivd71mf24KYdvORBDNSA&viewpoint=24.515398%2C121.583108&heading=223.98270208148256&pitch=13.883893360213435&fov=133.16346058432444)。

text: This is a **forest density map** of the contiguous United States. Eastern and Northern regions of the country typically have much denser tree cover than Western and Southwestern regions.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這是美國本土的**森林密度圖**。該國的東部和北部地區通常比西部和西南部地區擁有密得多得多的樹木覆蓋。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The Great Plains are in the middle of the United States and stretch from the Canadian border in the North, to central Texas in the South. This area is primarily **flat with few trees**. Some areas feature agriculture fields, while others feature dry and barren grassy fields.
text_zh: 大平原（Great Plains）位於美國中部，北起加拿大邊境，南至德州中部。這個地區主要為**地勢平坦且樹木稀少**。有些區域以農田為主，有些則是乾燥荒涼的草地。

text: The Appalachian mountain range is a low mountain range that runs through the eastern states. The general landscape consists of **low, forested mountains**, with beech and oak trees being a common sight.

NOTE: Houses in the south generally have [less storeys](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8). [New England architecture](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76), commonly consisting of wood panelling, high roofs and a porch, is also more common toward the north, especially in New England.
text_zh: 阿帕拉契山脈（Appalachian mountain range）是一條貫穿東部各州的低矮山脈。整體景觀為**低矮且林木茂密的山區**，常見山毛櫸和橡樹。
注意：南方的房屋通常[樓層較少](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8)。[新英格蘭建築](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76)通常具有木製外牆、高屋頂和門廊，這在北方也較為常見，特別是在新英格蘭地區。

text: The area stretching from the Canadian border to Northern New Mexico is home to the Rocky Mountains. These jagged, rocky formations often feature many **pine trees** and **visible snow** all year round at the highest peaks. Some areas of the Rocky Mountain Range are noticeably [dry](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8), with few trees.
text_zh: 從加拿大邊境延伸至新墨西哥州北部的區域是洛磯山脈（Rocky Mountains）的所在地。這些鋸齒狀的岩石地形在最高峰通常有許多**松樹**，且全年都有**清晰可見的積雪**。洛磯山脈的某些地區明顯[乾燥](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8)，且樹木稀少。

text: The Great Basin, centred around Nevada, can be recognized by the tall, sometimes [snow-capped](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7) mountains in the background. There are dry, but grassy, and slightly **shrubby plains** leading up to the mountains.

The tallest mountains are in Nevada, Utah and California. More [gradual, rocky hills](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57) can be seen in Oregon, and [greener mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18) can be seen in Idaho and central Utah.
Keep in mind that there are exceptions, so make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 以內華達州為中心的大盆地，其特徵是背景中高聳且有時[覆雪](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7)的山脈。通往山脈的平原乾燥但長滿青草，且略帶**灌木叢生**。
最高聳的山脈位於內華達州、猶他州和加州。在奧勒岡州可以看到較為[平緩的岩石山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57)，而在愛達荷州和猶他州中部則可以看到[較為翠綠的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18)。
請記住凡事都有例外，因此在猜測之前務必留意其他線索。

text: In the Appalachian area stretching from southern New York to southern Virginia, there are a lot of forest-covered rolling hills, with **flat valleys** dividing them. A majority of the ridges are oriented Southwest to Northeast.
text_zh: 在從紐約州南部延伸至維吉尼亞州南部的阿帕拉契地區，有許多森林覆蓋的起伏山丘，並由**平坦的山谷**分隔開來。多數的山脊走向為西南至東北。

text: Temperate rainforests are found in coastal areas of Washington, Oregon, and Northern California. These rainforests feature many **broadleaf trees, large conifers, and ferns.**
NOTE: These rainforests stretch north into coastal British Columbia and Southeast Alaska as well.
text_zh: 溫帶雨林分佈在華盛頓州、奧勒岡州和加州北部的沿海地區。這些雨林有許多**闊葉樹、大型針葉樹和蕨類植物。**
注意：這些雨林也向北延伸至英屬哥倫比亞省沿海和阿拉斯加東南部。

text: Central Valley, California can be recognized by its **Mediterranean climate**. This is reflected in its agriculture, seen in the vineyards and olive trees that can commonly be found here.
In addition, [rolling hills](https://goo.gl/maps/RU5Wcy6ubkyWLn5U6) can be seen toward the edges of the valley.
text_zh: 加州的中央谷地（Central Valley）可以透過其**地中海型氣候**來識別。這反映在其農業上，在這裡常見到葡萄園和橄欖樹。
此外，在谷地邊緣可以看到[起伏的山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/RU5Wcy6ubkyWLn5U6)。

text: Just west of the metropolitan areas of Austin and San Antonio Texas lies a large area of dry, rocky hills featuring many **yucca** and **prickly pear** plants. [Texas Live Oak](https://goo.gl/maps/w98CVBghQFtndu9C6) trees are the predominant tree type in this area.
text_zh: 就在德州奧斯汀和聖安東尼奧都會區的正西方，坐落著一大片乾燥的岩石丘陵地帶，長有許多**絲蘭**和**刺梨**植物。[德州櫟樹（Texas Live Oak）](https://goo.gl/maps/w98CVBghQFtndu9C6)是該地區主要的樹種。

text: The Rio Grande Valley in South Texas is **extremely flat** and features **shrubby trees** and agricultural fields. This area borders the Mexican state of Tamaulipas.
text_zh: 德州南部的格蘭德河谷（Rio Grande Valley）**極為平坦**，且有**灌木狀的樹木**和農田。這個地區與墨西哥的塔毛利帕斯州接壤。

text: **Corn fields** can most commonly be found in these regions. For a detailed overview, see [this](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Corn_Belt_2018.svg) map.
text_zh: **玉米田**最常在這些地區找到。如需詳細概覽，請參閱[這張](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Corn_Belt_2018.svg)地圖。

text: **Soybeans** are short, dark green crops organised in long rows and are found in similar regions where corn is grown. They are most common in the Eastern Plains, Midwest, Lower Mississippi Valley, and areas of the Mid Atlantic.
text_zh: **大豆**是矮小、深綠色的作物，以長排方式排列，分佈在種植玉米的類似地區。它們在東部平原、中西部、下密西西比河谷和大西洋中部部分地區最為常見。

text: Along the Canadian border in North Dakota, and rarely Montana, fields filled with **short yellow canola flowers** (Brassica napus) can commonly be seen from the road.
text_zh: 在北達科他州沿著加拿大邊境，以及少數的蒙大拿州，從路上常能看到開滿**黃色油菜花（Brassica napus）**的田野。

text: **Cotton** is a crop that produces large fields of **fluffy white flowers**. It is most commonly produced in coastal Southeastern states, the Lower Mississippi River Valley, Western Texas, and parts of California and Arizona. You can click [here](https://ers.usda.gov/sites/default/files/_laserfiche/Charts/99698/CottonAcreage2017.png?v=95859) for a more detailed map.
NOTE: When cotton is not fully grown (earlier in the year) cotton fields often look like [this](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KfHaonkY71zhSDfe7).
text_zh: **棉花**是一種能長出大片**蓬鬆白花**田野的作物。它最常生產於東南部沿海各州、下密西西比河谷、德州西部以及加州和亞利桑那的部分地區。您可以點擊[這裡](https://ers.usda.gov/sites/default/files/_laserfiche/Charts/99698/CottonAcreage2017.png?v=95859)查看更詳細的地圖。
注意：當棉花尚未完全生長時（年份較早的時候），棉花田通常看起來像[這樣](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KfHaonkY71zhSDfe7)。

text: **Rice** production only occurs in a few areas of the US, so it is very useful for region guessing. It is typically grown in large, flat fields that resemble low prairies. It is only grown in north-central California and the Lower Mississippi River Valley in Arkansas, Louisiana, Texas, and Mississippi. You can click [here](https://ipad.fas.usda.gov/rssiws/al/crop_production_maps/US/USA_Rice.png) for a more detailed map.
NOTE: When rice is not fully grown, rice fields often look similar to [this](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e5TVrT3jBQg4Mgrb7).
text_zh: **稻米**生產僅發生在美國少數地區，因此對於地區猜測非常有用。它通常種植在類似低矮草原的大片平坦田野中。它僅種植在加州中北部以及阿肯色州、路易斯安那州、德州和密西西比州的下密西西比河谷。您可以點擊[這裡](https://ipad.fas.usda.gov/rssiws/al/crop_production_maps/US/USA_Rice.png)查看更詳細的地圖。
注意：當稻米尚未完全生長時，稻田通常看起來與[這個](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e5TVrT3jBQg4Mgrb7)相似。

text: The Eastern White Pine (_Pinus strobus_) has **horizontally layered branches** that gradually curve upwards at the ends, giving the tree a rather graceful appearance. They are common in New England, the northern Midwest near the Great Lakes, and the Appalachians.
NOTE: They can be found in eastern Canada as well.
text_zh: 東方白松（_Pinus strobus_）具有**水平分層的樹枝**，末端逐漸向上彎曲，賦予樹木相當優雅的外觀。牠們在新英格蘭、五大湖附近的中西部北部以及阿帕拉契山脈很常見。
注意：牠們也分佈在加拿大東部。

text: The loblolly pine (Pinus taeda), and longleaf pine (Pinus palustris), commonly referred to as **southern pines** in the community, are found throughout the southeastern US. They are a great way to recognize this region, as they are abundant, recognizable and mostly limited to this part of the country. They tend to be tall, with fluffy-looking clusters of pine needles.
text_zh: 火炬松（Pinus taeda）和長葉松（Pinus palustris），在社群中通常被稱為**南方松**，分佈於美國東南部各地。牠們是認出這個地區的好方法，因為牠們數量豐富、易於辨識且大多僅限於該國的這個部分。牠們通常很高，帶有蓬鬆外觀的松針叢。

text: Grass that is used in lawns in the southern US (colloquially known as [Bermuda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynodon_dactylon) and [St. Augustine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Augustine_grass) grasses) go dormant in the winter months. This causes the lawns to turn **beige or light brown in winter**; whereas grasses used in more northern areas of the US stay [much greener](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7HwppvMy4zQG2feq9) in winter.
text_zh: 美國南部用於草坪的草（俗稱[百慕達草](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynodon_dactylon)和[聖奧古斯丁草](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Augustine_grass)）在冬季會進入休眠。這會導致草坪在**冬季變成米色或淺棕色**；而美國較北地區使用的草在冬季則會[保持翠綠得多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7HwppvMy4zQG2feq9)。

text: Great Basin Sagebrush ([Artemisia tridentata](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artemisia_tridentata)) is a **short, shrubby blue-green bush** that is common in the interior western United States. It is most common in arid areas.
text_zh: 大盆地山艾樹 ([Artemisia tridentata](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artemisia_tridentata)) 是一種**矮小、呈灌木狀的藍綠色矮樹叢**，在美國西部內陸很常見。它在乾旱地區最為常見。

text: Saguaro cacti are most commonly shaped like** tall, straight tubes **with **several branches **extending from the main tube. They are most commonly found in southern Arizona, on the Sonoran border.
text_zh: 巨人柱仙人掌通常形狀像**高而直的圓柱**，主幹上延伸出**數個分枝**。它們最常分佈在亞利桑那州南部，位於索諾拉邊界一帶。

text: Extremely **tall conifer trees** ([Douglas firs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Douglas_fir)) with a dark brown bark, and dark green leaves, can most commonly be seen in Cascadia. Notably, they can also be found in northern California, Idaho and as far east as Montana.
Beware that they are also commonly found in British Columbia.
text_zh: 極其**高大的針葉樹**（[花旗松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Douglas_fir)），擁有深棕色樹皮與深綠色葉子，最常出現在卡斯卡底熱帶雨林。值得注意的是，它們也分佈在加州北部、愛達荷州，甚至向東延伸至蒙大拿州。
請注意，它們在英屬哥倫比亞省也很常見。

text: **Palm trees** are common in coastal areas of the Southeastern states, as well as the Desert Southwest region. Shown here is the Mexican Fan Palm, which is most common in California and along the Gulf Coast, but other palm tree types have a similar range.
text_zh: **棕櫚樹**常見於東南部各州的沿海地區，以及沙漠西南地區。此處顯示的是墨西哥扇椰子，最常見於加州及墨西哥灣沿岸，但其他種類的棕櫚樹也有類似的分布範圍。

text: Spanish moss, appearing as **greyish white drapes**, can sometimes be seen on trees in the Deep South.
text_zh: 有時可以在美國南部深處的樹上看到如**灰白色垂簾**般外觀的西班牙苔蘚。

text: Spanish Colonial Revival Architecture can be categorised as buildings with **lightly-coloured stucco walls** and **red clay-tile roofs**. They can be found in the desert southwest states of California, Nevada, Arizona, and Texas. You can also find similar types of buildings in Florida and coastal Georgia.
text_zh: 西班牙殖民復興建築的特點是擁有**淺色 stucco 外牆**和**紅瓦屋頂**。它們可以在西南部沙漠各州（加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州和德州）找到。你在佛羅里達州和喬治亞州海岸也能找到類似類型的建築。

text: Deep South Florida, between the metropolitan areas of Ft. Myers and Miami, features **dense, jungle-like forests** that have few inhabitants. Roads through these areas are commonly very straight and long.
text_zh: 南佛羅里達深處，在麥爾茲堡（Ft. Myers）和邁阿密等大都會區之間，有著**人煙稀少的茂密叢林般森林**。穿過這些地區的道路通常非常筆直且漫長。

text: The Florida Keys are an archipelago of tropical islands west of Miami. The highway connecting the islands can be recognized by green, tropical vegetation on the sides of the usually single lane road. The soil is also **sandy white**.
Urban locations are also similar, but with many more planted palm trees and mowed grass being a common sight.
text_zh: 佛羅里達礁島群是邁阿密以西的一群熱帶島嶼。連接這些島嶼的公路可以透過通常為單線道道路兩側的綠色熱帶植被來辨識。土壤也是**沙白色**。
城鎮地點也很相似，但有更多種植的棕櫚樹，修剪整齊的草皮也很常見。

text: Southwestern Oklahoma features a small area of **rocky, shrubby peaks**. Some of the mountains are also covered in trees, and the rocks can have a pinkish red tint to them.
text_zh: 奧克拉荷馬州西南部有一小片**岩石林立、灌木叢生的山峰**。有些山脈也覆蓋著樹木，岩石可能帶有粉紅色調。

text: Along the New Mexico and or Texas border there is a ridge of **tall, dry peaks** known as the Guadalupe Mountains. In adjacent areas of both states, [smaller foothills](https://goo.gl/maps/7ugHko97ZYSDBNDG9) of these mountains can be seen with relatively flat tops and shrubby foliage.
text_zh: 在新墨西哥州及／或德州的邊界沿線，有一道被稱為瓜達盧佩山脈（Guadalupe Mountains）的**高大乾旱山脊**。在兩州相鄰的地區，可以看到這些山脈[較小的山前丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/7ugHko97ZYSDBNDG9)，山頂相對平坦，並覆蓋著灌木植被。

text: The Black Hills, located in far Western South Dakota and far Eastern Wyoming, are a series of moderately tall mountains with large amounts of **conifer trees** and **rocky outcroppings**. The surrounding areas are typically much flatter with lesser tree cover.
NOTE: This area has a similar appearance to many areas within the Rocky Mountains, which lie further to the West.
text_zh: 黑山（The Black Hills）位於南達科他州最西部和懷俄明州最東部，是一系列中等高度的山脈，擁有大量的**針葉樹**和**岩石露頭**。周圍地區通常平坦得多，樹木覆蓋率較低。
注意：這個地區的外觀與進一步向西延伸的洛磯山脈中的許多地區相似。

text: Trees in Alaska are generally **thinner** and have less broad leaves than those seen in the other 49 states.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加的樹木通常比較**細**，葉子也比較不寬大，與美國其他 49 州的樹木相比。

text: Most of interior and northern Alaska lies in subarctic or** tundra** climate zones. These areas feature relatively low amounts of [forest undergrowth](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mFe2xNzxYnqgY5Af6) and [shorter trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oaa8n8a7AbYVj7YSA).
text_zh: 阿拉斯加內陸及北部大部分地區屬於副北極或**苔原**氣候區。這些地區的[森林下層植被](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mFe2xNzxYnqgY5Af6)相對稀疏，[樹木也較矮](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oaa8n8a7AbYVj7YSA)。

text: The Alaskan towns in the Alexander Archipelago, on the British Columbia border have a unique look. Tall mountains with **lush green forests** can be seen in the background, with the majority of buildings made of wood. In addition, [Generation 2](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8) coverage is often overcast and misty.
NOTE: Coastal areas of [Oregon](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7) and [Washington](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6) can have a similar appearance in terms of landscape and foliage.
text_zh: 位於與英屬哥倫比亞省接壤處的亞歷山大群島阿拉斯加城鎮，外觀獨特。背景可見高聳且**綠意盎然的森林**山脈，大部分建築物為木造。此外，[第二代相機](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8)的街景覆蓋通常陰天且多霧。
注意：[奧勒岡州](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7)和[華盛頓州](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6)的沿海地區在景觀和植被方面可能外觀相似。

text: **Aspen trees** ([Populus tremuloides](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Populus_tremuloides)) can be found in lower elevation areas of interior and south-central regions of Alaska. These trees have white bark and rounded leaves.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加內部及中南部較低海拔地區可以找到**白樺樹** ([山楊](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Populus_tremuloides))。這些樹有白色的樹皮和圓形的葉子。

text: **Juneau**, Alaska’s Capital city, is the largest settlement in the Alaskan panhandle. Therefore, it is much more ‘built up’ than other towns in this area. The city is surrounded by heavily forested mountains and hills.
text_zh: **朱諾**是阿拉斯加州的首府，也是阿拉斯加狹長地帶最大的聚落。因此，相較於該地區其他城鎮，朱諾的「建設」更為完善。這座城市被森林密布的山脈和丘陵環繞。

text: The Denali highway, stretching from Cantwell to Paxson in central Alaska, is a mostly **gravel highway** in the ‘Alaska’ mountain range. This road runs generally east to west, is covered in the generation 2 camera, and was taken in late summer, so wildflowers and green shrubby plants are common.
text_zh: 迪納利公路從阿拉斯加中部的坎特威爾延伸到帕克斯頓，是「阿拉斯加」山脈中一條大多為**碎石公路**。這條道路大致呈東西走向，由第二代相機拍攝，且是在夏末拍攝的，因此野花和綠色灌木植物很常見。

text: The general landscape consists of **green, tropical** mountains with many palm trees. Small roads are often made of [concrete](https://goo.gl/maps/GENv4jmjUzvkSbp38). Most houses are one storey, and have a simple box design. Plain **metal sheet** roofs are also very common.
text_zh: 整體地貌由**綠意盎然的熱帶**山脈和許多棕櫚樹組成。小路通常由[混凝土](https://goo.gl/maps/GENv4jmjUzvkSbp38)製成。大多數房屋為一層樓，採用簡單的箱型設計。樸素的**金屬板**屋頂也十分常見。

text: Ofu Airport is small with a **concrete** runway. The Google Car covering it has two **orange straps** on the roof. Many palm trees can also be seen on the other side of the runway.
text_zh: Ofu機場是個小型機場，跑道是**混凝土**的。拍攝該機場的Google 車車頂有兩條**橘色綁帶**。跑道另一側也能看到許多棕櫚樹。

text: All the Generation 3 coverage was taken in October, meaning that many deciduous trees have **autumn colours**.
text_zh: 所有第三代街景覆蓋都是在十月拍攝的，這表示許多落葉樹都呈現**秋天的顏色**。

text: **Pas de la Casa**, a touristy city in eastern Andorra, can be easily recognized by the plethora of shops and hotels. As it is located at an altitude of 2080 metres, there are no trees visible on the mountains surrounding it.
text_zh: **帕斯德拉卡薩**是安道爾東部的一個觀光城市，很容易透過大量的商店和飯店來辨識。由於它位於海拔 2080 公尺處，周圍的山上看不到任何樹木。

text: In the Chaco and Formosa provinces, you will often see **sandy soil** with an **abundance of vegetation**; mainly low trees and bushes.
text_zh: 在查科省和福爾摩沙省，你經常會看到**沙質土壤**，伴隨著**豐富的植被**；主要為低矮的樹木和灌木叢。

text: **Grassland** with a few separated tree plantations is generally found in this area.
text_zh: 帶有一些分散的樹木種植區的**草原**通常會在這個區域找到。

text: If you see this kind of vegetation with **flat grass** and a low number of bushes, you are almost certainly in the state of Tierra del Fuego or southeastern Santa Cruz.
text_zh: 如果你看到這種帶有**平坦的草地**和少量灌木叢的植被，你幾乎可以確定是在火地島省或聖克魯斯省東南部。

text: The majority of **tree plantations** in Argentina are located in the Entre Rios province.
NOTE: Uruguay and southern Brazil have them as well. Make sure to look at other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 阿根廷大部分的**人工林**都位於恩特雷里奧斯省。
注意：烏拉圭和巴西南部也有這些人工林。猜測前請務必查看其他線索。

text: **Beech forests** are commonly found in the state of Tierra del Fuego.
text_zh: **山毛櫸森林**常見於火地島省。

text: [Coperinicia alba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copernicia_alba), also known as the Caranday Wax Palm,** **have short, **fan-like leaves **that tend to grow in low-density, single-species forests. Most common in Formosa, they can also be found in Chaco, Corrientes and northern Santa Fe.
text_zh: [白羽扇椰子](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copernicia_alba)（亦稱為卡蘭代蠟棕）**具有短小的**扇形葉片**，**通常生長在低密度的單一樹種森林中。最常見於福爾摩沙省，在查科省、科連特斯省及聖塔菲省北部也能找到。

text: [Trithrinax Campestris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trithrinax_campestris), or the caranday palm, not to be confused with the Caranday Wax Palm, is a rustic palm native to the Sierras de Córdoba with a broader distribution in San Luis and northern mountainous Argentina. It can be identified by its compact fan-like leaves** **with a trunk hidden by a **coat of dead-leaves.**
text_zh: [田野三稜棕](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trithrinax_campestris)（即卡蘭代棕，切勿與卡蘭代蠟棕混淆）是一種源自科爾多瓦山脈的粗生棕櫚，在聖路易省及阿根廷北部山區分佈較廣。其特徵為**緊密的扇形葉片**，且樹幹被一層**枯葉外殼**所覆蓋。

text: The [Butia yatay palm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butia_yatay)** **has arching, [pinnate leaves](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinnation) and often grows at an incline with varying heights. It is most common in Corrientes and Parque Nacional El Palmar, Entre Rios.
text_zh: [巴拉圭椰子](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butia_yatay)**具有拱形的[羽狀葉](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinnation)，**通常帶有傾斜度且高度不一。最常見於科連特斯省及恩特雷里奧斯省的埃爾帕爾馬國家公園。

text: The [Totai Palm](https://species.wikimedia.org/wiki/Acrocomia_totai) has **small** **thin leaves** with a visible **spear shaped** top, and a **smooth trunk**. It can be found as a decorational plant all across Argentina, however in the wild it is most common in Formosa, Chaco and Misiones.
text_zh: [托泰棕](https://species.wikimedia.org/wiki/Acrocomia_totai)具有**小型**的**薄葉**，頂端有明顯的**長矛狀**結構，並擁有**光滑的樹幹**。它在全阿根廷都被作為觀賞植物種植，但在野外則最常見於福爾摩沙省、查科省和米西奧內斯省。

text: [Stetsonia coryne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stetsonia_coryne), or the **toothpick cactus**, is a large tree-like cactus with many branches and spines resembling toothpicks. Its habitat includes a hotspot between Catamarca and Cordoba as well as the border area between Chaco, Salta and Formosa.
text_zh: [斯特松仙人掌](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stetsonia_coryne)（即**牙籤仙人掌**）是一種大型樹狀仙人掌，有許多分枝和酷似牙籤的刺。其棲息地包括卡塔馬卡省與科爾多瓦省之間交界熱點，以及查科省、薩爾塔省和福爾摩沙省的邊境地區。

text: [Prosopis caldenia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prosopis_caldenia), known as the caldén, is a decently **large deciduous tree** with **small leaves** and **sinuous branches**. It is mainly found in La Pampa.
NOTE: This tree can sometimes be confused with other trees such as the [White Carob](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prosopis_alba).
text_zh: [卡爾登木](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prosopis_caldenia)又稱卡爾登樹，是一種相當**大型的落葉樹**，具有**小葉片**和**蜿蜒的樹枝**。主要分佈於拉潘帕省。
注意：這種樹有時會與其他樹木混淆，例如[白角豆樹](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prosopis_alba)。

text: Single **rows of poplar trees**, characterised by their thin and tall appearance, are very common around Neuquén. The area is also very flat.
text_zh: 單排**白楊樹**，以其細長高聳的外觀為特徵，在內烏肯省周圍非常常見。該地區也十分平坦。

text: The **monkey puzzle** **tree** can be found in western Neuquen. The most specimens are seen on state road 23.
NOTE: They are seen on the other side in Chile** **as well.
text_zh: **智利** **松**可見於內烏肯省西部。大多數可在23號省道上看到。
注意：它們也** **可見於智利另一側。

text: **Gum trees (eucalyptus)** are by far the most common type of tree in Australia. Their bark is typically light-coloured, with puffy puffy clusters of leaves.
NOTE: Their look may vary significantly, depending on your location within the country. More details can be found in the region-guessing section.
text_zh: **桉樹（尤加利樹）**是澳洲最常見的樹種。它們的樹皮通常顏色較淺，葉子呈蓬鬆的簇狀。
注意：它們的外觀可能會有很大的差異，取決於你在該國境內的位置。更多細節請參閱區域判斷章節。

text: The area around Warramboo in SA to Madura in WA has a unique landscape. Vegetation is quite **dry **and is made up of shrubs and **wide crowned eucalyptus**. In addition, the soil is sandy with a slight orange tint.
The dry area east of Adelaide and into northwestern Victoria has a similar landscape, with the same vegetation but usually with [**whiter soil**](https://goo.gl/maps/rFiSFVLVUJcF4kGt5).
NOTE: The soil gets more red in the WA side. Redder soil can also be seen more inland on the Victorian side around Mildura. In addition, the Nullarbor Highway has a distinct landscape.
text_zh: 從南澳（SA）的 Warramboo 到西澳（WA）的 Madura 一帶有獨特的景觀。植被相當**乾燥**，由灌木叢和**寬冠桉樹**組成。此外，土壤是沙質的，帶有淡淡的橘色。
阿得雷德以東和維多利亞西北部的乾燥地區有相似的景觀，植被相同，但土壤通常[**更白**](https://goo.gl/maps/rFiSFVLVUJcF4kGt5)。
注意：在西澳（WA）一側，土壤會更紅。在維多利亞（Victorian）一側，米爾杜拉（Mildura）周圍的內陸地區也能看到更紅的土壤。此外，納拉伯公路（Nullarbor Highway）有獨特的景觀。

text: **Lush green or golden **fields can be found in this band from the south of the Yorke Peninsula to Echuca. In the SA side, the landscape should be drier than the Victorian side and more wide crowned eucalyptus can be seen. On the Victorian side, the trees generally have more leaves and are taller.
NOTE: The area near Mount Gambier has a distinct landscape. For more information, see below.
text_zh: 從約克半島（Yorke Peninsula）南部到埃丘卡（Echuca）的這條地帶，可以發現**鬱鬱蔥蔥的綠色或金黃色**田野。在南澳（SA）一側，景觀應該比維多利亞（Victorian）一側更乾燥，可以看到更多寬冠桉樹。在維多利亞（Victorian）一側，樹木通常葉子更多且更高。
注意：甘比爾山（Mount Gambier）附近的地區有獨特的景觀。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱下方。

text: Coastal northern Queensland is very **tropical**. Typical vegetation consists of palm trees and dark green vegetation.
text_zh: 昆士蘭（Queensland）北部沿海地區非常**熱帶**。典型的植被由棕櫚樹和深綠色植物組成。

text: The landscape in inland NSW is mostly flat, and the soil gets **redder **the more inland you go. Vegetation consists of mostly dry **pale-green shrubs**. Further east and on the Queensland and Victorian borders, the climate gets more temperate but is still quite dry and more eucalyptus trees can be seen, with the soil transitioning into a more sandy colour as well as more hills being [visible](https://goo.gl/maps/GhZAimbF6eymrGVE9).
text_zh: 新南威爾斯（NSW）內陸地區的景觀大多平坦，越往內陸，土壤就越**紅**。植被主要由乾燥的**淺綠色灌木叢**組成。再往東，在昆士蘭（Queensland）和維多利亞（Victorian）邊界，氣候變得更溫和，但仍然相當乾燥，可以看到更多的桉樹，土壤也過渡到更沙質的顏色，並且可以看到更多的[山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/GhZAimbF6eymrGVE9)。

text: The vegetation in the area surrounding **Darwin** is extremely distinct. It features dark red soil, as well as rich green grass and trees. The tree trunks are typically black.
text_zh: **達爾文**周圍地區的植被非常獨特。它以深紅色土壤、茂盛的綠草和樹木為特色。樹幹通常是黑色的。

text: Tasmania has a **cool temperate** climate which is uncommon in the rest of Australia and is comparable to central-southern Chile or New Zealand. Typical landscape consists of green rolling hills that can look dry in winter coverage. Eucalyptus trees can be seen on the side of roads and on hills in the distance. Rural Tasmania is also quite hilly with dense eucalyptus forests making up the [landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/zcCanmsdVyGkoXY49).
NOTE: Certain areas of Victoria can look similar so make sure to look for other clues.
text_zh: 塔斯馬尼亞擁有澳洲其他地區少見的**涼爽溫帶**氣候，與智利中南部或紐西蘭相當。典型的景觀包含綠色起伏的丘陵，在冬季街景覆蓋中看起來可能較為乾燥。路邊和遠處的山丘上可以看到桉樹。塔斯馬尼亞的鄉村地區丘陵起伏，濃密的桉樹林構成了這裡的[景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/zcCanmsdVyGkoXY49)。
備註：維多利亞州的部分地區看起來可能很相似，因此務必尋找其他線索。

text: The northern QLD city of Cairns is distinct due to its **tropical **vegetation and big green mountains around the city.

NOTE: To differentiate Cairns from other northern Queensland towns, Cairns has many high rise buildings and should feel quite urban. [Divided roads](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9) are also common in downtown Cairns, and only commonly seen in Mackay further south, where it is less tropical and more flat.
text_zh: 昆士蘭北部的城市凱恩斯以其**熱帶 **植被和城市周圍綠意盎然的大山為特色。
註：若要將凱恩斯與昆士蘭北部的其他城鎮區分開來，凱恩斯有許多高樓大廈，都市感相當強。凱恩斯市中心也很常見[分隔道路](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9)，而這種道路只在更南邊的麥凱（Mackay）較為常見，但麥凱的熱帶感較少且地形更為平坦。

text: The area around **Mount Gambier**, SA features white soil and extensive pine tree plantations, making it recognisable.
text_zh: 南澳**甘比爾山**周邊地區具有白色土壤和廣闊的松樹造林地，非常容易辨識。

text: **Kangaroo Island** in South Australia tends to have a distinct look. The vegetation mostly consists of bushes and low, stubby eucalyptus trees with puffy clusters of leaves. The orange soil colour is reminiscent of Western Australia.
In addition, the island only has Generation 2, and [Generation 4](https://goo.gl/maps/hJLoayN4ogUyFonx8) coverage.
text_zh: 南澳的**袋鼠島**通常有獨特的外觀。植被主要由灌木和矮短、樹葉成簇蓬鬆的尤加利樹組成。橘色的土壤顏色讓人聯想到西澳。
此外，該島只有第 2 世代和[第 4 世代](https://goo.gl/maps/hJLoayN4ogUyFonx8)街景覆蓋。

text: The Nullarbor Highway (Latin for “no tree”) can be easily recognized thanks to the flatness, overall grey look and **very low vegetation**.
NOTE: Use the road angle or road lines to determine whether you are on the WA or SA side.
text_zh: 納拉伯公路（Nullarbor Highway，拉丁文意為「無樹」）因地形平坦、整體呈灰色調以及**非常矮小的植被**而很容易辨認。
註：利用道路角度或道路標線來判斷你是在西澳還是南澳這一側。

text: The Stuart Highway from Alice Springs to around Pimba, SA can be easily recognized by its **bright orange** dirt, short trees and blue car Generation 4.
NOTE: Use the road angle and whether there are [rumble strips](https://goo.gl/maps/71LHNi6HTXB6VwCt8) to determine whether you are in NT or SA. Rumble strips are much rarer on the NT side.
text_zh: 從愛麗斯泉到南澳潘巴（Pimba）附近的史都華公路（Stuart Highway）很容易辨認，因為這裡有**鮮橘色**泥土、矮樹和藍色車身的第 4 世代街景。
註：利用道路角度以及是否有[減速條](https://goo.gl/maps/71LHNi6HTXB6VwCt8)來判斷你在北領地還是南澳。北領地一側的減速條要少得多。

text: Streets in Bangladesh are often lined by trees, which sometimes have **white paint** on the bottom of their trunks.
text_zh: 孟加拉的街道兩旁經常種有樹木，樹幹底部有時會刷上**白漆**。

text: While most of Bangladesh is almost completely flat, in the eastern parts of Chittagong you may find fairly tall, forested and uncultivated **hills**.
text_zh: 雖然孟加拉大部分地區幾乎完全平坦，但在 Chittagong 的東部地區，您可能會發現相當高、覆蓋森林且未開墾的**丘陵**。

text: Standalone **fruit trees** in Bangladesh are most commonly seen in the states of Rajshahi and Rangpur.** Fruit orchards** with systematically planted trees, however, are concentrated near the Indian border in both states.
text_zh: 孟加拉的單株**果樹**最常見於 Rajshahi 和 Rangpur 邦。然而，系統化種植的**果園**則集中在這兩個邦靠近印度邊境的地方。

text: **Eucalyptus trees** are** **tall trees with lush crowns and **ivory-coloured trunks**. In Bangladesh they are more common in the north, with** **Rangpur, Rajshahi and Mymensingh being the most likely states.
text_zh: **尤加利樹**是** **樹冠茂密且擁有**象牙色樹幹**的高大樹木。在孟加拉，它們在北部更為常見，** **Rangpur、Rajshahi 和 Mymensingh 是最有可能出現的邦。

text: **Blossoming trees** are tied to coverage and seasonal metas in Bangladesh, and are only found in the states where coverage was taken during spring time - Khulna, Mymensingh and southern Dhaka.
NOTE: Beware that this is only accurate in Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: **開花的樹木**與孟加拉的街景覆蓋與季節性線索特徵相關，僅能在春季拍攝街景覆蓋的邦看到——Khulna、Mymensingh 和 Dhaka 南部。
備註：請注意，這僅在第 4 世代街景覆蓋中準確。

text: **Beach Sheoaks **([Casuarina equisetifolia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Casuarina_equisetifolia)) are thin evergreen trees** **with **thin, long, drooping branchlets. **Like the name suggests, they are mostly observed in coastal regions - along the coast of the Teknaf Peninsula and around Noakhali city in Chittagong.
text_zh: **海濱木麻黃** ([Casuarina equisetifolia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Casuarina_equisetifolia)) 是纖細的常綠樹**，**具有**細長下垂的小枝。**顧名思義，它們主要出現在沿海地區——泰克納夫半島沿岸以及吉大港諾阿卡利市周邊。

text: The Ardennes, located in the southeast part of Belgium, have a very distinct landscape. You can see a lot of **steep hills**, dense **forests, **and **valleys**.
NOTE: The Ardennes extend partially into France, Luxembourg, and Germany.
text_zh: 阿登地區位於比利時東南部，擁有非常獨特的地貌。你可以看到許多**陡峭的山丘**、密集的**森林**與**山谷**。
注意：阿登地區延伸至法國、盧森堡和德國的部分區域。

text: The most typical look of Bermuda is somewhat dense vegetation, consisting of fairly small trees and a lot of bushes, combined with single family houses strewn across the landscape.
text_zh: 百慕達最典型的景色是稍微密集的植被，由相當矮小的樹木和大量灌木組成，並散落著獨棟住宅。

text: The **Altiplano** (“high plain”) is an immense highland plateau that dominates most of western Bolivia. It is covered in grasslands that range from green to arid. Some parts are suitable for [agriculture](https://goo.gl/maps/KmBznqSbPKfSGGBF6), whereas other parts are [extremely dry](https://goo.gl/maps/cr2y2FLrMe2nne7R6). Grass growing in [tufts](https://goo.gl/maps/j7Tb5hpmkUkxZ8Bt6) is common (sometimes referred to as “Bolivian hedgehogs” in the community).
NOTE: While it is generally fairly flat, you will often see [hills and mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/NYUhe5JZvzW1EZTF6) around you. However, as a general rule, the road itself will be mostly flat.
text_zh: **阿爾蒂普拉諾高原**（Altiplano，意為「高平原」）是一座廣袤的高山高原，占據了玻利維亞西部的大部分地區。這裡覆蓋著從綠色到乾旱不等的草原。有些部分適合[農業](https://goo.gl/maps/KmBznqSbPKfSGGBF6)，而其他部分則[極度乾燥](https://goo.gl/maps/cr2y2FLrMe2nne7R6)。成[叢](https://goo.gl/maps/j7Tb5hpmkUkxZ8Bt6)生長的草很常見（社群有時稱之為「玻利維亞刺蝟」）。
註：雖然這裡整體來說相當平坦，但你經常會在四周看到[丘陵與山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/NYUhe5JZvzW1EZTF6)。不過原則上，道路本身大多是平坦的。

text: The grasslands of the Altiplano tend to look more **lush** in the more northern half: the area close to El Alto and La Paz.
NOTE: Due to seasonal coverage, there are some exceptions to this, but in general this is a good rule of thumb to distinguish between the different parts of the Altiplano.
text_zh: 阿爾蒂普拉諾高原的草原在北半部通常看起來更為**生機盎然**：即靠近埃爾阿爾托（El Alto）和拉巴斯（La Paz）的區域。
註：由於季節性街景覆蓋的原因，這點有一些例外，但總體而言，這是區分阿爾蒂普拉諾高原不同區域的好方法。

text: La Paz is a very **hilly** city. Most of La Paz itself is situated in meandering valleys, surrounded by hills that often tend to be covered in **green vegetation** (as opposed to the more dry hillsides found in many other Bolivian urban areas).
text_zh: 拉巴斯是一座非常**多丘陵**的城市。拉巴斯本身的大部分區域位於蜿蜒的山谷中，四周環繞著丘陵，這些丘陵往往覆蓋著**綠色植被**（與玻利維亞許多其他城鎮較乾旱的山坡形成鮮明對比）。

text: Sucre is situated in a very hilly landscape, and as a result you can see many elevation changes in its streets. Uniquely, you can see these **round, tree-covered hills **in many parts of the city.
text_zh: 蘇克雷部位於多丘陵的地形中，因此可以在其街道上看到許多地勢起伏。獨特的是，你在城市的多個區域都能看到這些**被樹木覆蓋的圓形丘陵 **。

text: Potosí is also situated in a very **hilly** landscape, like Sucre. However, its landscape is much more **arid**, with little to no trees atop the hills.
text_zh: 波托西也像蘇克雷一樣部位於非常**多丘陵**的地形中。然而，它的景觀要**乾旱**得多，山頂上幾乎沒有樹木。

text: Ruta 1 west of El Alto is a paved road that runs through green grasslands. The road itself is mostly flat, but you will usually see hills nearby. On the road, you will often see **numbers marked in white paint**.
Near the western end of the road, close to Desaguadero and the border with Peru, you will be able to see Lake Titicaca [to your north](https://goo.gl/maps/36TPhoLYEQC9t3SX8).
NOTE: This road can look very similar to Ruta 2 northwest of El Alto. Road angles can help if you are not sure.
text_zh: 埃爾阿爾托以西的 Ruta 1 是一條穿過綠色草原的鋪設道路。道路本身大多平坦，但你通常會在附近看到丘陵。在路面上，你經常會看到**用白漆標註的數字**。
在這條路的西端附近，靠近 Desaguadero 與秘魯邊境處，你將能在[北方](https://goo.gl/maps/36TPhoLYEQC9t3SX8)看到的的喀喀湖。
註：這條路看起來可能與埃爾阿爾托西北方的 Ruta 2 非常相似。如果不確定，道路角度會有幫助。

text: The N Yungas Road (also popularly known as **Death Road**), is a bendy, small and unpaved road, high up in the mountains east of La Paz. The vegetation is very tropical. The coverage in the southern part of the road is very foggy. True to its unofficial name, this road looks like a very dangerous drive. You can sometimes see some [daring cyclists](https://goo.gl/maps/paLV6Q6yFCrpgxHn7).

NOTE: The northern half of this road looks [less foggy and dangerous](https://goo.gl/maps/qrdtAg2G1jLGSWGP7). However, it should still be recognizable, as it is the only dirt road meandering through jungle hills in Bolivia.
text_zh: 北雲加斯路（N Yungas Road，俗稱**死亡之路**）是一條蜿蜒、狹窄且未鋪設路面的道路，位於拉巴斯以東的高山深處。植被非常具有熱帶特色。該路段南部的街景覆蓋大霧瀰漫。名副其實，這條路看起來開起來非常危險。你時常可以看到一些[大膽的自行車騎士](https://goo.gl/maps/paLV6Q6yFCrpgxHn7)。
註：這條路的北半段看起來[霧氣較少，也沒那麼危險](https://goo.gl/maps/qrdtAg2G1jLGSWGP7)。不過，它仍然應該很容易辨認，因為這是玻利維亞唯一蜿蜒穿過叢林丘陵的泥土路。

text: Around Morochata, northwest of Cochabamba on Ruta 25, there is a small isolated piece of coverage that looks **extremely similar to Peru**. It is a dirt road that meanders through a mountainous landscape. Knowing this road can be extremely helpful for country streak purposes.
The western part of this road is located in a [green mountain landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/XYS5bkYquerLYR4C8), with fields on the mountain slopes and lots of eucalyptus trees around.
Towards the east, it transitions into a more [arid high altitude landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/HSCxmB1jeaQpXrfP6) that still looks very similar to Peru.
text_zh: 在科查班巴西北方 Ruta 25 的 Morochata 周圍，有一小段孤立的街景覆蓋，看起來**極度類似秘魯**。這是一條蜿蜒穿過山區景觀的泥土路。了解這條路對於連勝國家模式非常有幫助。
這條道路的西段位於[綠色山脈景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/XYS5bkYquerLYR4C8)中，山坡上有農田，周圍有許多尤加利樹。
向東延伸，它轉變為更加[乾旱的高海拔景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/HSCxmB1jeaQpXrfP6)，看起來仍然非常像秘魯。

text: The roads around the town of Mataral have recognizable coverage: a **very green, hilly** landscape, and **sunny weather** with only a couple of clouds. While the hills are very green, the vegetation is not very dense, and quite low.

This coverage is limited to Ruta 7 from Comarapa to Mairana, and Ruta 22 to Vallegrande. Other roads in Bolivia with similar vegetation tend to either have different weather (overcast) or terrain (more flat).
text_zh: Mataral 鎮周圍的道路擁有可辨識的街景覆蓋：**非常翠綠、多丘陵的**景觀，以及只有幾朵雲的**晴朗天氣**。雖然丘陵非常翠綠，但植被並不茂密，而且相當矮小。
這段街景覆蓋僅限於從 Comarapa 到 Mairana 的 Ruta 7，以及前往 Vallegrande 的 Ruta 22。玻利維亞其他具有類似植被的道路，要麼天氣不同（陰天），要麼地形不同（更平坦）。

text: In the aforementioned Mataral area, you will often see large **cacti** hiding between the bushes, as well as **trees with yellow flowers**.
text_zh: 在上述的 Mataral 區域，你經常會看到隱藏在灌木叢中的大型**仙人掌**，以及**開著黃花的樹木**。

text: The section of Ruta 4, southwest of Patacamaya, runs through a semi-arid grassland landscape. Many parts of that road between Patacamaya and Callapa have **worn-down grainy asphalt**.
text_zh: Patacamaya 西南方的 Ruta 4 路段穿過半乾旱的草原景觀。Patacamaya 和 Callapa 之間該道路的多個路段擁有**磨損的顆粒狀柏油路面**。

text: Between the villages of Villa Vitalina and Coipasa, there is an isolated stretch of coverage where the Google car drove through **extremely arid** desert terrain. This small road is located close to the southwestern end of Ruta 12, near the Chilean border. It can be hard to spot on the map, because it blends in with the salt flat.

Closer to Villa Vitalina, the car drove over the [salt flat](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9). Closer to Coipasa, the car drove on an unpaved dirt road, where you can see [cone-shaped volcanic hills](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7). In both parts, there is virtually no vegetation.
text_zh: 在 Villa Vitalina 和 Coipasa 村莊之間，有一段孤立的街景覆蓋，Google 車駛過了**極度乾旱的**沙漠地形。這條小路位於 Ruta 12 的西南端附近，靠近智利邊境。在地圖上可能很難注意到，因為它與鹽沼融為一體。
靠近 Villa Vitalina 時，車輛駛過了[鹽沼](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9)。靠近 Coipasa 時，車輛行駛在未鋪設路面的泥土路上，在那裡你可以看到[錐形的火山丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7)。這兩個部分幾乎都沒有植被。

text: The typical Botswana landscape is **dry and mostly flat**, though a limited amount of elevation can be found in certain regions. Common vegetation includes shrubs, small trees, and occasionally dry, golden grasslands. The soil is arid, sandy and ranges in colour from white to red.
NOTE: The border region of South Africa can have a similar landscape.
text_zh: 典型的波札那景觀為**乾燥且大多平坦**，不過在特定區域仍可看到少許地勢起伏。常見的植被包括灌木、矮樹以及偶爾出現的乾枯金色草原。土壤乾旱呈沙質，顏色從白色到紅色不等。
註：南非的邊境地區可能會有類似的景觀。

text: Botswana has many unique and distinct regions throughout the country. This image breaks down the main factors that differentiate each distinctive landscape by soil, vegetation and other clues.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._

RESOURCE: This image was made possible by the invaluable research done by Jasper Woodard. You can check out his [Botswana videos](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FLhEAs1GfI) on his [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@jasperwoodard8134).
text_zh: 波札那全國各地有許多獨特且截然不同的區域。這張圖片透過土壤、植被和其他線索，拆解出區分每個獨特景觀的主要因素。
_點擊圖片可放大。_
資源：這張圖片歸功於 Jasper Woodard 所做的寶貴研究。你可以在他的 [YouTube 頻道](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FLhEAs1GfI) 上查看他的 [波札那影片](https://www.youtube.com/@jasperwoodard8134)。

text: The southeastern region near Gaborone has many **semi-arid hills covered in short shrubs**. If you see a lot of these, you are likely to be in the area between Gaborone and Lobatse.

NOTE: Similar hills can be found elsewhere in the country and across the border in South Africa. If you see a large quantity of them, and use other clues to rule out South Africa, you can be fairly certain that you are in southeastern Botswana.
text_zh: 哈博羅內附近的東南部區域有許多**覆蓋著矮灌木的半乾旱丘陵**。如果你看到很多這種景觀，你很有可能位於哈博羅內與羅巴策之間的區域。
註：在該國其他地方以及南非邊境對面也能找到類似的丘陵。如果你看到大量的此類丘陵，並利用其他線索排除南非，你就能相當確定自己位於波札那東南部。

text: The landscape in the eastern pocket north of Francistown is characterised by **red soil **and a somewhat arid look. The soil in these two areas often looks firm and rocky, rather than sandy or dusty. Trees and bushes with yellowed leaves and other “**autumn**” colours are common. Many trees are bare and withered. You might see fallen leaves on the ground here and there.
text_zh: 法蘭西斯敦以北的東部區域景觀特徵為**紅土**和些許乾旱的外貌。這兩個區域的土壤通常看起來堅硬且多石，而非沙質或多塵。帶有黃葉和其他「**秋天**」色彩的樹木和灌木非常常見。許多樹木皆已枯禿凋零。你可能偶爾會看到地面上的落葉。

text: A large region in the middle western part of the country is characterised by very **white **sandy soil. In addition, the vegetation tends to look **very dry**.
NOTE: Sandy soil can be found in many places in Botswana. This tip specifically refers to the bright white colour of the sand.
text_zh: 該國中西部的大片區域特徵為非常**白色**的沙質土壤。此外，植被往往看起來**非常乾燥**。
註：波札那許多地方都能看到沙質土壤。這個提示特別指的是沙子明亮的白色。

text: The A33 is characterised by a landscape that is more **lush** than usual. Trees have lots of green leaves and the grass is very tall. The more north you go, the more lush the vegetation becomes.
text_zh: A33 的特徵是比平常更為**茂密**的景觀。樹木長滿綠葉，草非常高。越往北走，植被就越茂密。

text: This portion of the A30 has a distinct **autumn** feel unique to it. Notably, there are trees with orange coloured leaves lining the road in straight rows. In addition, there is often tall grass as opposed to other autumn looking locations.
text_zh: A30 的這個路段有一種獨特的**秋天**氛圍。值得注意的是，道路兩旁排列著整齊成行的橘色葉片樹木。此外，與其他看起來像秋天的地點不同，這裡通常長有高草。

text: **Salt pans** can be found in central-eastern Botswana. Dirt road coverage can be found leading to the pans and has similar soil and grass, but you can also find many trees along the road. They are mainly found around the Nwetwe pan. The salt pans show up as lakes on the map.
NOTE: A lot of the dirt road coverage near the pans was taken in June, and will feature trees without leaves or those that are beginning to lose their leaves.
text_zh: **鹽沼**可以在波札那中東部找到。前往鹽沼的泥土路街景覆蓋擁有類似的土壤和草地，但你也會在路邊看到許多樹木。它們主要分佈在 Nwetwe 鹽沼附近。鹽沼在地圖上會顯示為湖泊。
註：鹽沼附近許多泥土路的街景拍攝於 6 月，因此會呈現沒有樹葉或開始落葉的樹木。

text: Just outside Gaborone, there is a lot of coverage along very rural, **small dirt tracks**. They can be identified by the orange-red shade of dirt and abundance of green trees and bushes surrounding the road.
text_zh: 在哈博羅內郊外，非常偏遠的**小泥土路**沿線有許多街景覆蓋。它們可以透過橘紅色的泥土以及道路周圍豐富的綠樹和灌木來辨認。

text: The section of the A33 within the Sibuya Forest Reserve and the CT/3 (Tamafupa) Commercial Wildlife Utilisation is **under construction**. This is most visible by the service road or embankment alongside the road.
NOTE: Despite being in the construction zone, some locations may still look normal.
text_zh: 在 Sibuya 森林保護區和 CT/3 (Tamafupa) 商業野生動物利用區內的 A33 路段**正在施工中**。這在路旁的施工道路或堤防中最為明顯。
註：儘管處於施工區域，某些地點看起來可能依然正常。

text: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by **extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees** surrounding the road. The first section of the road, between Maun and Shorobe, is paved. But that section can still be identified by the trees, faint road markings, and power lines to the west of the road.
text_zh: 從馬烏恩以北通往 Khwai 的大部分未鋪設道路，可透過道路周圍**極為白皙的沙質土壤與高大的綠樹**來辨認。該道路的第一段（馬烏恩與 Shorobe 之間）已鋪設柏油。但該路段仍可透過樹木、模糊的道路標線以及道路西側的電線來辨認。

text: The A20 has mostly **clean, recent asphalt**. Some sections of the road are much **thinner** than usual. The landscape is characterised by red soil, dry grey-coloured trees, and very little grass.
text_zh: A20 大部分鋪有**乾淨且較新的柏油**。該道路的某些路段比平常要**窄**得多。景觀特徵為紅土、乾枯的灰色樹木以及極少的草。

text: Ilha de Fernando de Noronha is a **Brazilian island** with official coverage approximately 340 kilometres northeast of Rio Grande do Norte, and the country itself. It is covered by a white buggy, which is visible at the front. The island is similar in vegetation to the closest part of mainland Brazil, and has large exposed rocks. There is also [boat coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/YGr29mutxGNbnuXL7) around the island.
text_zh: 費爾南多·迪諾羅尼亞島是一座位於北里奧格蘭德州暨巴西本土東北方約 340 公里處且有官方覆蓋的**巴西島嶼**。它是由車頭可見的白色沙灘車覆蓋的。該島的植被與最接近的巴西本土部分相似，並有巨大的裸露岩石。島嶼周圍還有[乘船拍攝覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/YGr29mutxGNbnuXL7)。

text: A large portion of the coverage is taken on sand beaches. You will typically see many palm trees along the beaches.
text_zh: 很大一部分的街景覆蓋是在沙灘上拍攝的。你通常會在海灘沿岸看到許多棕櫚樹。

text: Coastal palm forests also comprise a significant portion of the coverage. They almost exclusively consist of coconut palms.
text_zh: 沿海棕櫚林也佔了街景覆蓋的很大一部分。它們幾乎完全由椰子樹組成。

text: Coin du Mire is a small island with a dark **rocky shore** and a grassy field with **no bushes or palm trees**.
text_zh: Coin du Mire 是一個小島，有著深色的**岩石海岸**和一片**沒有灌木或棕櫚樹**的草地。

text: Conversely, **the northeast** is much more uncultivated: there is less agriculture and more natural vegetation. Some areas are slightly hilly.
text_zh: 相對地，**東北部**大部分未經開墾：農業較少，天然植被較多。部分地區略有丘陵。

text: **The southwest** is the area with the most elevation in Cambodia. This region is characterized by hills and low mountains. Some inland roads feature dense forest cover, but the coastal areas in particular are fairly densely populated.
text_zh: **西南部**是柬埔寨地勢最高的區域。該地區的特徵是丘陵和低山。部分內陸道路有密集的森林覆蓋，但特別是沿海地區人口相當密集。

text: **Rubber tree plantations** are found in three places:
- In a narrow belt northeast of Phnom Penh, mostly centred around the southern sections of Roads 7 and 71
- Around the town of Ban Lung in the far northeast, as well as east of it on and near Road 78.
- Around the town of Pech Sreada. This area has a distinct look. See the tip in the spotlight section.
Rubber trees can be recognized by their thin trunks and dark green crowns. The trees are neatly arranged in rows. They often have small taps near the bottom of the trunk.
