NOTE: Rubber trees are common in Thailand. Only use this clue to region-guess if you are certain that you are in Cambodia, and not to identify the country.
text_zh: **橡膠樹園**出現在三個地方：
- 在金邊東北方的狹長地帶，主要集中在 7 號和 71 號道路的南段周邊
- 在極東北部的邦隆鎮周邊，以及其東側的 78 號道路上與附近。
- 在 Pech Sreada 鎮周邊。這個區域有獨特的外貌。詳見精選章節中的提示。
橡膠樹可以透過細長的樹幹和深綠色的樹冠來辨認。樹木整齊地排列成行。樹幹底部附近通常裝有小集乳嘴。
注意：橡膠樹在泰國很常見。只有在你確定自己身處柬埔寨時，才使用此線索進行區域定位，切勿用來辨識國家。

text: The coverage close to **Phnum Samkos** has a distinct look: overcast weather, and large, prominent mountains that are visible in the distance. The roads are unpaved and consist of brown soil. Wild, very green vegetation can be seen all around you.
text_zh: **菩薩山**附近的街景有著獨特的外觀：陰天，遠處可見巨大而顯著的山脈。道路是未鋪柏裝的泥土路，呈棕色。四周可以看到野生且非常翠綠的植被。

text: **Oil palm plantations** can only be found on Road 4, as well as some of its rural offroads, just north of Preah Nob.
NOTE: Oil palm plantations are much more common in Malaysia and Indonesia. Only use this clue to region-guess if you are certain that you are in Cambodia, and not to identify the country.
text_zh: **油棕園**僅出現在 Preah Nob 正北方的 4 號道路以及其部分鄉村岔路上。
注意：油棕園在馬來西亞和印尼更常見。只有在你確定自己身處柬埔寨時，才使用此線索進行區域定位，切勿用來辨識國家。

text: **Preah Monivong National Park** in the south of the country has a unique and recognizable landscape. It is situated on a highland plateau. The soil is white and very rocky. The vegetation consists of stunted, windswept bushes and low trees. The foliage has a distinct dark green tint that contrasts with the white rocks. Some parts of the park are [more forested](https://goo.gl/maps/o8jNzth6g1aK3woh7) but will still have the same rocky soil.
text_zh: 該國南部的**波哥國家公園（Preah Monivong National Park）**擁有獨特且易於辨認的景觀。它位於高地高原上。土壤呈白色且多石。植被由矮小且受風吹侵蝕的灌木與矮樹組成。樹葉帶有獨特的深綠色調，與白石形成鮮明對比。國家公園的某些部分[森林較茂密](https://goo.gl/maps/o8jNzth6g1aK3woh7)，但依然擁有相同的多石土壤。

text: Most of the **northern section of Road 76**, between Lumphat and Mayura Wild Park, is recognizable too: it is a wide, unpaved road, with brown soil, and a semi-open jungle forest all around you.
Weather conditions start off as overcast on the southern end of the road, and quickly improve the further north you go, with almost completely clear skies on the northern end.
NOTE: There are other, smaller roads that can look similar. However, this road is by far the longest that has this distinct look.
text_zh: Lumphat 與 Mayura Wild Park 之間的 **76 號道路北段**大部分也很好辨認：這是一條寬闊的未鋪設道路，帶有棕土，周圍是半開放的叢林森林。
天氣狀況在道路南端為陰天，越往北走改善得越快，到了北端幾乎是晴空萬里。
注意：還有其他較小的道路看起來很像。不過，這條道路是目前為止具有這種獨特外貌最長的一條。

text: Around the town of **Pech Sreada**, in the far east of Cambodia, you can find rubber tree plantations that were covered during the dry season, leading to a distinct look. In addition, the soil is very orange, making it easy to distinguish this area from other regions in Cambodia with rubber tree plantations.
text_zh: 在柬埔寨遠東的 **Pech Sreada** 城鎮周邊，你可以找到在乾季期間被拍攝的橡膠樹園，因而呈現出獨特的外觀。此外，土壤非常橘，這使得該地區很容易與柬埔寨其他有橡膠樹園的地區區分開來。

text: The **Dempster Highway** (road numbers 5 and 8) connects the Klondike Highway (road number 2) in Yukon with the remote town of Inuvik in the Northwest Territories.

It is very recognizable: it is an unpaved road with Generation 2 coverage, **dark brown** soil, and a tundra landscape with **short trees**. It is mostly hilly and mountainous, but the section between Fort McPherson and Inuvik is flat. Closer to Inuvik, the weather gets cloudy.
text_zh: **鄧普斯特公路**（5 號與 8 號公路）連接育空的克朗代克公路（2 號公路）與西北地區偏遠的因奴維克鎮。
它非常容易辨認：是一條未鋪設泥土路，具有 Generation 2 街景覆蓋、**深褐色**土壤，以及帶有**矮樹**的苔原景觀。地形大多為丘陵與山地，但麥克弗森堡與因奴維克之間的路段平坦。越靠近因奴維克，天氣就越陰沉。

text: The AB-93 highway through Banff and Jasper National Park features distinct, gradual, and steep mountains with a **sharp **peak on either side of the road. Tall, somewhat thin trees can also be seen.
text_zh: 穿過班夫與賈斯珀國家公園的 AB-93 公路特色是道路兩側都有陡峭、山勢漸升且具有**尖銳**山峰的山脈。也可以看到高大但稍微纖細的樹木。

text: The **Trans-Labrador Highway** (road numbers 500 and 510) is a recognizable road, covered by Generation 4, mostly during sunny weather conditions. Thin pine** **trees line the side of the road, and it has a remote, cold, and northern feel. On many parts of the road, the sun is low in the sky. In addition, when the car drives past the city of **Happy Valley-Goose Bay**, it is common to see [snow on the ground](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78).
text_zh: **橫拉布拉多公路**（500 號與 510 號公路）是一條特徵鮮明的道路，由 Generation 4 拍攝，大多處於晴朗天氣。道路兩側排列著纖細的松** **樹，帶有一種偏遠、寒冷且偏北的感覺。在該公路的許多路段，太陽仰角都很低。此外，當車輛開過**歡喜谷-鵝灣**市時，常見到[地面上有積雪](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78)。

text: The inland roads of the **Gaspé Peninsula** feature densely forested mountainous terrain. It is particularly common to encounter **overcast **coverage in this region.
text_zh: **加斯佩半島**的內陸道路以森林密佈的山地地形為特色。在這個區域特別容易遇到**陰天**的街景覆蓋。

text: The **Cape Breton Highlands** in northeastern Nova Scotia have an unusual amount of elevation for Eastern Canadian standards. It is very forested, with a mix of broad-leaf trees and pine trees.
text_zh: 新斯科細亞省東北部的**布雷頓角高地**（Cape Breton Highlands）以東加拿大標準來看，有著異常起伏的地形。這裡森林茂密，生長著闊葉林與松樹的混合林。

text: **Route 430 **on Newfoundland runs in a roughly south-southwest to north-northeast direction, with the road lines slightly washed out. It is located in a remote and sparsely populated part of the island. On many sections of the road, the coast is visible to your west. To your east, you will usually see low **balsam fir** forests, and occasionally an imposing [wall of mountains](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) in the far distance.
text_zh: 紐芬蘭島上的**430號公路**（Route 430）大致呈南南西至北北東走向，道路標線稍微有些褪色。它位於該島偏遠且人口稀疏的地區。在這條路的許多路段，往西可以看見海岸。往東通常會看到低矮的**膠冷杉**（balsam fir）森林，遠處偶爾還能看到壯觀的[山牆](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)。

text: Kangiqsualujjuaq is a town in northern Québec, surrounded by **green rocky hills**, with trees visible in the distance.
text_zh: 康吉蘇阿盧朱阿克是魁北克北部的城鎮，被**綠色的岩石丘陵**環繞，遠處可以看到樹木。

text: Nain is a small town on the Northeastern coast of Labrador. The town features **colourful wooden houses**, and **trees **in and around the town. To the north, a [big hill](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7) is usually visible. And to the south, [rocky cliffs](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6) can be seen on the other side of the bay. Additionally, kids can sometimes be seen walking beside the trekker.
text_zh: 內恩（Nain）是拉布拉多東北海岸的小鎮。該鎮的特色是**色彩繽紛的木屋**，且鎮內及周邊有**樹木**。朝北通常可以看到[大山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7)。朝南則可以在海灣對岸看到[岩石峭壁](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6)。此外，有時候可以看到小孩走在跟拍車旁邊。

text: The **northernmost Google Street View coverage in the world** is a trekker on Ellesmere Island in northern Nunavut. It shows a glacier in a rocky, desolate landscape that is devoid of any vegetation.

NOTE: This coverage is sometimes used in maps to improve and standardise the scoring range. As a result, you might encounter this trekker in competitive maps like ACW, despite it not being pinpointable.
text_zh: **全世界最北的 Google 街景覆蓋**是位於努納福特北部埃爾斯米爾島（Ellesmere Island）上的徒步拍攝街景。它展示了荒涼岩石景觀中的冰川，該處完全沒有任何植被。
注意：這種街景有時會被地圖拿來改善並標準化評分範圍。因此，儘管它無法精確定位，你還是可能會在 ACW 等競技地圖中遇到這個徒步拍攝街景。

text: Shown here is a **Köppen climate map** of Chile.
Chile is a long and narrow country that spans more than 4,000 kilometres from north to south, meaning that its climate varies significantly due to latitude.

The northern parts of the country, which lie in the tropical zone, are dry and arid, leading to a mild desert climate. In the centre, around the capital, the climate becomes less arid, leading to a temperate mediterranean climate. In the southernmost regions of Chile, which lie in the subantarctic zone, the climate is cold and wet, leading to a cool oceanic climate.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 此處顯示的是智利的**柯本氣候分類圖**（Köppen climate map）。
智利是一個狹長的國家，南北跨度超過 4,000 公里，這意味著其氣候會因緯度而有顯著差異。
該國北部位於熱帶地區，乾燥而乾旱，形成溫和的沙漠氣候。在中部首都周邊，氣候較不乾旱，形成溫和的地中海型氣候。在智利最南端的次南極帶地區，氣候寒冷潮濕，形成涼爽的海洋性氣候。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The Atacama is an extremely arid desert covering the northern third of Chile. Some parts of it experience the lowest rainfall on the planet. As a result, many locations in this desert are almost completely devoid of any vegetation: you will often just see sand and bare rock without any plants in sight anywhere.
NOTE: The Atacama Desert also covers parts of southern Peru, western Bolivia and northwestern Argentina.
text_zh: 阿塔卡馬（Atacama）是極度乾旱的沙漠，涵蓋智利北部三分之一的土地。其中某些地區經歷了地球上最低的降雨量。因此，這座沙漠中的許多地方幾乎完全沒有任何植被：你經常只會看到沙子和裸露的岩石，放眼望去看不到任何植物。
注意：阿塔卡馬沙漠也涵蓋秘魯南部、玻利維亞西部和阿根廷西北部的一部分。

text: The region around Santiago can be recognized by its semi-arid climate, having **dry hills** and scattered vegetation.
text_zh: 聖地牙哥周邊地區可以透過其半乾旱氣候來辨認，擁有**乾燥山丘**和零星的植被。

text: **Narrow roads** with trees on both sides can commonly be seen in the regions of Bio Bio and Araucania.
text_zh: 兩側有樹木的**狹窄道路**常見於 Bio Bio 和阿勞卡尼亞大區。

text: Southern Aysén can be recognised by **autumn coverage**, having orange and red coloured vegetation. Keep in mind that not all coverage in this region will have fall colours.
text_zh: 艾森南部可以透過**秋季街景覆蓋**來辨認，擁有橘色和紅色的植被。請記住，並非此地區的所有街景覆蓋都有秋季色彩。

text: Part of Ruta 41 is located in a valley, with **snowy** mountains seen in the distance. Many trees and vineyards can commonly be seen toward the west. Triple yellow lines can also be seen from [this point](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5).
text_zh: 41 號公路（Ruta 41）的一部分位於山谷中，遠處可以看到**積雪的**山脈。向西常可見到許多樹木和葡萄園。從 [這個點](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5) 還可以看到三黃線。

text: The northern section of Pampa del Tamarugal National Reserve can be recognized by the **Tamarugo trees** lining the road. The road itself is mediocre quality, and in a consistent north-west direction.
text_zh: 帕馬德爾塔馬魯加爾國家保護區（Pampa del Tamarugal National Reserve）的北部可以透過路邊排列的**塔馬魯戈樹**來辨認。道路本身的品質一般，且方向一致朝西北方。

text: Llanos de Challe National Park can be recognized by the **brown** coloured dirt on the roadside, patches of light sand, **juniper** plants, and dark coloured mountains. The sky is overcast in most of the coverage.
NOTE: [Pan de Azúcar National Park](https://goo.gl/maps/QyUDrkEedZ29m21G8) looks similar, however has less vegetation.
text_zh: 亞諾斯德查爾雷國家公園（Llanos de Challe National Park）可以透過路邊**褐色**的泥土、零星的淺色沙地、**杜松**植物以及深色的山脈來辨認。大部分街景覆蓋的天空都是陰天。
注意：[潘德阿蘇卡國家公園](https://goo.gl/maps/QyUDrkEedZ29m21G8) 看起來類似，但植被較少。

text: A **vast**, mostly treeless landscape combined with triple yellow lines are seen in Alto Bio Bio National Reserve. While the reserve may look dry, there is a distinct cold and **high altitude** feel. [Monkey puzzles](https://goo.gl/maps/j5q5VVZamhkFDLSQ6) are also seen toward the east.
NOTE: Ruta 181 leading up to the reserve also has triple yellow lines, however, is less vast with more vegetation.
text_zh: 阿爾托比奧比奧國家保護區（Alto Bio Bio National Reserve）中可以看到**廣闊**、幾乎沒有樹木的景觀結合三黃線。雖然保護區看起來可能很乾燥，但有一種明顯寒冷和**高海拔**的感覺。向東也可以看到 [智利南洋杉](https://goo.gl/maps/j5q5VVZamhkFDLSQ6)。
注意：通往該保護區的 181 號公路（Ruta 181）也有三黃線，然而範圍較不廣闊且植被較多。

text: Puyehue National Park can be recognized by the dense vegetation surrounding the road. The pavement itself has triple yellow lines, and **tar snakes** are frequently seen. In the east, many [**dead trees**](https://goo.gl/maps/vvvheTYM3U7XohwK9) can be seen with a lack of leaves.
text_zh: 普耶胡埃國家公園（Puyehue National Park）可以透過環繞道路的茂密植被來辨認。路面本身有三黃線，並且經常可以看到**補路瀝青（tar snakes）**。在東部，可以看到許多缺少樹葉的 [**枯樹**](https://goo.gl/maps/vvvheTYM3U7XohwK9)。

text: Most of Christmas Island is covered by dense **tropical forest**. Some unpaved roads feature bright, white sandy soil. A small part of the coverage is in built-up areas. And in some places, [palms](https://goo.gl/maps/wzh7z1FVTpBp32RM6) can be seen.
text_zh: 聖誕島大部分地區都被茂密的**熱帶森林**覆蓋。有些未鋪裝道路帶有明亮的白色沙質土壤。一小部分覆蓋位於人口稠密區。在某些地方，可以看到[棕櫚樹](https://goo.gl/maps/wzh7z1FVTpBp32RM6)。

text: The **built-up areas** are in the northeast. The rest of the island is mostly covered by dense forest.
text_zh: **人口稠密區**位於東北部。島上的其餘地區大多被茂密的森林覆蓋。

text: The general landscape consists of **bright white sand**, **many palms** and mowed grass. Cocos Islands is significantly less forested or hilly compared to Christmas Island.
text_zh: 整體景觀由**明亮的白沙**、**許多棕櫚樹**與修剪過的草皮組成。與聖誕島相比，科科斯群島的森林或丘陵少得多。

text: The inland trekker on Pulau Luar (Horsburgh Island) can be recognized by the **dry**, yellow grass, and more **sparse** vegetation.
text_zh: 盧阿爾島（Pulau Luar，即霍斯堡島 Horsburgh Island）的內陸徒步拍攝可以透過**乾燥**的黃草以及更**稀疏**的植被來識別。

text: East of the Andes lies a **vast lowland** called Llanos. It is characterised by open tropical grasslands, savannas with scattered trees, small areas of forest and seasonal flooding.
text_zh: 安地斯山脈以東坐落著一個稱為亞平斯平原（Llanos）的**廣闊低地**。其特徵為開闊的熱帶草原、散落著樹木的疏林草原、小面積森林以及季節性氾濫。

text: This landscape is typical of the far Northern province of La Guajira: **extreme dryness**, low vegetation and occasional cacti.
In addition, you can often recognise the Uribia-Puerto Bolivar road because of this landscape, the straightness and the train track always present to the East.
text_zh: 這種地貌是極北省份拉瓜希拉省的典型特徵：**極度乾旱**、植被稀疏且偶有仙人掌。
此外，你經常可以透過這種地景、筆直的道路，以及東側始終陪伴的鐵軌，來認出烏里比亞－波利瓦爾港（Uribia-Puerto Bolivar）公路。

text: The majority of **oil palm** plantations are found along the coast in Puntarenas province. A few smaller plantations are located in Limón province.
NOTE: A few oil palms can be found here and there throughout the country, especially on the east coast but they’re not part of any plantations.
text_zh: 大多數的**油棕**種植園都在蓬塔雷納斯省的沿海一帶找到。一些較小的種植園位於利蒙省。
注意：全國各地偶爾可以找到一些油棕，特別是在東海岸，但它們不屬於任何種植園。

text: **Guanacaste trees **can be recognised by their thick trunk and characteristically large, umbrella-shaped crown. They are mostly seen in the eponymous Guanacaste province.
text_zh: **象耳豆樹**（Guanacaste trees）可以透過其粗壯的樹幹和具有代表性的大型傘狀樹冠來識別。它們大多見於同名的瓜納卡斯特省。

text: Simple fences made of irregular wooden branches or logs are found all over Costa Rica but much more prevalent in the west, compared to the planted tree rows or spiked concrete variants more common elsewhere.
text_zh: 由不規則木枝或原木製成的簡單柵欄在哥斯大黎加各地都能找到，但在西部更為盛行，相較於其他地方更常見的種植樹籬或帶刺混凝土變體。

text: Another major divided highway is the RN 32 from the intersection with RN 4 to Limón on the Caribbean coast. The road passes through lush forests in the generally flat Northern lowlands.
NOTE: Aside from the stretch of the RN 1 with concrete pavement, all other major divided highways are in close proximity to San José.
text_zh: 另一條主要的分隔高速公路是從與 4 號國道交叉口通往加勒比海岸利蒙的 32 號國道。該道路穿過大致平坦的北方低地中的茂密森林。
注意：除了鋪有混凝土的 1 號國道路段外，所有其他主要的分隔高速公路都緊鄰聖荷西。

text: **Beach trekkers** are mostly found on the northern west coast, but can also be found [west of San José](https://maps.app.goo.gl/W1ft4gW7uTFt9zG3A#extra%5Btags%5D=Beach&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) and on [Cocos Island](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gHZvJaSJNKVMQfFL6#extra%5Btags%5D=Cocos+Forest&extra%5Btags%5D=Beach&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng).
text_zh: **海灘徒步拍攝**主要分佈在北部西海岸，但在[聖荷西西方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/W1ft4gW7uTFt9zG3A#extra%5Btags%5D=Beach&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)與[可可島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gHZvJaSJNKVMQfFL6#extra%5Btags%5D=Cocos+Forest&extra%5Btags%5D=Beach&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)上也能找到。

text: Most rural **forest trekkers** are found in central Costa Rica. [Cocos Island](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cFS241KcJxpjsFP87#extra%5Btags%5D=Cocos+Forest&extra%5Btags%5D=forest&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) also mainly consists of dense tropical forests.
text_zh: 大多數鄉村**森林徒步拍攝**都位於哥斯大黎加中部。[可可島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cFS241KcJxpjsFP87#extra%5Btags%5D=Cocos+Forest&extra%5Btags%5D=forest&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)也主要由茂密的熱帶森林組成。

text: In Centro Recreativo Bosque de la Hoja, just east of San José de la Montaña, you can see the trekker being followed by **three dogs** through a pine forest.
text_zh: 在位於聖荷西德拉蒙塔尼亞（San José de la Montaña）東側的波斯克德拉霍哈休閒中心（Centro Recreativo Bosque de la Hoja），你可以看到徒步拍攝穿過一片松樹林，身後跟著**三隻狗**。

text: Another quirk of Generation 3 coverage is that the majority of it was made in **autumn**. This means that the vegetation in this coverage will often have distinct yellowish or orange fall colours.
Take note that this seasonal meta is not found in Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: 第 3 代覆蓋的另一個奇特之處在於，其大部分拍攝於**秋天**。這意味著此覆蓋範圍內的植被通常會呈現明顯偏黃或偏橘的秋季色彩。
請注意，這種季節性線索特徵在第四代街景覆蓋中並不存在。

text: The Adriatic coast features **rocky **mountains similar to those seen in Montenegro or Albania. Shrubs are more common instead of trees along the coast, especially in the south. This coastal region has a lot of islands and peninsulas.
text_zh: 亞得里亞海沿岸有著類似蒙特內哥羅或阿爾巴尼亞的**岩石**山脈。沿海地區的樹木較少、灌木叢較普遍，尤其是南部。這個沿海地區有許多島嶼和半島。

text: These tall **cypress trees** are commonly found near the southern tip of Croatia.
text_zh: 這些高大的**柏樹**常見於克羅埃西亞的最南端。

text: The island has a Mediterranean landscape, with bright exposed rock, olive trees, palm trees, cypress trees, and green coastal farmland. The interior consists of pine forests in the mountains.
text_zh: 這座島嶼擁有地中海景觀，有明亮的裸露岩石、橄欖樹、棕櫚樹、柏樹以及翠綠的沿海農田。內陸山區則是由松樹林組成。

text: **Dark red fields**, even if covered in vegetation, are a good clue for northern Cyprus and Famagusta, the far eastern region.
text_zh: **深紅色農田**，即使被植被覆蓋，也是判斷賽普勒斯北部以及最東邊區域法馬古斯塔（Famagusta）的好線索。

text: The wind turbines in the SW are located within the Oreites Forest, a shrubby hill surrounded by more extreme elevation. There is a noticeable incline towards the coast, which is often visible to the southwest.
text_zh: 西南方的風力發電機位於奧賴特斯森林（Oreites Forest）內，這是一座灌木叢生的山丘，周圍有著更極端的高低起伏。往海岸方向有明顯的坡度，從西南方通常看得見。

text: This type of landscape is found on the outskirts of Santo Domingo. It is characterised by narrow dirt tracks, whitish dirt, **dried green shrubbery** and debris next to the road.
text_zh: 這種地景見於聖多明哥的郊區。其特徵是狹窄的土路、白色的泥土、路旁的**枯綠灌木叢**和雜物。

text: The **Amazon** area is very distinct. It is fairly flat, and contains many of these trees with white bark (Cordia trichotoma), and oil palms.
The vast majority of the coverage notably uses the rarer “high antenna”.
text_zh: **亞馬遜**地區非常獨特。它相當平坦，且有許多這種白樹皮的樹木（Cordia trichotoma）以及油棕。
絕大多數的街景覆蓋顯著使用了較少見的「高天線」。

text: The province of Chimborazo is semi-arid, and has an abundance of **pine trees**.
text_zh: 欽博拉索省（Chimborazo）屬於半乾旱氣候，並有大量的**松樹**。

text: [The Galapagos Islands](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Gal%C3%A1pagos+Islands/@-0.383106,-90.4233344,8z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x9021d9b43bec07cd:0xfb3e68fef05dae23!8m2!3d-0.383106!4d-90.4233344!16zL20vMDE2empq?entry=ttu) are an archipelago located west of mainland Ecuador. There are only **trekkers** and **boat coverage** on and around the islands. There is a wide variety of landscapes, including volcanic soil, low shrubbery, and craters (with Galapagos turtles onlooking).
text_zh: [加拉巴哥群島](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Gal%C3%A1pagos+Islands/@-0.383106,-90.4233344,8z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x9021d9b43bec07cd:0xfb3e68fef05dae23!8m2!3d-0.383106!4d-90.4233344!16zL20vMDE2empq?entry=ttu)是位於厄瓜多本土西側的群島。島上及周邊只有**徒步拍攝**與**船隻街景覆蓋**。這裡有各種不同的地貌，包括火山土壤、低矮灌木叢以及火山口（有加拉巴哥象龜在旁觀看）。

text: The Djoser pyramid, which can be recognised by the **stair-like sections** combined with the scaffolding surrounding it, is located south of Cairo. You can also find some other minor historical [excavation sites](https://goo.gl/maps/7BqQiweSuJNymHtk9) and some plain [desert coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/rGjL8b1VSXDGGyck7).
text_zh: 左塞爾金字塔（Djoser pyramid）位於開羅南部，其特徵是**階梯狀的結構**結合了周圍的鷹架。你也可以找到其他較小的歷史[發掘遺址](https://goo.gl/maps/7BqQiweSuJNymHtk9)以及一些平坦的[沙漠街景](https://goo.gl/maps/rGjL8b1VSXDGGyck7)。

text: Montane grasslands with **long golden grass** and a mountainous landscape are typical of Western Eswatini.
NOTE: Long grass can be found in almost all areas of Eswatini. This clue refers specifically to the pristine golden colour most commonly seen in the Western highlands.
text_zh: 具有**金色長草**的山地草原與山地景觀是西史瓦帝尼的典型特徵。
注意：長草幾乎可以在史瓦帝尼的所有地區找到。這個線索特別指的是西部高地最常見的原始金色。

text: **Pine tree plantations** are found in select areas in the West of the country.
NOTE: Similar plantations can also be found in South Africa.
text_zh: **松樹人工林**出現在該國西部的特定區域。
注意：類似的人工林也可以在南非找到。

text: You can recognise the **Mlawula Nature Reserve** thanks to the narrow dirt tracks, tall grass and overall savannah landscape.
text_zh: 你可以透過狹窄的泥土小徑、高高的草叢和整體的疏林草原景觀，來認出**姆拉武拉自然保護區（Mlawula Nature Reserve）**。

text: The Faroe islands have **almost** **no naturally growing** trees.
text_zh: 法羅群島**幾乎沒有自然生長**的樹木。

text: Most of Finland is covered by dense **boreal forests**. Pine trees are common, as well as birches, which are easily recognizable by their white trunks.
text_zh: 芬蘭大部分地區被密集的**北方針葉林**覆蓋。松樹很常見，樺樹也很普遍，其白色的樹幹非常容易辨認。

text: A lot of **Generation 3** coverage was taken in **autumn**, meaning that trees in this coverage often have distinct fall colours.

NOTE: This is significantly less common in Generation 3 coverage in the other Nordics. This means that when you are faced with a tough decision between countries, a fall vibe can be a good clue for Finland.
Take note that this season meta is not present in Generation 2 and Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: 許多 **第 3 代** 覆蓋是在**秋天**拍攝的，這意味著此覆蓋範圍內的樹木通常具有明顯的秋季色彩。
註記：這在其他北歐國家的第三代街景中相當少見。這意味著當你在不同國家之間難以抉擇時，秋天的氛圍可以作為芬蘭的一個好線索。
請注意，這種季節特徵在第二代和第四代街景中並不存在。

text: **Small, stunted trees** with spindly, thin trunks are common in northern Finland.
text_zh: 長著纖細薄樹幹的**小型侏儒樹**在芬蘭北部很常見。

text: **Road 970** in the far north, on the border with Norway, is easily recognizable: it runs through a river valley with hills on both sides. The river is visible in many places, usually to the northwest. The birch trees around the road are small and stunted.
NOTE: The Generation 3 coverage on this road was taken in the autumn, meaning that the vegetation looks dead and mostly devoid of leaves.
text_zh: 位於最北端、與挪威邊境交界處的 **970 號公路**非常容易辨認：它穿過一條兩側都是山丘的河谷。河流在許多地方清晰可見，通常在西北方向。道路周圍的樺樹又小又矮。
註記：這條路上的第三代街景是在秋天拍攝的，這意味著植被看起來枯萎且大部分沒有葉子。

text: Due to its proximity to the Scandinavian Mountains, the area near Kilpisjärvi features a unique **hilly **landscape, with** low vegetation**.
NOTE: [The Generation 2 coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/32NoQ1mRjDmu5CsUA) on this road was taken during Spring, so the vegetation looks dead.
text_zh: 由於鄰近斯堪地那維亞山脈，基爾皮斯耶爾維附近的地區擁有獨特的**丘陵**地貌，並伴隨**低矮植被**。
注意：這條道路上的[第二代相機覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/32NoQ1mRjDmu5CsUA)是在春天拍攝的，因此植被看起來像是枯萎的。

text: You can spot trees that are painted white close to the bottom of the trunk in the northeast.
NOTE: You will rarely find them outside the shaded region.
text_zh: 你可以在東北部發現樹幹底部附近被漆成白色的樹木。
註記：你在陰影區域之外很少能找到它們。

text: Many trees in Brandenburg and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern have these **tiny green markers** on them. You can very rarely find them in Lower Saxony.
text_zh: 布蘭登堡和梅克倫堡-西波美拉尼亞的許多樹木上都有這些**微小的綠色標記**。你在下薩克森極少數情況下才能找到它們。

text: The [**shrub** and **sand** covered hills](https://goo.gl/maps/S5iYEBFRs4prPQ5M8) are unique to the island of Sylt. And like the rest of the North Frisian Islands, rock walls, brick houses, and thatched roofs are common.
NOTE: Some parts of Sylt look [more generic](https://goo.gl/maps/YQfwxNwtUKZtoGYV9), but still very flat.
text_zh: 這些[覆蓋著**灌木**與**沙子**的山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/S5iYEBFRs4prPQ5M8)是敘爾特島（Sylt）特有的景觀。就像北弗里斯蘭群島（North Frisian Islands）的其他地方一樣，石牆、磚造房屋和茅草屋頂十分常見。
註：敘爾特島的一些地區看起來[比較大眾化](https://goo.gl/maps/YQfwxNwtUKZtoGYV9)，但地形依然非常平坦。

text: Ghana is mostly flat with **red soil**, however hills and mountains can be seen in some regions. **Tropical **vegetation is very common, and palms are common especially toward the south.
text_zh: 迦納的地形大多平坦且有著**紅色土壤**，但在某些地區可以看到丘陵和山脈。**熱帶**植被非常普遍，棕櫚樹也很常見，特別是在南部地區。

text: Northern Ghana features a **savannah** landscape, which can be identified by its dry soil and less dense vegetation.
text_zh: 迦納北部具有**熱帶草原**景觀，其特徵是乾燥的土壤和較稀疏的植被。

text: **Dense forests** in Ghana are typically found in the southwest and east. You will usually see many naturally occurring palm** **trees, making the two regions recognizable.
text_zh: 迦納的**茂密森林**通常分佈在西南部和東部。你通常會看到許多自然生長的棕櫚**樹**，這使得這兩個地區極具辨識度。

text: **Tall palm trees** are commonly found** **along the coast. Most of them are located in the west.
text_zh: **高大的棕櫚樹**常見於**沿海地區**。它們大多位於西部。

text: Most **unpaved roads** in a **dry savannah** landscape are found north of Wa, as well as near the town itself.
NOTE: The other unpaved roads in northern Ghana are the Yendi-Nkwanta road in the east, and part of the Salaga-Tamale road, which has very distinct soil. See the tips below.
text_zh: **乾燥熱帶草原**景觀中的大多數**未鋪面道路**都位於瓦鎮（Wa）以北，以及該城鎮本身附近。
註：迦納北部的其他未鋪面道路包括東部的延迪-恩寬塔（Yendi-Nkwanta）公路，以及薩拉加-塔馬利（Salaga-Tamale）公路的一部分，該路段具有非常獨特的土壤。請參閱下方的提示。

text: The road connecting the town of Sawla with the N10 has very crisp,** new road lines**. Most of the road runs in a general east-west direction, through a lush savannah landscape. The middle line can be solid or dashed.
NOTE: There are a couple of other roads with crisp road lines like these, however these tend to have a different road angle or landscape.
text_zh: 連接索瓦鎮（Sawla）和 N10 公路的道路有非常清晰的**新道路標線**。這條路大致呈東西走向，穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。中間的標線可以是實線或虛線。
註：還有其他幾條道路也有像這樣清晰的道路標線，但這些道路通常有不同的道路角度或景觀。

text: The Salaga-Tamale road up to Kpalbusi is a dirt road with very moody **overcast **coverage. The soil tends to be **very dark**, with a purple or brown** **tinge to it. The road also has a unique tropical savannah feel. The soil is most dark near the town of Salaga.
NOTE: Unpaved roads with overcast coverage and a savannah landscape can be found in other places. The unique aspect of this road is the dark purplish brown soil and the especially dark cloud cover.
text_zh: 通往克帕爾布西（Kpalbusi）的薩拉加-塔馬利公路是一條泥土路，有著非常陰暗的**陰天**街景覆蓋。土壤往往**非常黑暗**，帶有紫色或棕色的**色調**。這條路也帶有獨特的熱帶草原風情。土壤在薩拉加鎮附近最黑。
註：帶有陰天街景覆蓋和熱帶草原景觀的未鋪面道路在其他地方也能找到。這條路的獨特之處在於其帶有紫褐色的土壤以及特別陰暗的雲層覆蓋。

text: The road between Nkwanta and Domanko is **unpaved**, with a **powerline** close to the road to your east or northeast. The road itself runs in a general SE-NW direction, through a lush savannah landscape that is typical of central Ghana.

NOTE: In urban areas, there can be a powerline on both sides of the road. In addition, a section of the Salaga-Tamale road has a powerline to the east as well, but the darker soil and moody cloud cover makes it distinguishable.
text_zh: 恩寬塔（Nkwanta）和多曼科（Domanko）之間的道路是**未鋪面道路**，道路東側或東北側緊鄰著**高壓電線**。道路本身大致呈東南-西北走向，穿過迦納中部典型的鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。
註：在市區，道路兩側都可能設有高壓電線。此外，薩拉加-塔馬利公路的一段路東側也有高壓電線，但較暗的土壤和陰沉的雲層覆蓋使其得以區分。

text: The coastal area just **east of Accra**, especially on the N1, has a distinct landscape: it is very flat and wide open, with significantly less vegetation than the rest of southern Ghana. Some parts can look somewhat dry.
text_zh: **阿克拉以東**的沿海地區，特別是在 N1 公路上，有著獨特的景觀：地勢非常平坦且開闊，植被比迦納南部其他地區明顯少得多。有些部分看起來可能有點乾燥。

text: The section of the N1 road near the border town of Elubo is **very new**: it has dark and unblemished asphalt, a very crisp-looking middle line, and no outer lines. The vegetation is dense and occasionally features palm trees.
NOTE: This new road surface continues until the town of Azuleti. The middle line can be dashed or solid. Near Azuleti, the road does not have a middle line.
text_zh: 靠近邊境城鎮埃盧博（Elubo）的 N1 公路段**非常新**：它有著黑暗且無瑕疵的柏油路面、看起來非常清晰的中間標線，且沒有外側標線。植被茂密，偶爾夾雜著棕櫚樹。
註：這段新的路面一直延伸到阿祖萊蒂（Azuleti）鎮。中間標線可以是虛線或實線。靠近阿祖萊蒂時，道路沒有中間標線。

text: The Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary has a unique Google car. The ‘Ghana tape’ and roof rack will **not **be visible however, the **black right side mirror** will be slightly visible just outside the blur.
NOTE: The red soil and surrounding vegetation should still be good clues for the country, despite the lack of the typical car meta associated with Ghana.
text_zh: 波本費馬猴子保護區（Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary）有一台獨特的 Google 車。「迦納膠帶」和車頂架將**不會**被看到，不過**黑色右側後視鏡**會在馬賽克外圍微微露出。
註：儘管缺乏與迦納相關的典型車輛特徵，但紅色的土壤和周圍的植被仍然是該國很好的線索。

text: On many of the central islands you can find a very **barren landscape**, with small bushes and no trees in sight. This tends to be more common on the smaller islands with coverage.
text_zh: 在許多中部島嶼上，你可以看到非常**貧瘠的景觀**，只有小灌木叢，看不到任何樹木。這在有街景覆蓋的小島上通常更常見。

text: The Greenlandic landscape is very barren, with **no trees or taller vegetation **and often featuring snow. Mountains and hills are common, with very limited flat areas. On top of that, almost all coverage was taken in coastal areas, so fjords and visible coastlines are very common.
text_zh: 格陵蘭的景觀非常荒涼，**沒有樹木或高大植被**，且經常有雪。山脈和小山很常見，平坦地區非常有限。除此之外，幾乎所有的街景覆蓋都是在沿海地區拍攝的，因此峽灣和清晰可見的海岸線非常普遍。

text: Guam has a **tropical climate** with a lot of dense and somewhat low vegetation.
text_zh: 關島擁有**熱帶氣候**，且有許多濃密且相對矮小的植被。

text: **Oil palm plantations** are primarily found in two general areas: in the southwest and just north of the central mountain range.
text_zh: **油棕園**主要分布在兩個大致區域：西南部以及中部山脈的正北方。

text: Hawaii is known for its **lush** and **tropical** vegetation, with a variety of plants and trees. However, being a volcanic island chain, Hawaii has a wide range of landscapes, and as such vegetation as well.
You will often see plenty of [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/Ki93sohMTCDs1MZM8), [tall grass](https://goo.gl/maps/vfprezHVC8j4r6wY9), or other flowers on the sides of the roads.
text_zh: 夏威夷以其**蒼翠**且**熱帶**的植被而聞名，擁有各種植物和樹木。然而，作為一個火山島鏈，夏威夷擁有廣泛的地貌，因此植被也很多樣。
你經常會在路邊看到大量的[蕨類植物](https://goo.gl/maps/Ki93sohMTCDs1MZM8)、[高草](https://goo.gl/maps/vfprezHVC8j4r6wY9)或其他花卉。

text: Topography on Hawaii is characterised by many **sloping volcanoes**, rugged **cliffs**, **hills**, **valleys** and **craters**. Such distinct topography combined with tropical vegetation is a good way to identify Hawaii.
text_zh: 夏威夷的地形特徵是許多**傾斜的火山**、崎嶇的**懸崖**、**山丘**、**山谷**和**火山口**。這種獨特的地形結合熱帶植被，是辨識夏威夷的好方法。

text: The Island of Kauaʻi is the furthest west island in Hawaii with official Google coverage. This island has deep red soil and has large **rugged hills** with lush, jungle-like vegetation.
NOTE: Other islands such as Maui and Molokaʻi have similar soil colours, but the hillsides on them will typically have [less dense vegetation](https://maps.app.goo.gl/D3FK2TyPBcA4LpPZ7).
text_zh: 可愛島是夏威夷擁有官方 Google 街景的最西邊島嶼。這個島嶼擁有深紅色的土壤，並有著大型**崎嶇山丘**以及蒼翠的叢林般植被。
注意：其他島嶼（如茂宜島和摩洛凱島）也有相似的土壤顏色，但那裡的山坡通常[植被較不濃密](https://maps.app.goo.gl/D3FK2TyPBcA4LpPZ7)。

text: The Island of Molokaʻi is just southeast of Oʻahu. It features **deep red soil** and a prominent [volcano](https://maps.app.goo.gl/q2AwtJcBg9UjyECS8) on the eastern end of the island. Especially in the older Generation 3 coverage, the vegetation appears very dry. Molokaʻi is also very sparsely populated.
text_zh: 摩洛凱島就位於歐胡島的東南方。它擁有**深紅色土壤**，且島嶼東端有一座顯著的[火山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/q2AwtJcBg9UjyECS8)。特別是在較舊的第三代街景中，植被顯得非常乾燥。摩洛凱島的人口也非常稀少。

text: Towards the coasts of the island of Lānaʻi, hills dotted with **dry grass and shrubby vegetation** are commonly seen. These areas are very rural with few buildings.
text_zh: 朝著拉娜伊島的海岸前進，經常可以看到點綴著**乾草與灌木植被**的山丘。這些地區非常鄉村化，建築物很少。

text: The Island of Maui sits southeast of Molokaʻi. In the centre of the island, you will find dry and somewhat flat grasslands with one or **both** of the **mountain ranges** on the island visible.
text_zh: 茂宜島位於摩洛凱島的東南方。在島嶼中心，你會發現乾燥且有些平坦的草原，島上的一座或**兩座**山脈清晰可見。

text: Coastal areas of Maui are noticeably more** lush and green**. Banana plants, palm trees, and [views of the mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dm1N9dDprdoeUqWP7) are all common.
text_zh: 茂宜島的沿海地區明顯**更加蒼翠茂盛**。香蕉樹、棕櫚樹以及[山景](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dm1N9dDprdoeUqWP7)都很常見。

text: The coastal areas of the island of Hawai’i are where most of the towns and **built-up areas** on the island are located. These areas are typically more lush and have more trees and [fern plants](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3CBjiYMSAUukBp4n6) than the interior.
text_zh: 夏威夷島的沿海地區是島上大多數城鎮和**人口密集區**所在的地方。與內陸相比，這些地區通常更為蒼翠，擁有更多樹木和[蕨類植物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3CBjiYMSAUukBp4n6)。

text: **Rural roads** going through forests within a flat landscape are commonly found south of the city of Hilo, on the island of Hawaiʻi.
NOTE: Mountainous forests are dotted around Hawaii, but if you are in one, and you see red soil with Generation 3, consider guessing in Kauaʻi, the westernmost covered island.
text_zh: 夏威夷島（Hawaiʻi）希洛（Hilo）市南方常見穿越平坦地景森林的**鄉間道路**。
注意：夏威夷各地散布著山地森林，但如果你身處其中，且看到搭配第三代相機的紅土，可以考慮猜在最西邊有街景涵蓋的考艾島（Kauaʻi）。

text: The infamous “**Hawaiian** **lattice**” can be recognized by the volcanic soil and rocks that are abundant in the region. Volcanic vegetation can also be seen lining the roads. Note that the angle of the roads is a big clue for the area, and that this lattice was built on the slope of Mauna Loa.
text_zh: 惡名昭彰的「**夏威夷** **棋盤格**」可以透過該地區豐富的火山土壤和岩石來辨識。道路兩旁也可以看到火山植被。請注意，道路的角度是該地區的重要線索，而且這個棋盤格是建造在冒納羅亞火山（Mauna Loa）的坡地上。

text: Kahoʻolawe is a small island that lies just to the southwest of Maui. It only has **trekker** coverage on small gravel roads and dirt trails, and is characterised by dry, shrubby vegetation, rolling hills, and **dark red soil**. On the western end of this coverage, [several buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9) can be seen.
text_zh: 卡胡奧拉韋島（Kahoʻolawe）是位於茂宜島（Maui）西南方的一座小島。它的小碎石路和泥土小徑只有**徒步拍攝**涵蓋，並以乾燥、灌木叢生的植被、起伏的山丘和**深紅色土壤**為特徵。在這個涵蓋範圍的西端，可以看到[數棟建築物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9)。

text: There is also a plethora of rural locations that are harder to identify.

Outside the urban areas, Hong Kong is generally quite **mountainous**, with green, subtropical vegetation. There is extensive coverage in rural areas outside the city, with many roads going through the mountains. You might see low-rise rural buildings, however usually you will not need to travel far to see tall apartment blocks.
NOTE: Singapore, on the other hand, is very flat.
text_zh: 這裡也有大量較難辨識的鄉村地點。
在市區之外，香港通常相當**多山**，且擁有綠色的亞熱帶植被。市郊的鄉村地區有廣泛的街景涵蓋，許多道路穿梭於群山之間。你可能會看到低矮的鄉村建築，但通常不需要走太遠就能看到高聳的公寓大廈。
注意：相對地，新加坡非常平坦。

text: The residential district of Caribbean Coast and Tung Chung has **identical **apartment blocks that face the same direction, almost like a “wall” of buildings. There are a lot of planted palm trees in between and on the side of roads.
text_zh: 加州花園與東涌住宅區有朝向同一方向、**外觀相同**的公寓大樓，幾乎就像是一道建築「牆」。道路中間和兩側種植了許多棕櫚樹。

text: The Tai Chung Kiu Road is a divided road that runs in a north-east direction, and has views of the Shing Mun **River to the west**. The median has palm trees. In addition, a bicycle path runs alongside the road. Further north, [Route 2](https://goo.gl/maps/D1XThCUDTXBLmhhg8) also runs alongside the river, but this road has more lanes.
text_zh: 大涌橋路是一條朝東北方向延伸的分隔道路，並可享有西側城門**河的景觀**。中央分隔島種有棕櫚樹。此外，道路旁還設有自行車道。再往北，[2號幹線](https://goo.gl/maps/D1XThCUDTXBLmhhg8)也沿著河流運行，但這條路的車道較多。

text: Fan Kam Road runs in a general north-east direction, and can be recognized by the dense **tropical vegetation** surrounding the road, and sometimes mountains in the background. The road is also quite narrow and does not have any outer lines. Many [small villages](https://goo.gl/maps/9LA3nzaHZdsVzMvm6) branch off of the road, south and north of the country park.
text_zh: 粉錦公路大致朝東北方向延伸，其特徵為道路周圍茂密的**熱帶植被**，有時背景還能看到山脈。該道路也相當狹窄，且沒有任何外側標線。郊野公園的南北兩側有許多[小村莊](https://goo.gl/maps/9LA3nzaHZdsVzMvm6)自該道路分岔出去。

text: Lam Kam Road is similar to Fan Kam Road, however it runs in a more **east-west** direction. The road should also feel **busier **with more cars driving along the road and more houses on the sides of the road. In addition, the road is usually wider and a [median](https://goo.gl/maps/Yggjz9dCZCderyto9) containing trees can be seen separating sidewalks near the villages.
text_zh: 林錦公路與粉錦公路相似，但它的走向更偏**東西**方向。這條路應該會感覺**更繁忙**，沿途車輛更多，道路兩側的房子也更多。此外，道路通常較寬，且在村莊附近的人行道之間可以看到種有樹木的[分隔島](https://goo.gl/maps/Yggjz9dCZCderyto9)。

text: The roads going to Disneyland are divided, with palm trees along the side of the road with **teal **coloured street lamps.
text_zh: 通往迪士尼樂園的道路為分隔道路，路側種有棕櫚樹，並配有**青綠色**路燈。

text: While the southeastern parts of Hungary are extremely flat, with almost no noticeable hills, the northern and western parts mainly consist of **forested hills and mountains**. The tallest mountains are found in the north, while the southwestern mountains are generally slightly lower.
text_zh: 雖然匈牙利的東南部地區極其平坦、幾乎沒有明顯的山丘，但北部和西部地區主要由**多樹的山丘和山脈**組成。最高山脈位於北部，而西南部山脈通常稍低。

text: Unlike most of the Hungarian plains, which is almost entirely cultivated land, the Puszta, centred around Hortobágy National Park, mainly consists of barren and wet, natural grasslands.
text_zh: 不同於匈牙利大部分幾乎完全是耕地的平原，以霍爾托巴吉國家公園（Hortobágy National Park）為中心的普斯塔（Puszta）地區，主要由貧瘠且潮濕的天然草原組成。

text: Iceland often looks **barren and treeless**. Most regions have a dark grey soil consisting mostly of volcanic rocks.
NOTE: Due to the lack of trees, the landscape in Iceland does not look like anywhere else in Northern Europe.
text_zh: 冰島的景色通常**荒涼且無樹木**。大多數地區的土壤呈深灰色，主要由火山岩組成。
注意：由於缺乏樹木，冰島的地景看起來與北歐其他任何地方都不一樣。

text: Barren landscapes consisting mostly of** dark volcanic gravel**, with little to no vegetation or signs of life, are typical of the inland regions of Iceland. Most such covered roads are located in the east.
text_zh: 主要由**深色火山礫石**組成的荒涼地景，幾乎沒有植被或生命跡象，是冰島內陸地區的典型特徵。大多數此類有覆蓋的道路都位於東部。

text: The Southwest agricultural area in Iceland can be identified by its relatively flat **farmland landscape** scattered with numerous [farmsteads](https://goo.gl/maps/a8wo7RuEwy7EX5vZ6), fields, meadows and grasslands.
NOTE: Although there are other smaller agricultural areas in Iceland, mountains in this area tend to be quite distant, making it unique.
text_zh: 冰島的西南農業區可以透過其相對平坦的[農莊](https://goo.gl/maps/a8wo7RuEwy7EX5vZ6)、田野、草地和草原錯落的**農田地景**來辨識。
NOTE: 雖然冰島還有其他較小的農業區，但該地區的山脈通常相當遙遠，這使其顯得獨特。

text: The valley around Hallormsstaður has a distinct northeast/southwest angle with **low-lying mountains** on either side, a **wide river** flowing through it, and an **unusual amount of trees** for Iceland. Some of the sideroads are [in the forests](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HrmHr9Y8mPom7qBk6).
text_zh: 霍爾姆斯豪茲尤爾周圍的山谷具有明顯的東北/西南走向，兩側有**低矮的山脈**，一條**寬闊的河流**流過其中，並且以冰島來說擁有**異常多的樹木**。有些小路[位於森林中](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HrmHr9Y8mPom7qBk6)。

text: In Bihar, and less commonly Jharkhand, you may find trees with **four red and white stripes** painted near the bottom.
text_zh: 在比哈爾邦，以及較少見的賈坎德邦，你可能會發現樹木底部附近畫有**四條紅白相間的條紋**。

text: Houses or huts with **thatched roofs** are mainly found along the east coast and northern plains. Large [hay mounds](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7) are also generally more common in this region. Note that thatched roofs from Uttar Pradesh to Odisha tend to be made of [fine pieces of hay](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7) whereas thatched roofs from Odisha to Tamil Nadu tend to be made of dried [palm fans](https://goo.gl/maps/JQrA1smY5vWAYjee9).
text_zh: 擁有**茅草屋頂**的房屋或小屋主要分佈在東海岸和北部平原。大型[乾草堆](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7)在該地區也通常更常見。請注意，從北方邦到奧里薩邦的茅草屋頂往往由[細小的乾草塊](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7)製成，而從奧里薩邦到 Tamil Nadu 邦的茅草屋頂往往由乾燥的[棕櫚扇葉](https://goo.gl/maps/JQrA1smY5vWAYjee9)製成。

text: **Oil palm **plantations are most commonly found in the panhandle of Andhra Pradesh, especially near the eastern border with Telangana.
text_zh: **油棕**種植園最常見於安 Andhra Pradesh 邦狹長地帶，特別靠近與特倫 Telangana 邦的東部邊界。

text: In Ladakh and northern Himachal Pradesh you can find an **extremely dry landscape** with little to no vegetation within the Himalayan mountains.
text_zh: 在拉達克和喜馬拉雅山脈內喜馬拉雅普德什省北部，你可以找到幾乎沒有植被的**極度乾燥景觀**。

text: The Western Ghats Mountains in the western part of Maharashtra can be recognised by their **distinct ridgelines**, often having plateaus rather than peaks. The northern part is drier while the southern part has more vegetation.

NOTE: During the [rainy season](https://www.google.com/maps/@19.5669899,73.7237394,3a,42y,336.38h,97.72t,359.97r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfFjQwbXx-Aro9gPWDaPH5Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) the mountains will turn green and appear quite different.
text_zh: 位於馬哈拉施特拉省西部的西高止山脈可以透過其**清晰的山脊線**來識別，這些山脈通常是高原而非尖峰。北部地區較為乾燥，而南部地區則有較多植被。
注意：在[雨季](https://www.google.com/maps/@19.5669899,73.7237394,3a,42y,336.38h,97.72t,359.97r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfFjQwbXx-Aro9gPWDaPH5Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)期間，群山會變成綠色，外觀會截然不同。

text: The landscape in Mizoram mainly consists of lush, green valleys with fairly low vegetation with eroded hillsides having many small peaks scattered around.

NOTE: A somewhat similar landscape can be found in [Meghalaya](https://www.google.com/maps/@25.3870998,91.7617742,3a,40.2y,128.95h,86.43t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9EK2RjZ-ChZWuNyxjcwwvA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), however rather than distinct peaks, the hillsides will have a mostly smooth and flat top.
text_zh: 米索蘭省的景觀主要由茂盛的綠色山谷組成，植被相當矮小，侵蝕的山坡周圍散落著許多小山峰。

注意：在[梅ઘ拉亞省](https://www.google.com/maps/@25.3870998,91.7617742,3a,40.2y,128.95h,86.43t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9EK2RjZ-ChZWuNyxjcwwvA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)可以找到某種程度上類似的景觀，然而山坡不會有明顯的尖峰，而是多半呈現平滑且平坦的頂部。

text: [Japanese cedar trees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptomeria) can typically be recognised by their significant height combined with their narrow, fluffy-looking crowns. They are most commonly found near the border of Sikkim and West Bengal, as well as in Meghalaya.
text_zh: [日本柳杉](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptomeria)通常可以透過其顯著的高度以及狹窄、蓬鬆的樹冠來辨識。它們最常見於錫金與西孟加拉省的邊界附近，以及梅ઘ拉亞省。

text: Salt flats and [coastal marshes](https://www.google.com/maps/@22.0778782,72.2542147,3a,41.2y,236.56h,85.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sLYwEbQt8jOozBK8IYBl7ww!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) with nearly **no vegetation**, other than short yellow or brown grass, can be found in parts of Gujarat. [Shallow bodies of water](https://goo.gl/maps/B8yUWPvxANcLtfMC8) can often be seen around these areas.
NOTE: The soil in western Rajasthan will be a lot more sandy and you’ll typically be able to see short desert shrubs.
text_zh: 古茶拉底省的部分地區可以找到鹽灘和[沿海沼澤](https://www.google.com/maps/@22.0778782,72.2542147,3a,41.2y,236.56h,85.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sLYwEbQt8jOozBK8IYBl7ww!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)，除了矮小的黃草或褐草外，幾乎**沒有植被**。[淺水區](https://goo.gl/maps/B8yUWPvxANcLtfMC8)經常可以在這些地區周圍看到。
注意：西拉賈斯坦省的土壤會沙質得多，你通常可以看到矮小的沙漠灌木。

text: Lakshadweep, located off the coast of Kerala, can be easily recognised by the abundance of **coconut trees**. They are often painted **red-and-white**, resembling the Polish flag.
text_zh: 位於喀拉拉省外海的拉克沙群島，可以透過大量的**椰子樹**輕易辨認。它們經常被漆成**紅白相間**，類似波蘭國旗。

text: Northern Israel is usually far more **mountainous** and **green** than the rest of Israel. Throughout the region you will almost always see forested hills and mountains.
text_zh: 以色列北部通常比以色列其他地區更加**多山**且**翠綠**。放眼整個地區，你幾乎總是能看到長滿森林的山丘和山脈。

text: The area west of Jerusalem can often look deceptively similar to northern Israel, with green forested hills and some agriculture sprinkled across the landscape.

Two things can occasionally be used to tell the two apart. Firstly, in northern Israel you may occasionally see wide, [flat valleys](https://goo.gl/maps/6TvF6u9qvM7ZGx2k8), while the Jerusalem area is always going to be hilly. Secondly, if you see houses made of [Jerusalem stone](https://goo.gl/maps/8QyM47Z1iwZCsiR9A), you are likely to be near Jerusalem.
text_zh: 耶路撒冷以西的地區看起來通常會與以色列北部有著欺騙性的相似，那裡有綠色的森林山丘，景觀中點綴著一些農業。
偶爾可以用兩件事來區分這兩者。首先，在以色列北部，你可能會偶爾看到寬闊的[平坦山谷](https://goo.gl/maps/6TvF6u9qvM7ZGx2k8)，而耶路撒冷地區則總是丘陵起伏。其次，如果你看到由[耶路撒冷石](https://goo.gl/maps/8QyM47Z1iwZCsiR9A)建造的房屋，你很可能就在耶路撒冷附近。

text: **Date palm** plantations can often be seen close to the Jordanian border.
text_zh: 靠近約旦邊境的地方經常可以看到**棗椰**種植園。

text: The southern stretch of road 90 will have a **dry mountain range** to the east. It is also common to see palm trees.
text_zh: 90號公路的南部路段東側會有一座**乾燥的山脈**。看到棕櫚樹也很常見。

text: North of the Hasolelim forest reserve you can see this **large reservoir**.
text_zh: 哈索勒利姆自然保護區（Hasolelim forest reserve）以北可以看到這個**大型水庫**。

text: The Israel National Trail goes through the entire country and has one of the **longest trekkers** in the world. The trail goes through more or less every landscape present in the country, from the [rocky desert](https://goo.gl/maps/N9yF7LjTjYj2jXo89) in the south to [lush forests](https://goo.gl/maps/iKEmza2XMqA6DuP6A) in the north. Along the trail you may find [these markings](https://www.google.com/maps/@29.7794747,34.9703316,2a,15y,278.69h,83.71t,2.5r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCNnIN-Yjz8voGkn46w7zjw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), which will typically be orange, blue and white, but can also feature [other colour schemes](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.8947414,34.9497539,2a,15y,70.95h,72.04t,2.13r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sEjA0G5uGy2rDeCJn5cFLSA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 以色列國家步道貫穿整個國家，擁有世界上**最長的徒步拍攝**之一。該步道或多或少會穿過國內現存的所有景觀，從南部的[岩石沙漠](https://goo.gl/maps/N9yF7LjTjYj2jXo89)到北部的[鬱鬱蔥蔥的森林](https://goo.gl/maps/iKEmza2XMqA6DuP6A)。沿著步道你可能會找到[這些標記](https://www.google.com/maps/@29.7794747,34.9703316,2a,15y,278.69h,83.71t,2.5r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCNnIN-Yjz8voGkn46w7zjw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)，它們通常是橘色、藍色和白色，但也可能採用[其他配色方案](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.8947414,34.9497539,2a,15y,70.95h,72.04t,2.13r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sEjA0G5uGy2rDeCJn5cFLSA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: Japanese White Birch grows dominantly in the **Chubu and Hokkaido **regions, and to a lesser extent in Tohoku. Small areas of white birch can be found throughout Japan, so use this information primarily to help assist your region guess.

NOTE: Japanese Beech is another species of tree found in Japan. They, however, have more [grey and spotted bark](https://goo.gl/maps/pA6yUwusCcRfxnSz9), as opposed to the mostly white Japanese White Birch.
text_zh: 白樺主要生長在**中部與北海道**，東北較少。全日本各地都有零星分布，因此這項線索比較適合輔助判斷地區而非單獨定位。
註：日本另有山毛櫸這種樹，但樹皮偏[灰色且帶斑點](https://goo.gl/maps/pA6yUwusCcRfxnSz9)，不像白樺那樣近乎全白。

text: Chinese Silver Grass, referred to as Kyushu grass, is indeed very abundant on the island of **Kyushu**. However, use this tip with caution, as they can be seen outside of this area.

NOTE: Another notable region they can be found in is the prefectures of Niigata, Yamagata and Akita. Though, combining the rather large quantity found on Kyushu, its normally distinct vegetation, along with other information, there often will be a clear distinction.
text_zh: 芒草（社群俗稱九州草）確實在**九州**大量生長，但要謹慎使用這條線索，因為其他地區也看得到。
註：新潟、山形與秋田三縣也是明顯的分布區。不過九州的數量本來就多，加上當地植被通常相當有辨識度，再配合其他線索，多半分得出來。

text: The island is shaped by a unique mix of British and Norman influences. The many **winding roads** and hedgerows are reminiscent of English country lanes, with **tree-covered** roads being particularly common. However, due to Jersey’s unique geographical position, most coverage features **sunny **weather.
All images were taken by a **Generation 2** camera.
text_zh: 這座島嶼的特色融合了獨特的英國與諾曼第影響。許多**蜿蜒道路**和綠籬讓人聯想到英國鄉間小路，其中**樹木覆蓋**的道路特別常見。不過，由於澤西島獨特的地理位置，大部分的街景都有著**晴朗**的天氣。
所有影像皆由**第二代**相機拍攝。

text: Jordan is a **very arid** country, with limited vegetation and a lot of almost completely lifeless desert. The lushest parts will still only have the look of an [arid Mediterranean landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zvmGEnAftHUVwb6N9).
text_zh: 約旦是一個**非常乾旱**的國家，植被有限，且有許多幾乎毫無生氣的沙漠。最茂盛的部分也只會呈現[乾旱地中海景觀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zvmGEnAftHUVwb6N9)的外觀。

text: **Highway 15** is the longest **divided highway** with coverage in Jordan. Most of the road is surrounded by desert landscape. It is also surrounded by rocky hills in the south closer to Aqaba.

NOTE: Highway 35 north of Madaba and highway 40 west of Amman are also divided but do not feature a desert landscape, while the divided highway 80 in the south runs mainly from east to west, making it distinguishable.
text_zh: **15號公路**是約旦覆蓋範圍內最長的**分隔雙向公路**。公路大部分被沙漠景觀環繞。在南部靠近亞喀巴的地方，周圍則是岩石山丘。
注意：馬達巴以北的35號公路和安曼以西的40號公路也是分隔道路，但沒有沙漠景觀，而南部的80號分隔公路主要呈東西走向，這點讓它很容易辨認。

text: **Highway 35** connecting Amman and Jerash is a divided road surrounded by hills speckled with green vegetation.
NOTE: Highway 40 west of Amman is also divided and features a similar landscape. However, the **T-shaped** lamppost shown in the image is only found on highway 35 which helps distinguish the two.
text_zh: 連接安曼和傑拉什的**35號公路**是一條周圍點綴著綠色植被山丘的分隔道路。
注意：安曼以西的40號公路也是分隔道路，且具有類似的景觀。不過，圖片中顯示的**T字形**路燈僅見於35號公路，這有助於區分這兩條路。

text: **Highway 40** is a recognisable divided** **road surrounded by low, green shrubbery that makes its way west of Amman through the hilly terrain into the sandy area close to the Dead Sea.
NOTE: **Y-shaped **lamp posts as shown in the image can be found along the length of highway 40, making it distinguishable from highway 35 north of Amman.
text_zh: **40號公路**是一條好認的分隔**道路**，周圍環繞著低矮的綠色灌木叢，從安曼以西穿過丘陵地形，一直延伸到死海附近的沙地區域。
注意：如圖片所示，沿著40號公路全長可以找到**Y字形**路燈，這使其有別於安曼以北的35號公路。

text: Kazakhstan is a big and diverse country, which features a plethora of distinct landscapes like [deserts](https://goo.gl/maps/DWJvw2JjfZTTF2ER9), [grassy steppes](https://goo.gl/maps/FtuwHnxx1cACr5HU9), [mountain passes](https://goo.gl/maps/dnJR7qdEBDQLUkUC9), and [birch forests](https://goo.gl/maps/NTfW9tkDsF2mVbqT8).
Most strikingly, most of the rural coverage in Kazakhstan is in a very empty, open and mostly flat landscape.
text_zh: 哈薩克是一個廣闊且地形多樣的國家，擁有大量不同的景觀，例如[沙漠](https://goo.gl/maps/DWJvw2JjfZTTF2ER9)、[草地草原](https://goo.gl/maps/FtuwHnxx1cACr5HU9)、[山隘](https://goo.gl/maps/dnJR7qdEBDQLUkUC9)以及[樺樹林](https://goo.gl/maps/NTfW9tkDsF2mVbqT8)。
最顯著的是，哈薩克的鄉村街景大多位於非常空曠、開闊且大多平坦的景觀中。

text: The bottom of tree trunks are very often **painted white**.
NOTE: This is common in several eastern European countries, as well as in parts of Russia.
text_zh: 樹幹的底部經常被**漆成白色**。
注意：這在幾個東歐國家以及俄羅斯的部分地區也很常見。

text: These **lush birch forests** next to green fields are common in northern Kazakhstan.
NOTE: This landscape often appears very similar to that found in and around [Omsk Oblast](https://goo.gl/maps/GSSXj16AyYgmrd2L8) in Russia.
text_zh: 這些位於綠色田野旁的**茂密樺樹林**在哈薩克北部很常見。
注意：這種地貌看起來通常與俄羅斯[鄂木斯克州](https://goo.gl/maps/GSSXj16AyYgmrd2L8)及周邊地區非常相似。

text: **Sandy **and shrubby **desert-like** landscapes are common in southwestern Kazakhstan.
text_zh: 哈薩克西南部常見**沙質**且帶有灌木的**沙漠般**地貌。

text: The East Kazakhstan Region is **hilly **and **forested**. It was covered in october, so you will see **fall colours** on the vegetation. The town of [Ridder](https://goo.gl/maps/i5kesJk8N1Nm9tJK9) itself is flat, but surrounded by hazy mountains.
text_zh: 東哈薩克州**多山丘**且**多森林**。它是十月份拍攝的，因此你會看到植被呈現**秋季色彩**。[里德](https://goo.gl/maps/i5kesJk8N1Nm9tJK9)城鎮本身是平坦的，但被朦朧的山脈環繞。

text: The landscape in southern Kazakhstan near Uzbekistan is hilly and quite **dry and shrubby**, with a lot of [orange looking grass](https://goo.gl/maps/NMh2NNtw2fLihzkD6). The landscape consists of [dry but grassy rolling hills](https://goo.gl/maps/HVEEsWWCgeKeFyMv7) or [dead flat agricultural land](https://goo.gl/maps/rYuF4Q74ka7y5KXz5) near Zhetisay.
NOTE: These [red and white KM markers](https://goo.gl/maps/55J3nhF75bSt4K7G6) that look like Kyrgyz ones, are only found near Zhetisay.
text_zh: 哈薩克南部鄰近烏茲別克邊境的景觀多丘陵且相當**乾燥多灌木**，有許多[看起來呈橘色的草](https://goo.gl/maps/NMh2NNtw2fLihzkD6)。景觀包含[乾燥但長滿草的起伏丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/HVEEsWWCgeKeFyMv7)，或是傑特賽（Zhetisay）附近[死平的農田](https://goo.gl/maps/rYuF4Q74ka7y5KXz5)。
注意：這些看起來像吉爾吉斯風格的[紅白相間公里碑](https://goo.gl/maps/55J3nhF75bSt4K7G6)，只在傑特賽附近找得到。

text: Around Semey, you can find small clusters or entire forests** **consisting mostly of **pine trees** and some deciduous trees, which will have **fall colours**.
text_zh: 在塞梅依周圍，你可以找到由**松樹**和一些會呈現**秋葉色彩**的落葉樹組成的小群落或整片森林** **。

text: The divided section of the **E38** goes **southeast to northwest** from Shymkent to Kyzylorda. The road is made of **asphalt**, and it has **all white road lines**. The landscape varies quite a lot; in the south, it is very [green](https://goo.gl/maps/71g8LgQkJqC4mYJF6) and in the north, it gets [dry, sandy, and shrubby](https://goo.gl/maps/StZ6q6CejmVpK7yg8).
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: **E38** 的雙向分隔車道從奇姆肯特到克孜勒奧爾達**由東南向西北**延伸。這條路是**柏油**路面，並有**全白色道路標線**。地景變化相當大；南部非常[綠意盎然](https://goo.gl/maps/71g8LgQkJqC4mYJF6)，北部則變得[乾燥、多沙且有灌木](https://goo.gl/maps/StZ6q6CejmVpK7yg8)。
行車方向：雙向

text: Between Karaganda and Astana, the **M36 **is now a divided highway, with **yellow outer lines**. The landscape consists of a grassy, sometimes hilly, steppe with an occasional row of trees along the road. Note that the general **southeast to northwest** road angle is important.
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: 在卡拉干達和阿斯塔納之間，**M36 **現在是一條中央分隔的高速公路，帶有**黃色外側線**。地景由草地、有時起伏的草原組成，路旁偶有成排的樹木。請注意，大體的**由東南向西北**道路角度很重要。
行車方向：雙向

text: The section of the **A1 **going from Astana to Shchuchinsk is a **6-lane divided highway**. The landscape around is generally **quite green**, with trees and grassy plains or hills.
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: **A1 **從阿斯塔納到休欽斯克的路段是一條 **6 車道的分隔高速公路**。周圍的地景通常**相當翠綠**，有樹木以及草地平原或山丘。
行車方向：雙向

text: The **A17 **going to Ulytau Region can be recognised by the **bad pavement quality**, where the edges of the road are almost crumbling away, along with the **single white middle road line**, which can be dashed or solid. The landscape itself is a grassy steppe, with some fall coloured trees occasionally lining the roads.
[West of Atasu](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8), the sun is distinctly low on the horizon.
NOTE: A small section east of Atasu has [pristine new pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9), which has a slight red tint to it.
Driving direction: **Towards **[**Atasu**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu) from both directions
text_zh: 通往兀魯套州的 **A17 **可以透過**糟糕的鋪面品質**來辨識，道路邊緣幾乎在崩塌，並伴隨著**單一白色中央道路標線**（可能是虛線或實線）。地景本身是草地草原，路旁偶爾點綴著帶有秋色的樹木。
[阿塔苏西方](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8)，太陽明顯在地平線低處。
注意：阿塔苏東方的一小段路擁有[嶄新的 pristine 鋪面](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9)，帶有一點微紅的色調。
行車方向：從雙向**朝向**[**阿塔苏**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu)

text: The road north of Zhezqazghan has no road lines. The landscape is **very dry, desolate**, with very limited vegetation** **and slightly hilly. The soil can look very red or orange at times.
The weather is sunny, with a lot of [cumulus clouds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulus_cloud).
Driving directions: **North **from Nikolskiy
text_zh: 傑茲卡茲甘北方的道路沒有道路標線。地景**非常乾燥、荒涼**，植被非常有限** **且略帶起伏。土壤有時看起來非常紅或橘。
天氣晴朗，有許多[積雲](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulus_cloud)。
行車方向：自尼科利斯克**向北**

text: Coverage in dense **baltic pine forests** can be found north of Shchuchinsk, which is north of Astana.
NOTE: Baltic pines can be found in other parts of the country.
text_zh: 濃密**波羅的海松林**的街景覆蓋可以在休琴斯克（阿斯塔納以北）以北找到。
註：波羅的海松樹也可能在該國其他地區找到。

text: Parts of Oskemen have **hazy forest fire coverage**.
text_zh: 烏斯季卡緬諾戈爾斯克（Oskemen）的部分地區有**霧茫茫的森林大火街景覆蓋**。

text: The Altyn Emel National Park is a barren grassland with snowy mountains in all directions. Some parts are [very snowy](https://goo.gl/maps/7K5s7XqLSKzpMLvEA). And in the eastern section, there is a small [curvy mountain pass](https://goo.gl/maps/8rJPLHV5Zs7DxQC87).
text_zh: 阿爾廷埃梅爾國家公園是一片貧瘠的草原，四周環繞著雪山。某些部分[非常雪白](https://goo.gl/maps/7K5s7XqLSKzpMLvEA)。而在東部路段，有一個小型[蜿蜒山隘](https://goo.gl/maps/8rJPLHV5Zs7DxQC87)。

text: Near the Turkmenistan border in southwest Kazakhstan, you will find this **unpaved sandy desert road. **The landscape is almost blindingly bright from the sand.
text_zh: 在哈薩克西南方的土庫曼邊境附近，你會找到這條**未鋪裝的沙質沙漠道路。**風景被沙子映得幾乎刺眼。

text: The far west areas of the country that are northwest and southwest of Kisumu are the most agricultural parts of the country. You will often see **farms**, grassy hills, and tall **eucalyptus **trees in this region of the country.
text_zh: 基蘇木（Kisumu）西北方與西南方的國內極西地區是國內農業最發達的部分。在這個區域，你經常會看到**農場**、草地山丘以及高大的**尤加利樹**。

text: The B9 in the Northeast is entirely unpaved and has bright **reddish orange dirt **with many trees surrounding the road. Most of it is very flat, but the coverage at the western end of the road can have hills and mountains. The soil also transitions into a more sandy colour.
text_zh: 東北部的 B9 公路完全未鋪柏油，擁有明亮的**紅橘色泥土**，道路周圍有許多樹木。大部分路段非常平坦，但道路西端的街景可能會出現丘陵和山脈。土壤也會轉變成更偏向沙子的顏色。

text: North of Marsabit will be **much flatter**, with some mountains in the distance. The stretch just north or Marsabit will have mountains visible to the south, while further north, a different range can be seen. It will also have much less vegetation.
text_zh: 馬斯比特以北的地區會**平坦許多**，遠處有一些山脈。馬斯比特正北方的路段往南可以看見山脈，而再往北方則能看見不同的山脈。該處的植被也會少得多。

text: The A3 north of Garissa is very unique, with **light coloured **soil and many green trees on either side of the road.
text_zh: 加里薩（Garissa）以北的 A3 公路非常獨特，道路兩側有著**淺色**土壤和許多綠樹。

text: Amboseli National Park has a grey car with a small snorkel. It is very flat with **tan grass, few trees**, and dried up lake beds. You can always see the base of Kilimanjaro to the south, with most of it obscured by clouds.
text_zh: 安博塞利國家公園有一輛灰色且帶有小型進氣 snorkel 的車。地勢非常平坦，有著**黃褐色的草、稀疏的樹木**以及乾涸的湖床。往南方總是可以看到吉力馬札羅山的山腳，大部分山體都被雲層遮蔽。

text: The area surrounding and between Kerio and Lodwar uses the same car as the Aberdare National Park, but with a vastly different landscape. It is very **sandy, dry**, and has little vegetation.
You may also find yourself in [Generation 3 coverage without car meta](https://goo.gl/maps/SVmfuG3XAkPt2ipv7).
text_zh: 克里奧和洛德瓦爾周圍及之間的地區使用的是與亞伯德爾國家公園相同的車，但景觀截然不同。這裡非常**沙質、乾燥**且植被稀少。
你可能也會發現自己身處[沒有 Google 車特徵的第三代街景覆蓋範圍](https://goo.gl/maps/SVmfuG3XAkPt2ipv7)。

text: All of Kyrgyzstan was covered during the **winter months**, so many of the trees will lack leaves, the landscape will be quite drab, and you can see snow in many parts of Kyrgyzstan.
text_zh: 整個吉爾吉斯斯坦的街景都是在**冬季**拍攝的，所以許多樹木沒有葉子、景觀相當枯黃，且在吉爾吉斯斯坦的許多地方都可以看到雪。

text: Lake Issyk Kul is the **biggest body of water** in Kyrgyzstan. You will often be able to spot it on the roads north and south of the lake. Sometimes it will be obscured by buildings or trees, but the lack of any mountains in the direction of the lake will be a good clue.

NOTE: There are two other significant bodies of water that can be seen from the road: the [Toktogul Reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/ay9ZJWwV3ZNPLviu6) and [Lake Song-Kul](https://goo.gl/maps/zgw4obnegxGGkWSPA). With a bit of practice, you can reliably distinguish these from Issyk Kul however.
text_zh: 伊塞克湖是吉爾吉斯 **最大的水體**。你經常可以在湖泊的南北兩側道路上看到它。有時它會被建築物或樹木遮擋，但朝著湖泊的方向沒有任何山脈會是一個很好的線索。
注意：從路上還可以看見另外兩個重要水體：[托克托古爾水庫](https://goo.gl/maps/ay9ZJWwV3ZNPLviu6)與[松湖](https://goo.gl/maps/zgw4obnegxGGkWSPA)。不過只要稍加練習，你就能穩妥地將它們與伊塞克湖區分開來。

text: You can also distinguish Osh from Bishkek by looking at the trees: most still have their **leaves**.
text_zh: 你可以透過觀察樹木來區分奧什（Osh）與比許凱克（Bishkek）：大部分樹木仍有**葉子**。

text: This section of road goes through mountains that have **rocky cliffs**. These mountains are a habitat for lots of [spruce trees](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6) that grow on the cliff sides. A more diverse selection of trees grows next to the river that follows the road. You can see that [some mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A) still have snow on the peaks. Most [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6) along the road are coloured blue.
NOTE: The southern section of the road features more rocky cliffs that cannot sustain any trees.
text_zh: 這段路穿過擁有**岩石懸崖**的山區。這些山脈是許多生長在懸崖邊的[雲杉樹](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6)的棲息地。順著道路流淌的河流旁生長著更多樣化的樹木。你可以看到[有些山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A)頂端仍有積雪。沿路的 plupart [路標](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6)都是藍色的。
注意：該道路的南部路段有更多無法支撐任何樹木生長的陡峭岩壁。

text: You can see the mostly **dried up** part of the Toktogul Reservoir either to the south or north of the road. There are taller mountains quite close on every side. The northern half is more desolate, while the south features more vegetation and buildings as well.
text_zh: 你可以在道路的南側或北側看到托克托古爾水庫（Toktogul Reservoir）大體上**乾涸**的部分。四面八方都有相當靠近的較高山脈。北半部更為荒涼，而南半部則有更多植被和建築物。

text: This southern region has a lot of **agriculture** and a lot of vegetation on the sides of the roads. The region is generally flat, but the road is very close to the hills that are usually to the north or east. The gaps in the minimap indicate [exceptionally hilly spots](https://goo.gl/maps/jiACiXehCHEDrKs6A).
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
text_zh: 這個南部地區有許多**農業**活動，道路兩旁也有大量植被。該地區大致平坦，但道路非常靠近通常位於北側或東側的山丘。小地圖上的缺口暗示了[異常丘陵起伏的地點](https://goo.gl/maps/jiACiXehCHEDrKs6A)。
注意：這段路段具有南部髒鏡像。

text: The road then becomes undivided. This section south of Balykchy is **extremely dry**, with the landscape mostly consisting of **small shrubs**, unless you are next to the [Chu river](https://goo.gl/maps/ywDaNU4WiGsZyf6y8). To the north, you can spot [these mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/LP3YHHgYadZiUXew7) that have clouds hovering above them. Otherwise, there are no clouds in this region.
text_zh: 接著道路變回未分隔的雙向道。巴雷克奇（Balykchy）以南的這段路**極為乾燥**，除非你靠近[楚河](https://goo.gl/maps/ywDaNU4WiGsZyf6y8)，否則地貌主要由**小型灌木**組成。往北看，你可以發現[這些山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/LP3YHHgYadZiUXew7)上方懸掛著雲朵。除此之外，這個地區沒有雲。

text: Further up the road, you enter a **dry valley** with mountains flanking both sides. There is barely any vegetation - just some shrubs close to the ground. The river next to the road brings some more [greenery](https://goo.gl/maps/QHRbRNePyag8rCWZ7) to the area. In the southern half of this section, you can see this [slightly snowy ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/EXF4khfG7pRPC3hY6) to the north.
text_zh: 順著路往前，你進入了一個兩側環繞著山脈的**乾燥山谷**。這裡幾乎沒有植被——只有一些靠近地面的灌木。道路旁的小河為該地區帶來了更多[綠意](https://goo.gl/maps/QHRbRNePyag8rCWZ7)。在這段路的南半部，你可以看到北側有這個[微雪的山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/EXF4khfG7pRPC3hY6)。

text: Going further south, you will reach this next valley, which seems equally dry, but the mountains are more rocky and have **trees** growing on them. The road now has very **bad pavement**, and as such you can see dust clouds.
text_zh: 繼續向南，你將抵達下一個山谷，它看起來同樣乾燥，但山脈更為崎嶇且長有**樹木**。現在道路的**路面狀況很差**，因此你可以看到塵土飛揚。

text: The section east of Cholpon Ata appears **overcast**, with mountains to the north, and a lake to the south. Tall** tree rows** on either side of the road is a common sight.
text_zh: 喬爾蓬阿塔以東的路段呈現**陰天**，北側有山脈，南側有湖泊。道路兩旁高大的**樹排**是常見的景象。

text: The vertical stretch of road north of Karakol is mostly flanked by tall **tree rows** on either side. There are also tall **snowy mountains** to the north and south.
NOTE: The weather changes [here](https://goo.gl/maps/KRut2ZyU5NqN4kSh9), around the midpoint of the road.
text_zh: 卡拉科爾以北的垂直路段兩旁大多有高大的**樹排**夾道。北部和南部也有高大的**雪山**。
注意：天氣在道路中點附近的[這裡](https://goo.gl/maps/KRut2ZyU5NqN4kSh9)發生了變化。

text: On the road west of Karakol, you will see a lot of vegetation on the sides of the roads, and long expanses of green and yellow fields beyond them. You will usually be able to see the [Tian Shan Mountain Range](https://goo.gl/maps/eas6MS21Stbsv2xSA) in the distance to the north. There are [big mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/CADnPrwmSH4cDRNz5) to the south as well, with smaller hills before them.
NOTE: The weather is completely clear east of [this intersection](https://goo.gl/maps/pWreLeU7anq1h2kZ7).
text_zh: 在卡拉科爾以西的路上，你會看到道路兩旁有許多植被，遠處則是綿延不斷的綠黃相間田野。你通常能夠在遠處的北側看到[天山山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/eas6MS21Stbsv2xSA)。南側也有[大山](https://goo.gl/maps/CADnPrwmSH4cDRNz5)，前方則有較小的山丘。
注意：[這個交叉口](https://goo.gl/maps/pWreLeU7anq1h2kZ7)以東的天氣完全晴朗。

text: The eastern side of EM-13 closely resembles the road going west of Naryn. (See tip below) This road, however, is an unpaved gravel road in the middle of the Naryn valley, so the hills to the north are now closer. The Landscape is filled with bushes, shrubs, and grass.

NOTE: The one [town](https://goo.gl/maps/1thfQDp4CWjf8LFd6) in the region can be recognized by these [white-and-red fences](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4501666,74.8385784,3a,19y,34.51h,67.32t,0.03r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suyOimMFlXHwwDfOq3fpKRQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) with a white diamond pattern in the middle.
text_zh: EM-13 的東側非常類似納倫以西的道路。（見下方提示）然而，這條路是納倫河谷中央的一條未鋪面碎石路，因此北側的山丘現在更靠近了。地貌充滿了灌木、矮樹叢和青草。

注意：該地區的唯一[城鎮](https://goo.gl/maps/1thfQDp4CWjf8LFd6)可以透過中間帶有白色菱形圖案的[紅白相間圍欄](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4501666,74.8385784,3a,19y,34.51h,67.32t,0.03r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suyOimMFlXHwwDfOq3fpKRQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)來辨識。

text: The road in the mountains south of Song-Kul is the only unpaved road this **high up** in the mountains. You can see the clouds below you, down in the valleys below. The mountains have rugged peaks, and snowy cliff sides. Many of the mountains also have **spruce trees** growing on them.
text_zh: 宋湖以南山區的道路是山區中海拔**這麼高**的唯一未鋪面道路。你可以看到下方的雲朵在下方的山谷中。山脈擁有崎嶇的山峰和覆蓋著雪的懸崖邊。許多山脈上還生長著**雲杉樹**。

text: This valley is **full of vegetation**. This area also has a lot of buildings and fences near the road. Most of the road is in poor shape, with it being unpaved and potholes littering parts of it. To the north, you can see some darker clouds, and closer to Arkit, the weather will get cloudier, and there are more dead trees.
The south to north driving direction on this road is worth noting.
text_zh: 這個山谷**充滿了植被**。這個地區在道路附近也有很多建築物和柵欄。大部分道路狀況不佳，為未鋪裝路面且部分路段佈滿坑洞。向北望去，你可以看到一些較暗的雲層，越接近阿爾基特（Arkit），天氣就會越陰沉，並且有更多枯樹。
這條路由南向北的行駛方向值得注意。

text: This section near Arkit has a lot of **snow** everywhere and **low broad leafed trees** all around. This already unique landscape paired with the south to north driving direction makes it very easy to recognise.
text_zh: 阿爾基特附近的這段路到處都是**雪**，周圍環繞著**低矮的闊葉樹**。這種本就獨特的景觀搭配由南向北的行駛方向，使得這裡非常容易辨認。

text: The road south of Jeti Oguz goes through a valley. The general landscape in this valley is **very green** by Kyrgyzstan standards, there are plenty of trees and bushes growing in the valley and on the hills. You can see small patches of snow still on the ground. From most of the valley, you can still see the [Tian Shan mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/n5nMitgC1Zx3N7H69) to the north, and other snowy mountains to the south. The valley also contains these [unique orange rock formations](https://goo.gl/maps/b1a7ct7RJ3iedLDPA).
text_zh: 傑提奧古茲（Jeti Oguz）南側的道路穿過一個山谷。以吉爾吉斯標準來看，這個山谷中的整體景觀**非常翠綠**，山谷中和山丘上生長著大量的樹木和灌木。你還可以看到地面上有一小塊一小塊的殘雪。從山谷的大部分地方，你仍然可以看到北邊的[天山山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/n5nMitgC1Zx3N7H69)，以及南邊的其他雪山。山谷中也包含這些[獨特的橙色岩石地形](https://goo.gl/maps/b1a7ct7RJ3iedLDPA)。

text: The road north of Grigorievka goes through a stunning river valley. This is one of the most unique roads in Kyrgyzstan. You can easily recognise it from the **spruce covered mountains** in this rocky valley. The lack of snow is also notable.

The [northern half](https://www.google.com/maps/@42.8331837,77.4143633,2a,90y,134.55h,91.08t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D36.16604%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) of this road is on an open rolling field with pine forests scattered around.
text_zh: 格里戈里耶夫卡（Grigorievka）北側的道路穿過一個令人驚嘆的河谷。這是吉爾吉斯最獨特的道路之一。你可以從這個岩石山谷中**雲杉覆蓋的山脈**輕易將其認出。沒有雪也是一個顯著特點。

這條路的[北半部](https://www.google.com/maps/@42.8331837,77.4143633,2a,90y,134.55h,91.08t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D36.16604%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)位於開闊的起伏原野上，周圍散落著松林。

text: There is a side road north of the Orto Tokoy Reservoir that has very broken coverage. This road is **well maintained**, and it passes through **dry mountains**. The only vegetation around is grass and shrubs. To the west, you can see this [mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/EYX6oJnUFHhxN89P8) which has little snow left. To the north, the [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/NP7X99RuTAnMVSNu5) are dark, similar to silhouettes, and on the southern portion of the road, you will see the [reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/tqBo8qMqdCXkZhjT9).
text_zh: 奧爾托托科伊水庫（Orto Tokoy Reservoir）北側有一條支路，其街景覆蓋非常破碎。這條路**維護良好**，它穿過**乾旱的山脈**。周圍唯一的植被是草和灌木。向西望去，你可以看到這座[山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/EYX6oJnUFHhxN89P8)，上面幾乎沒有殘雪。向北望去，[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/NP7X99RuTAnMVSNu5)呈深色，類似剪影，而在道路的南部，你會看到[水庫](https://goo.gl/maps/tqBo8qMqdCXkZhjT9)。

text: This remote gravel road southwest of Naryn passes through a **dry and desolate valley**. Despite the river, there is nothing but some shrubs on the ground. Many of the mountains in the valley have steep, rocky cliff sides. You will also find snow here, but more so in the south.
text_zh: 納倫（Naryn）西南方這條偏遠的碎石路穿過一個**乾旱荒涼的山谷**。儘管有河流，但地面上除了幾叢灌木外什麼也沒有。山谷中的許多山脈都有陡峭的岩石懸崖面。你在這裡也會發現雪，但越往南越多。

text: Street View coverage in Laos is very **limited**. Only five cities are covered: Vientiane, Vang Vieng, Luang Prabang, Savannakhet, and Pakse.
In addition, all coverage in Laos was taken by a Generation 3 camera.

All five cities have a distinct look and with some practise they are easily distinguishable from each other. The differences are discussed in more detail in the region-guessing section, but the summarized version is as follows:
- **Luang Prabang**: historical architecture, hills, palms
- **Vang Vieng**: distinct mountains
- **Vientiane**: no roof rack, large city
- **Savannakhet**: very flat
- **Pakse**: red soil, arid, hills
text_zh: 寮國的街景覆蓋非常**有限**。只有五個城市有覆蓋：永珍（Vientiane）、旺陽（Vang Vieng）、龍坡邦（Luang Prabang）、沙灣拿吉（Savannakhet）和巴色（Pakse）。
此外，寮國的所有覆蓋都是由第 3 相機世代拍攝的。
這五個城市都有獨特的外觀，經過一些練習後，它們很容易彼此區分。這些差異將在區域猜題部分進行更詳細的討論，但總結版本如下：
- **龍坡邦**：歷史建築、山丘、棕櫚樹
- **旺陽**：特異的山峰
- **永珍**：沒有車頂架、大城市
- **沙灣拿吉**：非常平坦
- **巴色**：紅土、乾旱、山丘

text: **Palm trees** are common in Luang Prabang.
text_zh: **棕櫚樹**在龍坡邦很常見。

text: The road that goes through the conservation area features uniquely **hilly **terrain for Laos. Landscape around the road is also very **dry**, and mostly **forested**. Additionally, the road is in good condition with coloured curbs and dashed outer lines.
NOTE: It is the only single lane road that has black and white or yellow and white curbs.
text_zh: 穿過保育區的道路具有寮國少見的**丘陵**地形。道路周圍的景觀也非常**乾旱**，且大多為**森林**。此外，道路狀況良好，配有彩色緣石和虛線外側標線。
註記：這是唯一一條擁有黑白或黃白緣石的單車道道路。

text: Savannakhet is very **flat**: the only mountains that are visible are on the other side of the Mekong river, in Thailand.
It is also recognizable as its soil has a **slight red** tinge, however not as red as Pakse.
NOTE: On Google Maps, the label for Savannakhet is hidden under the label of the Thai province of Mukdahan until you zoom in relatively close. You can find Savannakhet by going west of Xeno.
text_zh: 沙灣拿吉非常**平坦**：唯一能見到的山脈在湄公河對岸的泰國境內。
它也可以透過其土壤帶有**微紅**色調來辨識，不過沒有巴色那麼紅。
註記：在 Google 地圖上，沙灣拿吉的標籤藏在泰國莫拉限府（Mukdahan）的標籤下方，直到你放大到相對接近的程度。你可以透過向西前往瑟農（Xeno）來找到沙灣拿吉。

text: The southern city of Pakse is easily recognizable thanks to the distinct **red **soil.
The vegetation is also uniquely **dry**, with equally [dry hills](https://goo.gl/maps/VRfYqJdVfgmuNvwL6) nearby.
text_zh: 南部的巴色由於鮮明的**紅色**土壤而很容易辨識。
植被也異常**乾旱**，附近有同樣[乾旱的山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/VRfYqJdVfgmuNvwL6)。

text: The area south of Jelgava is characterised by a **wide open landscape** with considerably less forest and more fields than most of the rest of Latvia.
text_zh: 葉爾加瓦以南地區的特徵是**開闊廣大的景觀**，與拉脫維亞其他大部分地區相比，森林明顯較少而田野更多。

text: Campus Debbieh of the Beirut Arab University consists of somewhat sparsely built large **modern sandstone buildings** on top of a forested hill. [The ocean](https://goo.gl/maps/JABVUYU4L9Zztrxm8) can typically be seen far away to the west.
text_zh: 阿拉伯貝魯特大學的德比亞校區由位於森林山丘頂部的、稀疏分佈的大型**現代砂岩建築**組成。[海洋](https://goo.gl/maps/JABVUYU4L9Zztrxm8)通常可以在遠處的西方看見。

text: Grasslands in Lesotho primarily consist of **short grass**.
NOTE: This is mostly useful to distinguish Lesotho from Eswatini, which famously has a lot of tall grass.
text_zh: 賴索托的草原主要由**短草**組成。
注意：這主要有助於將賴索托與以擁有大量高草而聞名的史瓦帝尼區分開來。

text: Around Ruggell, there is a small, forested ridgeline to the south. This is a big contrast to the towering mountains seen elsewhere.
text_zh: 在魯格爾周圍，南方有一個帶森林的小型山脊線。這與其他地方看到的巍峨群山形成了巨大對比。

text: This steep rocky cliff with trees at its base and on the top can be seen in and around Mäls.
text_zh: 這個底部和頂部都有樹木的陡峭岩壁可以在梅爾斯及周邊地區看到。

text: Lithuania has **less forest cover** than the other two Baltic countries. As a result, the landscape appears more open and agricultural. Your mileage may vary depending on the round however, so use this meta with some caution.
text_zh: 立陶宛的**森林覆蓋率較低**，不如另外兩個波羅的海國家。因此，風景看起來更為開闊且充滿農田。不過實際情況可能因回合而異，因此在使用這項線索特徵時請保持謹慎。

text: The Curonian Spit is a long thin sand-dune [spit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spit_(landform)) south of Klaipeda, that separates the Curonian Lagoon from the Baltic Sea. The main road on this spit, **road 167**, has a recognizable combination of landscape and road direction:
- The road runs in an approximate north-south direction and has Generation 4 coverage.

The road is surrounded on all sides by forest with many [Baltic pines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris). In many places, you will see slightly windswept trees (visible in the example image).
text_zh: 庫爾斯沙嘴（Curonian Spit）是位於克萊佩達（Klaipeda）南方的一條長形細沙[沙嘴](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spit_(landform))，它將庫爾斯潟湖與波羅的海隔開。這條沙嘴上的主要道路——**167號公路**，具有可辨識的地景與道路方向組合：
- 這條路大致呈南北走向，且擁有 Generation 4 街景覆蓋。
道路四周都被森林環繞，並有許多[歐洲赤松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris)。在許多地方，你可以看到稍微被風吹歪的樹木（如範例圖片所示）。

text: Almost all of Luxembourg’s landscape consists of green **rolling hills**, with a patchwork of agriculture and forests.
NOTE: If you see a yellow licence plate, and you are not sure what country it belongs to, landscape is often a good clue: almost all of the Netherlands is completely flat.
text_zh: 盧森堡的景觀幾乎全由綠色**起伏丘陵**組成，夾雜著農田和森林。
NOTE: 如果你看到黃色車牌，且不確定它屬於哪個國家，風景通常是一個很好的線索：荷蘭幾乎完全是平地。

text: A **hilly,** **rural** region of Macau can be found in the south. Roads are narrow, winding up hills with trees on both sides. A helpful clue are the lamp posts, which are commonly seen.

When this area appears in a world map, it can be confusing to newer players, as there are very few language or architecture clues available. The washed out early Generation 2 coverage can help with identifying it as being located in Macau.
text_zh: 在澳門南部可以找到一個**多山、** **鄉村風情**的地區。道路狹窄，蜿蜒上山，兩側都是樹木。一個有用的線索是經常可以看到的燈柱。
當這個地區出現在世界地圖上時，對於新玩家來說可能會感到困惑，因為可用的語言或建築線索非常少。早期褪色的第 2 代覆蓋可以幫助辨識其位於澳門。

text: The coverage on the island of Nosy Ambariovato can be recognized by the **people**, one wearing a blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their forehead, one with a light red T-shirt and one with a [darker red tank top](https://goo.gl/maps/sesxVH8xbgjzWWNt8). There is also a [fourth person](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.4541161,48.3406304,2a,64.5y,249.26h,65.91t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sx4Wu5e_usfrumoBchBeMCQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) in some of the coverage, wearing a light blue T-shirt. The coverage is very hilly and forested.
text_zh: 諾西昂巴里瓦托島（Nosy Ambariovato）上的覆蓋可以透過**人物**來辨識：一人穿著藍色 T 恤、額頭上戴著太陽眼鏡，一人穿著淺紅色 T 恤，另一人穿著[較深紅色的背心](https://goo.gl/maps/sesxVH8xbgjzWWNt8)。在某些覆蓋中還有[第四個人](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.4541161,48.3406304,2a,64.5y,249.26h,65.91t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sx4Wu5e_usfrumoBchBeMCQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)，穿著淺藍色 T 恤。該覆蓋地區多山且森林密布。

text: A beach west of Ambiky can be recognized by the **low trees** combined with low mountains to the northwest.
text_zh: 安比基以西的海灘可以透過**矮樹**結合西北方的低矮山脈來辨識。

text: Baobab Avenue is easy to recognize by the extremely **broad trunked** baobab trees along the side of the road.
text_zh: 猴麵包樹大道（Baobab Avenue）很容易透過路旁極其**粗幹**的猴麵包樹來辨識。

text: A small part of the coverage in Tsaranoro was taken inside a forest, which occasionally hides the surrounding mountains. The best way to recognize this area is the relatively **dark coverage**, combined with the four people following the trekker.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅的一小部分街景覆蓋是在森林內部拍攝的，這偶爾會遮蔽周圍的山脈。辨識這個區域的最佳方式是相對**昏暗的街景覆蓋**，結合跟著徒步拍攝的四個人。

text: The second part with the same two people is found to the east of St Augustin, going through a **hilly landscape** with a lot of shrubs.
text_zh: 第二段有著同樣兩個人，位在 St Augustin 東側，會穿過一片有許多灌木的**起伏山丘景觀**。

text: Similar to continental Portugal, Madeira has a lot of **eucalyptus forests**, which can sometimes look deceptively [like the mainland](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iPZqubcw1HMTrzAi9).
NOTE: The Azores do not commonly have eucalypti.
text_zh: 類似葡萄牙本土，馬德拉島有許多**尤加利樹**，有時候看起來會讓人誤以為是[本土](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iPZqubcw1HMTrzAi9)。
注意：亞克里斯群島通常沒有尤加利樹。

text: The eastern tip of the island is very arid with little to no vegetation.
text_zh: 該島的最東端非常乾旱，幾乎沒有植被。

text: The Niono mosque is located in a **busy area** by the side of a wide, sandy and fairly dirty road, with trees right by the walls of the mosque.
It is most easily located on the map by first looking for the “Centre Commercial” slightly north of the centre of Niono.
text_zh: 尼奧諾清真寺位於一條寬闊、沙多且相當骯髒的道路旁之**熱鬧區域**，清真寺的牆壁旁就有樹木。
在地圖上最容易找到它的方式，是先尋找尼奧諾市中心略北方的「Centre Commercial」。

text: The exterior of the mosque in Gao can be recognised by the **large desolate space** outside the walls, the ground consisting of reddish dirt, and some trees in the background.
text_zh: 加奧清真寺的外部可以透過牆外**寬敞荒涼的空間**、呈現紅褐色泥土的地基，以及背景中的幾棵樹來辨識。

text: The Djenné mosque has a very recognizable front, with some distant trees and a **clear sky**. The mosque is surrounded by low houses, making the area look fairly open.
text_zh: 傑內清真寺有一個非常好辨認的正面，配上一些遠處的樹木和**晴朗的天空**。清真寺周圍環繞著低矮的房屋，使得該區域看起來相當開闊。

text: The Mopti mosque is similar in style to the Djenne mosque, but has **trees growing closer** to the walls and a slight amount of clouds in the sky. The streets with coverage around the walls of the mosque also appear more [narrow](https://goo.gl/maps/wYkmJf6fUAN6Fp2J7) than the ones in Djenne.
text_zh: 莫普提清真寺的風格與傑內清真寺相似，但**樹木生長得更靠近**牆壁，天空中也有少許雲朵。清真寺牆壁周圍有街景的街道也顯得比傑內的街道[更窄](https://goo.gl/maps/wYkmJf6fUAN6Fp2J7)。

text: This natural **rocky gorge **is part of the [Bandiagara Escarpment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bandiagara_Escarpment). It features dry trees and bushes following the path. It is located southwest of Sangha Ogol Leye, and is the only completely rural coverage in Mali.
text_zh: 這個自然的**岩石峽谷**是[邦賈加拉懸崖](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bandiagara_Escarpment)的一部分。它以沿著小徑的枯樹和灌木為特色。它位於桑加奧戈爾萊耶（Sangha Ogol Leye）的西南方，是馬利唯一完全位於鄉村的街景。

text: The general landscape of Malta consists of slightly hilly **dry agricultural fields**. Many roads are also only 1 or 2 lanes wide, due to the island’s size. Having a mediterranean climate, [cacti](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kh2pMFPUTQhivKT76#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) and various [dry shrubs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BqgdrBxdG2UFft3z7#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) can be seen.
text_zh: 馬爾他的整體地景由微坡的**乾燥農田**組成。由於島嶼的面積，許多道路也只有 1 或 2 個車道寬。由於擁有地中海氣候，可以看到[仙人掌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kh2pMFPUTQhivKT76#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)和各種[乾燥灌木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BqgdrBxdG2UFft3z7#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)。

text: Habitation Clément is a **rum distillery** covered by a trekker. Due to it being pinpointable, some locations are on maps such as [ACW](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914). There are several landscapes in and around the distillery, including:
- A [warehouse](https://goo.gl/maps/zSrUUsk3JPYyyP8YA) with a truck and a forklift.
- A [view of the outside](https://goo.gl/maps/FW2mfgwes23dj1yd6) with hills in the background and machinery on display.
- A [rural dirt track](https://goo.gl/maps/3Wx7QjXUcCUVRuRU9) outside with red soil and palm trees.
- The [inside of the distillery](https://goo.gl/maps/mnoysxVXLY5VZBpN7) with the structure made of H-beam steel.
text_zh: 克萊芒莊園（Habitation Clément）是一個有徒步拍攝覆蓋的**蘭姆酒蒸餾廠**。由於它是可精準定位的，因此有些位置會出現在諸如 [ACW](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914) 等地圖上。蒸餾廠內外有幾種景觀，包括：
- 一個有卡車和堆高機的[倉庫](https://goo.gl/maps/zSrUUsk3JPYyyP8YA)。
- 一個[戶外景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/FW2mfgwes23dj1yd6)，背景有山丘並展示著機械。
- 外部的[農村泥土小徑](https://goo.gl/maps/3Wx7QjXUcCUVRuRU9)，有著紅土和棕櫚樹。
- 蒸餾廠[內部](https://goo.gl/maps/mnoysxVXLY5VZBpN7)，其結構由 H 型鋼梁製成。

text: The **coastal southern trekker** can be recognized by a few unique things:
- [In the north](https://goo.gl/maps/pApNFF5yFbPfWrry5), the trekker starts off walking on a slightly hilly path, with other people.
- [Several houses](https://goo.gl/maps/XxD6aTzoBNrF5qPF9) with orange roofs can be seen.
- [A flatter and more open path](https://goo.gl/maps/DGkgXWthbCLEnskA7) can be seen, with the ocean slightly visible through the trees.
- [The coverage ends in the south](https://goo.gl/maps/9DxD1KWqV83XHPzh7) with a car park and some stalls.
text_zh: **南部沿海徒步拍攝**可以透過幾件獨特的事情來辨識：
