- [在北部](https://goo.gl/maps/pApNFF5yFbPfWrry5)，徒步拍攝一開始是走在稍微起伏的小徑上，旁邊有其他人。
- 可以看到[幾棟](https://goo.gl/maps/XxD6aTzoBNrF5qPF9)有橘色屋頂的房子。
- 可以看到[一條更平坦、更開闊的小徑](https://goo.gl/maps/DGkgXWthbCLEnskA7)，透過樹木隱約能看到海洋。
- [覆蓋在南部結束](https://goo.gl/maps/9DxD1KWqV83XHPzh7)，有一個停車場和一些攤位。

text: The Jardin de Balata trekker is the most **tropical** and **humid** feeling on Martinique. The trekker can be recognized by dark and damp feeling, the trees with [buttress roots](https://goo.gl/maps/kmvFzPJvGuvtoBtj6), [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/qBrahrtWA29634dU6) and [bamboo](https://goo.gl/maps/NDEVBU9sPAfnhvF6A). [This man](https://goo.gl/maps/Z3eXTHiJwapSoPU17) wearing a black shirt and grey cap can sometimes be seen with the trekker.
text_zh: 巴拉達花園（Jardin de Balata）徒步拍攝是馬丁尼克感覺最**熱帶**且最**潮濕**的。這個徒步拍攝可以透過黑暗潮濕的感覺、帶有[板根](https://goo.gl/maps/kmvFzPJvGuvtoBtj6)的樹木、[蕨類](https://goo.gl/maps/qBrahrtWA29634dU6)和[竹子](https://goo.gl/maps/NDEVBU9sPAfnhvF6A)來辨識。[這個人](https://goo.gl/maps/Z3eXTHiJwapSoPU17)穿著黑色襯衫戴著灰色帽子，有時會和徒步拍攝一起出現。

text: Yucca filifera, also known as **tree yucca**, as well as yucca decipiens are most commonly seen in San Luis Potosi and Zacatecas as well as some of the bordering northern states. They can be recognised by their oblong rosettes of sharp green leaves branching from a single trunk, similar to a tree.
text_zh: 絲蘭（Yucca filifera，也被稱為**樹絲蘭**）以及德西皮恩絲蘭最常見於聖路易波托西州和薩卡特卡斯州，以及一些北部邊境州。它們可以透過從單一主幹分枝、類似樹木的尖銳綠葉長橢圓形蓮座叢來辨認。

text: **Sabal palms **are most commonly observed in the east coast of Mexico, the Yucatan peninsula, as well as the state of Nayarit. They feature a spiky, sun-shaped crown, giving the tree a** lollipop-like **appearance.
text_zh: **沼生棕櫚**最常在墨西哥東海岸、猶加敦半島以及納亞里特州被觀察到。它們具有帶刺、太陽形狀的樹冠，賦予樹木**棒棒糖般**的外觀。

text: The **Attalea rostrata **is a huge palm recognizable from its upright leaves, almost resembling an umbrella. It is mostly exclusive to Veracruz and Tabasco, and can be rarely found in Chiapas.
text_zh: **美洲王棕**是一種巨大的棕櫚樹，以其直立的葉子而聞名，幾乎像是一把雨傘。它主要分布在韋拉克魯斯和塔巴斯科，在恰帕斯則較少見。

text: **Oil palm plantations **are most common in Chiapas, and occasionally on the outskirts of the state in Veracruz, Tabasco, and Campeche.
text_zh: **油棕園**最常見於恰帕斯州，偶爾也出現在該州周邊的韋拉克魯斯州、塔巴斯科州和坎佩切州。

text: **Boojum trees** can be recognized by their alien, **tentacle**-like appearance. They are almost exclusively found in the southern half of Baja California.
text_zh: **象鼻樹**可以透過其異形、**觸手**般的外觀來辨認。它們幾乎只分佈在下加利福尼亞州南部。

text: **Brittlebush** are small shrubs with bright **silver-grey** leaves that are most commonly found in Sonora, especially around Hermosillo.
text_zh: **刺葉灌木**是小型灌木，帶有明亮的**銀灰色**葉子，最常見於索諾拉州，特別是在埃莫西索周圍。

text: These **thin, white-barked **trees can be found in the Yucatan peninsula, but are most prevalent in Quintana Roo.
text_zh: 這些**白色薄皮的**樹木可以在猶加敦半島找到，但在金塔納羅奧州最為普遍。

text: The western parts of Chihuahua and Durango can feature a rocky mountainous landscape covered with **pine forests**. In general, these pines are shorter and more **stunted **in appearance than pine forests of the central or south.
text_zh: 奇ihuahua州和杜蘭戈州的西部地區可能具有覆蓋著**松林**的岩石山地景觀。一般來說，與中部或南部的松林相比，這些松樹外觀更矮、更**發育不良**。

text: These **red agricultural fields** surrounded by dense forests of tropical trees are most common in northern Campeche.
text_zh: 這些被熱帶樹木茂密森林包圍的**紅色農田**最常見於坎佩切州北部。

text: **Mud brick** buildings are most abundant in Durango, especially full houses constructed with mud brick. However, they can essentially be found in almost all of the dry desert states.
text_zh: **土磚**建築在杜蘭戈州最為豐富，特別是用土磚建造的完整房屋。然而，它們基本上可以在幾乎所有乾燥的沙漠州找到。

text: These fences made out of trees with **red-coloured bark **are commonly found in Veracruz.
NOTE: These tree fences can still be found in other coastal states and are best utilised when combined with other clues.
text_zh: 這些由帶有**紅色樹皮**的樹木所組成的籬笆常見於韋拉克魯斯州（Veracruz）。
注意：這些樹籬仍然可以在其他沿海各州找到，最好與其他線索結合使用。

text: The area around Poza Rica in Veracruz features a lot of **citrus tree plantations**. It is common to see large amounts of these trees grown right on top of the hills.
text_zh: 韋拉克魯斯州（Veracruz）的波薩里卡（Poza Rica）周邊地區有許多**柑橘類樹木種植園**。常見到大量這些樹木直接生長在山丘頂部。

text: The outskirts of Ciudad Juárez features a lot of dirt roads with a distinct shade of **orange soil **and **low shrubs**.
text_zh: 華雷斯城的市郊有許多土路，帶有明顯的 **橘色土壤** 色調和 **低矮灌木**。

text: The 54 is a divided highway that runs through northeastern Zacatecas which features **yucca trees** spammed on both sides of the road. Additionally, the streetview car is often exposed and appears almost [white](https://goo.gl/maps/BfA6FLRVcL371P9z9) due to the sunlight.
text_zh: 54 號公路是一條貫穿薩卡特卡斯州東北部的分道公路，道路兩側長滿了 **絲蘭樹**。此外，街景車經常曝光過度，在陽光下看起來幾乎呈 [白色](https://goo.gl/maps/BfA6FLRVcL371P9z9)。

text: Monaco is a **hilly** country. The very few areas that are not built up show mediterranean vegetation.
text_zh: 摩納哥是一個**多山**的國家。極少數未開發的地區則展現出地中海植被。

text: Planted **palm trees** are common.
text_zh: 人工種植的**棕櫚樹**很常見。

text: Mongolia can typically be identified by the **steppe biomes** found across the country. While some forested areas are found in Mongolia, most of the country features empty grasslands or deserts with a characteristic **lack of trees**. It is not uncommon to find rugged, rocky or rolling hills as well as rivers and lakes across Mongolia.
text_zh: 蒙古通常可以透過全國各地的**草原生物群系**來識別。雖然蒙古有一些森林地區，但大部分地區都是空曠的草原或沙漠，並具有明顯**缺乏樹木**的特徵。在蒙古各地發現崎嶇、岩石或起伏的山丘以及河流和湖泊並不罕見。

text: You can find **forests**, typically surrounded by grassy fields, all around northern Mongolia. Generally these will be Siberian Larches, with pines and birches being common as well.
text_zh: 你可以在蒙古北部各處找到通常被草地包圍的**森林**。這些通常是西伯利亞落葉松，松樹和樺樹也很常見。

text: There are several areas with off-road **desert **coverage in southern Mongolia. Most of this coverage is directly south or east of the town of Mandalgovi.
text_zh: 蒙古南部有幾個越野**沙漠**街景區域。大部分這些街景都位於曼德戈壁鎮的正南方或東方。

text: There are a couple of **paved desert roads** in southern Mongolia.
_You can learn more about these roads later in the guide._
text_zh: 蒙古南部有幾條**鋪設的沙漠公路**。
_你可以在本攻略稍後了解更多關於這些道路的資訊。_

text: You can find arid steppe rangeland, characterised by the **coarse soil**, **patchy grass**, and** small shrubs**, throughout southwestern Mongolia.
text_zh: 你可以在整個蒙古西南部找到乾旱的草原牧場，其特點是**粗糙的土壤**、**斑駁的草地**和**小型灌木**。

text: Fall coverage in Mongolia gives rise to very distinct **orange-coloured trees and grass**, and can only be found in a few areas; mostly between the towns of Lun and Hatgal, with some fall coverage [around Ulaanbaatar](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.866984,107.188701,3a,133.2y,235.5h,85.21t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1saIpt9aZkRkOjlFykNBDfwg!2e0). Trees are more commonly seen the further north you are.

NOTE: Some of the generation 4 coverage in [Ulaanbaatar](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9189445,107.4492844,3a,75y,185.1h,91.89t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smK-88Jih1bfOYeF2tjMvsw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) was also taken in the fall.
text_zh: 蒙古的秋季街景會呈現出非常明顯的**橘色樹木和草地**，且只能在少數幾個區域找到；大多在倫鎮和哈特高鎮之間，部分秋季街景[分佈在烏蘭巴托周圍](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.866984,107.188701,3a,133.2y,235.5h,85.21t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1saIpt9aZkRkOjlFykNBDfwg!2e0)。越往北走，越常看到樹木。
註：[烏蘭巴托](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9189445,107.4492844,3a,75y,185.1h,91.89t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smK-88Jih1bfOYeF2tjMvsw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的一些第四代街景也是在秋天拍攝的。

text: Around the town of Bugant is a large forest that stands out for having **narrow dirt trails** with** close trees**, typically on both sides, in a way that can appear quite Russian. Additionally, it is very common to see [birches](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.564103,107.379264,3a,133.2y,330.1h,93.54t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1syWqZgKrvLoKxZ8db1nZrRA!2e0) around this area.
Keep in mind that the dirt trails in this forest do not appear on the map.
text_zh: 布甘特鎮周圍有一片大森林，其特色是擁有**狹窄的泥土小徑**以及兩側**緊鄰的樹木**，這種風格看起來相當俄羅斯。此外，在該地區周圍看到[樺樹](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.564103,107.379264,3a,133.2y,330.1h,93.54t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1syWqZgKrvLoKxZ8db1nZrRA!2e0)非常普遍。
請記住，這片森林中的泥土小徑並不會顯示在地圖上。

text: The Choir Highway is the longest covered paved road in Mongolia, running from [Nalaikh](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.77658,107.232478,3a,133.2y,171.4h,93.00t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sFWvQqwHIvkCGtHsoz1mhYA!2e0) down to [Zamiin-Uud](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.716706,111.904061,3a,133.2y,314.6h,93.81t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sZbWIuL1uDQQ2yFg9dpxsnw!2e0) on the Chinese border, and is **mostly desert**. The dry brown soil, lack of vegetation, clear skies, and general flatness are all characteristic of this road. Additionally, a [railroad](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.718626,109.503585,3a,17.5y,216.0h,91.07t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQf6QlyXzxFZUV3dC4ir_1Q!2e0) runs along the entire highway, which can be seen **west **of the highway north of Sainshand, and **east **of the highway south of Sainshand. Between the towns of Sainshand and Erdene there is some [overcast coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.7715611,110.4184031,3a,90y,294.3h,90t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8C5NF-mzJwNxjCkq1w7yfQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 喬伊爾公路是蒙古覆蓋範圍最長的鋪設公路，從[納來哈](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.77658,107.232478,3a,133.2y,171.4h,93.00t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sFWvQqwHIvkCGtHsoz1mhYA!2e0)一直延伸到中國邊境的[扎門烏德](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.716706,111.904061,3a,133.2y,314.6h,93.81t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sZbWIuL1uDQQ2yFg9dpxsnw!2e0)，且**大多為沙漠**。乾燥的棕色土壤、缺乏植被、晴朗的天空以及整體平坦都是這條公路的特徵。此外，整條公路旁都有一條[鐵路](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.718626,109.503585,3a,17.5y,216.0h,91.07t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQf6QlyXzxFZUV3dC4ir_1Q!2e0)，在賽音山達以北位於公路**西**側，在賽音山達以南則位於公路**東**側。在賽音山達鎮和額爾登鎮之間有一些[陰天街景](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.7715611,110.4184031,3a,90y,294.3h,90t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8C5NF-mzJwNxjCkq1w7yfQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: The other main desert highway in Mongolia runs through Mandalgovi, and can be differentiated from the Choir Highway by its **cloudy skies**, darker pavement, and deep blue tent instead of the tentless car.
text_zh: 蒙古的另一條主要沙漠公路穿過曼德戈壁，可以透過其**多雲的天空**、較深的鋪面以及深藍色帳篷（而不是無帳篷的車輛）來與喬伊爾公路區分。

text: In the eastern grasslands, the Street View car has a **light blue tent** and a forward-facing snorkel.
text_zh: 在東部草原上，Google 車配有**淺藍色帳篷**和朝前的呼吸管。

text: North of Ulaanbaatar you can find this car, which has the same blue tent as the eastern tent, but with a **backwards-facing snorkel**. The snorkel can sometimes be difficult to see, so use other additional clues such as rolling hills and forests to confirm the region.

NOTE: The highway in pink can have either the blue tent car or the [tentless car with snow coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.326546,106.221693,3a,133.2y,12.7h,98.90t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1so4HCVsdnYFYZfYe2PtP_Jw!2e0).
text_zh: 在烏蘭巴托北方可以找到這輛車，它擁有和東部帳篷相同的藍色帳篷，但配備了**朝後的呼吸管**。呼吸管有時很難看清楚，因此請利用起伏丘陵和森林等其他額外線索來確認區域。
注意：粉紅色標示的公路可能會出現藍色帳篷車，或是[帶有雪景的無帳篷車](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.326546,106.221693,3a,133.2y,12.7h,98.90t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1so4HCVsdnYFYZfYe2PtP_Jw!2e0)。

text: Erdenet is the second largest city in Mongolia. As such, it has many multistory buildings that can be seen from across town, a large stadium, and a **ferris wheel** in the south of the city. It is surrounded by large barren hills to the south and to the north, and was covered on a **cloudy day **in the** winter**, meaning all vegetation is dead.

NOTE: Erdenet can look very similar to Darkhan and Ulaanbaatar, but the lack of snow distinguishes it from [Darkhan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6), while the cloudy skies and lack of rubber inlays on the roof racks can be used to distinguish it from [Ulaanbaatar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59).
text_zh: 額爾登特是蒙古第二大城。因此，它有許多從城鎮各處都能看見的多層樓建築、大型體育場，以及位於該市南方的**摩天輪**。城鎮南北兩側都被大型的貧瘠丘陵環繞，拍攝時正逢**冬季的陰天**，意味著所有植被都已枯死。
注意：額爾登特看起來可能非常像達爾漢和烏蘭巴托，但沒有積雪這點可以將它與[達爾漢](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6)區分開來，而陰暗的天空以及車頂架上沒有橡膠嵌件，則可以用來將它與[烏蘭巴托](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59)區分開來。

text: Sukhbaatar and Altanbulag are two neighbouring towns in the north near the Russian border. They have dry, forested hills all around and heavy **overcast coverage**. Sukhbaatar is completely overcast while Altanbulag is slightly less cloudy.

NOTE: [Murun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NnM6SDXQ8Ysi9xED8) and [Choibalsan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/68m1Tx62pZ5AtmuY8) are two other towns that also have overcast coverage, but lack forested hills and have different Street View cars.
text_zh: 蘇赫巴托（Sukhbaatar）與阿爾坦布拉格（Altanbulag）是位於北方接近俄羅斯邊境的兩個相鄰城鎮。它們周圍都是乾燥的森林山丘，且有厚重的**陰天街景**。蘇赫巴托完全是陰天，而阿爾坦布拉格則稍微沒那麼多雲。
注意：[木倫](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NnM6SDXQ8Ysi9xED8)與[喬巴山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/68m1Tx62pZ5AtmuY8)是另外兩個也有陰天街景的城鎮，但缺少森林山丘，且使用不同的 Google 車。

text: Sainshand is the largest town in the desert region and it has a dry climate, many buildings, and paved roads. A **dry ridge** separates the northern and southern parts of the town, distinguishing Sainshand from other desert towns that are mostly flat. In the downtown area you can find a miniature [pink eiffel tower](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.8922678,110.138733,3a,90y,124.45h,93.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1HmF0u7fsDOuxWWcAchIIA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 賽音山達（Sainshand）是沙漠地區最大的城鎮，擁有乾燥的氣候、許多建築物和鋪面道路。一條**乾燥的山脊**將城鎮的南北兩側分隔開來，這點讓賽音山達有別於其他多數平坦的沙漠城鎮。在市中心可以找到一座縮小版的[粉紅艾菲爾鐵塔](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.8922678,110.138733,3a,90y,124.45h,93.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1HmF0u7fsDOuxWWcAchIIA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: The desert town of Zamiin-Uud on the border with China has unique **sailboat lamp posts **featuring a** golden flower pot** around them. Often, white signs with Mongolian folded script can be seen attached to these lamp posts.

NOTE: The other desert towns of Choir and Sainshand look similar to Zamiin-Uud and have the same Street View car but use different lamp posts. Choir can be identified by its [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.356902,108.371902,3a,110.3y,325.7h,98.24t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s6djXgVDAZ-fDj71h8NhXQA!2e0) lamp posts and Sainshand by its [white](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.893259,110.142104,3a,76.1y,92.3h,99.02t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQ5CKt2u89UjuWb7RAyy5ig!2e0) lamp posts.
text_zh: 位於中蒙邊境的沙漠城鎮扎門烏德（Zamiin-Uud）擁有獨特的**風帆燈柱**，燈柱周圍帶有**金色花盆**。通常可以看到附掛在這些燈柱上、寫有蒙古垂直蒙文的白色標牌。

注意：其他沙漠城鎮喬伊爾和賽音山達看起來與扎門烏德相似，並使用相同的 Google 車，但使用的是不同的燈柱。喬伊爾可透過其[藍色](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.356902,108.371902,3a,110.3y,325.7h,98.24t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s6djXgVDAZ-fDj71h8NhXQA!2e0)燈柱辨識，賽音山達則透過其[白色](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.893259,110.142104,3a,76.1y,92.3h,99.02t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQ5CKt2u89UjuWb7RAyy5ig!2e0)燈柱辨識。

text: Mandalgovi is a large desert town with notably **cloudy coverage**. It’s the only large desert town apart from Dalanzadgad which is not on the Choir Highway, and it has a **deep blue tent** instead of the tentless car.
text_zh: 曼達勒戈壁是一個大型沙漠城鎮，擁有明顯的**多雲街景**。它是除了不屬於喬伊爾公路的達蘭扎德嘎德之外，唯一的大型沙漠城鎮，且它配備的是**深藍色帳篷**而不是無帳篷車。

text: In the central town of Tsetserleg, you will see these distinct **rocky**, **rugged hills,** with small trees growing on them to the north. It has very clear skies and the neighbourhoods can often be seen on the hilly slopes.
text_zh: 在中央城鎮策策爾勒格（Tsetserleg），往北看會看到這些獨特的**岩石質**、**崎嶇山丘**，上面生長著小樹。這裡的天空非常晴朗，且經常可以在山坡上看到住宅區。

text: Hatgal is a small lake town on the Khuvsgul Lake. It can be recognized from its **fall coverage **with orange trees and grass, and the **large lake** in the northeast, where the [Khuvsgul Ice Festival](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.5022757,100.1660243,2a,90y,292.3h,91.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8IxMX1A7ghnXLvz5ONqe4Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) is held every year.
text_zh: 哈特嘎（Hatgal）是庫苏古尔湖畔的小鎮。可以從其帶有橘色樹木與草地的**秋季街景覆蓋**，以及東北方的**大湖**（每年都在此舉辦[庫苏古尔冰雪節](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.5022757,100.1660243,2a,90y,292.3h,91.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8IxMX1A7ghnXLvz5ONqe4Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)）辨識出來。

text: Uliastai is a central-western Mongolian town, **surrounded by** **large, green nearby hills**. It is common to see a decent amount of **trees **or the **river **that runs through the town. In the centre of town, you can find a small [hill](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fi4Q82dtsDEW8Ho26) with the Soyombo symbol inscribed on it.
text_zh: 烏里雅蘇台（Uliastai）是蒙古中西部城鎮，**周圍環繞著****附近的大型綠色山丘**。經常可以看到相當數量的**樹木**或流經城鎮的**河流**。在城鎮中心，你可以找到一座刻有索永博符號的小[山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fi4Q82dtsDEW8Ho26)。

text: Khovd is a large, dry and shrubby town, in western Mongolia, that can be identified by the very distinct **rocky, red-tinted hills,** present to the** **north of town.

NOTE: The nearby [Khar-Us](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AM8e1gaheeFvUP5X9), [Tugrug](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NipvfyEBDZw75eLNA), and the samely named [Khovd](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Gg2oVW2ZVEnLyzZ17) have similar landscapes but are much smaller towns.
text_zh: 科布多（Khovd）是蒙古西部一個大型、乾燥且灌木叢生的城鎮，可以透過城鎮**北方**非常明顯的**岩石質、帶紅色的山丘**來識別。
注意：附近的[哈爾烏斯湖](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AM8e1gaheeFvUP5X9)、[圖格里克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NipvfyEBDZw75eLNA)以及同名的[科布多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Gg2oVW2ZVEnLyzZ17)景觀相似，但城鎮規模小得多。

text: East of Uvs lake, you can find a lot of these **small shrubs** and patchy grass in a somewhat flat landscape.

NOTE: Similar shrubs can be found around [Shaazgai Lake](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.234698,91.23369,3a,133.2y,93.5h,88.52t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sp0fw9T6Pm6c030-i807Nmw!2e0), but that area is considerably more hilly.
text_zh: 在烏布蘇湖以東，你可以在相對平坦的景觀中找到許多這些**小灌木**和斑駁的草地。
注意：類似的灌木可以在[沙斯蓋湖](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.234698,91.23369,3a,133.2y,93.5h,88.52t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sp0fw9T6Pm6c030-i807Nmw!2e0)周邊找到，但該地區的山丘要多得多。

text: Khan Khokhii is a national park in northwestern Mongolia with some of the most **dense forests** in the country. It has partially cloudy skies, dark soil, and the western grey tent.
Keep in mind that the trails in this park do not appear on the map.
NOTE: There are other forests in Mongolia, but Khan Khokhii is one of the biggest and one of the only areas where you can be completely surrounded by trees.
text_zh: 汗庫海（Khan Khokhii）是蒙古西北部的一個國家公園，擁有國內一些最**濃密的森林**。這裡有部分多雲的天空、黑色的土壤，以及西方的灰色帳篷。
請記住，這個公園裡的步道並不會顯示在地圖上。
注意：蒙古還有其他森林，但汗庫海是最大的一座，也是少數幾個能讓你完全被樹木包圍的地區之一。

text: This beautiful river valley, just west of Lake Hatgal in the Khoridol Saridag mountains, is very recognizable from the surrounding rocky cliffs and forests, and the ground that is completely **covered in pebbles**.
text_zh: 這個美麗的河谷位於哈特嘎湖以西的科里多爾薩里達格（Khoridol Saridag）山脈中，周圍環繞著岩石峭壁與森林，且地面完全**覆蓋著卵石**，極易辨認。

text: Roads surrounded by** tall and lush trees** on both sides will generally place you in the north of the country. The more trees and the greener they are, the further north-northeast you should click.
text_zh: 兩側被**高大且茂密的樹木**環繞的道路，通常代表你位於該國北部。樹木越多且越綠，你就應該往更北北東的方向點擊。

text: The landscape east of Windhoek closely resembles that of Botswana, with a generally **flat and dry** landscape, featuring** **slightly reddish soil, short **golden grass** and shrubbery, as well as acacia trees.
text_zh: 溫荷克以東的地景與波札那（Botswana）非常相似，大致為**平坦且乾燥**的地景，帶有微紅的土壤、矮小的**金色草叢**與灌木叢，以及金合歡樹。

text: Further northwest, you’ll find a somewhat greener region, where the mountains and hills will be covered in shrubbery and trees.
text_zh: 再往西北方，你會發現一個稍微綠意盎然的區域，那裡的群山與小山丘會覆蓋著灌木叢和樹木。

text: Around Windhoek, you’ll find a small region with a somewhat **dry rolling hills landscape**, with hills that are covered in dry yellow grass and dead-looking bushes and small trees.
text_zh: 在溫荷克周邊，你會發現一個小區域，有著稍微**乾燥的起伏丘陵地景**，山丘覆蓋著乾黃的草、看起來枯死的灌木和小樹。

text: Road A1 between Windhoek and Okahandja, featuring a savannah-like landscape, is just one of two major roads that are **divided** in Namibia. The [other one](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VVjMKLWS9dDQ2qLb8) can be found just southeast of Swakopmund, and features a dry coastal landscape, with light sandy soil and sand dunes.
text_zh: 位於溫荷克和奧卡漢賈（Okahandja）之間的 A1 公路具有疏林草原般的景觀，是納米比亞僅有的兩條主要**分隔**道路之一。[`另一條`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VVjMKLWS9dDQ2qLb8)可以在斯瓦科普穆德東南側找到，具有乾燥的海岸地景，帶有輕薄的沙土與沙丘。

text: Road B1 south of Grunau is a desolate paved road going generally N-NE through a desert landscape with only very low and dry vegetation.
text_zh: 格魯瑙（Grunau）南側的 B1 公路是一條荒涼的鋪裝道路，大致朝北北東方向穿過沙漠地景，只有非常矮小且乾燥的植被。

text: North of Okahandja, the B1 follows a general northbound direction, with the sun shining brightly to the N-NW. The sky is otherwise clear of clouds. As for the landscape, it’s flatter than around Windhoek, with only the occasional hill or mountain, otherwise the short golden grass, somewhat green acacia trees and shrubbery further away from the road is typical for middle to north Namibia.
South of Sukses, you’ll see these two pointy [mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDSJUQXQbwBwL9CNA), one of which has a sharper peak than the other, to the west of the road.
text_zh: 奧卡漢賈以北，B1 大致呈向北走向，太陽在 N-NW 方向燦爛地照耀著。除此之外天空晴朗無雲。至於地景部分，它比溫荷克周邊還要平坦，只有零星的小山或山脈，除此之外，短小的金色草叢、離路面較遠且帶點綠意的金合歡樹與灌木叢，是納米比亞中北部典型的景象。
蘇克斯（Sukses）以南，你會在道路西方看到這兩座尖尖的[`山`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDSJUQXQbwBwL9CNA)，其中一座的山峰比另一座更尖銳。

text: This desolate paved road goes in a general E-SE direction through a fairly flat and dry landscape. Small clouds dot the sky. The shrubbery is quite green for the most part, especially in the [east](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J4HCC4RMMBLLk4659), which is also very hilly.
NOTE: The easiest way to tell it apart from parts of the B4 is the eastwards driving direction on this road, as opposed to westwards on the B4.
text_zh: 這條荒涼的鋪裝道路大致朝東東南方向穿過相當平坦且乾燥的地景。天空中點綴著小雲。灌木叢大體上相當翠綠，特別是在[東部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J4HCC4RMMBLLk4659)，那裡也非常多山丘。
注意：要將它與 B4 的部分路段區分開來，最簡單的方法是這條路的行駛方向是向東，而 B4 則是向西。

text: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis, the landscape will seem mostly flat until you reach the [intersection with the D432](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LnyJcQw9FVFwQbiRA), but you can notice the road having a [gradual incline](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uKxxvnhYT7HLAqBk7) for long stretches. The soil around is very red in colour, with limited shrubbery or signs of life. The weather is clear, with some clouds far in the distance.
text_zh: 在道路爬升至庫伊比斯（Kuibis）以東的高原後，直到你抵達[`與 D432 的交會處`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LnyJcQw9FVFwQbiRA)之前，地景看起來大致平坦，但你可以注意到道路有[`長距離的漸進式爬坡`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uKxxvnhYT7HLAqBk7)。周邊的土壤顏色非常紅，幾乎沒有灌木叢或生命跡象。天氣晴朗，遠處有些許雲朵。

text: Road B6 goes in a general eastwards direction from Windhoek, with the landscape ranging from [hilly](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HKH2ANTv77TFfAKp8) close to Windhoek, to [mostly flat](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LPHBgkFuNUibVNjm8) closer to Gobabis. The soil is somewhat orange in colour, with short green grass and otherwise green vegetation growing from it. The cloud cover also varies, but no part of this road has a clear sky.
NOTE: The only other similar paved road, road [C39](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gtHvwZTt24sAB3wa8), has brighter soil.
text_zh: B6 公路從溫荷克大致向東延伸，地景從溫荷克附近的[`多山`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HKH2ANTv77TFfAKp8)轉為接近戈巴比斯時的[`大多平坦`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LPHBgkFuNUibVNjm8)。土壤顏色帶點橘色，上面生長著短小的綠草以及其他綠色植被。雲量也有所不同，但這條路的任何路段都沒有萬里無雲的天空。
注意：唯一另一條類似的鋪面道路，即[C39](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gtHvwZTt24sAB3wa8)公路，其土壤顏色較明亮。

text: A large rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from the paved C13. Other smaller hills and mountains can be seen in other directions. Light coloured soil hugs the road, while more orange coloured soil can be seen further from the road, with light green vegetation and shrubbery acting as a contrast.
Another easy way to get the road is to look for the [wispy clouds trying to hide the sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PrvocmJ5bXzvv823A) in the east.
text_zh: 從鋪裝的 C13 往西方望去，可以看到大型的峻峭山脈地形。其他方向則可見其他較小的小山丘和山脈。淺色土壤緊貼著道路，而距離道路較遠處則可見更偏橘色的土壤，並以淺綠色的植被和灌木叢作為對比。
取得這條路的另一種簡單方法是尋找東方[`試圖遮蔽太陽的輕薄捲雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PrvocmJ5bXzvv823A)。

text: Red tinted and slightly grainy pavement along with the green savannah-like grassy landscape crowned with [low-lying cumulus clouds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sThNdCyePnA6XouS9) can be used to recognise the northern section of road C35.
text_zh: 帶有紅色調且微帶顆粒的鋪面，搭配點綴著[`低矮積雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sThNdCyePnA6XouS9)的綠色疏林草原般草地景觀，可用來辨識 C35 公路的北部路段。

text: South of the C41 intersection, the road loses its red pavement, and the quality worsens. The landscape is less grassy, and more sandy, with [hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HByXtaekqiaUQGk77) to the west, though often hidden behind the vegetation. The road generally goes in a S-SE direction. Further south, it gets hillier, and parts will have a more SE bound angle. The sky is consistently covered by scattered [cirrostratus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6hbEGCHVQJKwN58A) and [cumulus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d26SpmrumkcZVnv36) clouds.
text_zh: 在 C41 交會處以南，道路失去了紅色鋪面，品質也隨之惡化。地景上的草變少、沙變多，西方有[`山丘`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HByXtaekqiaUQGk77)，雖然經常被植被遮擋。道路大致呈南南東走向。再往南走，地勢變得更多山，部分路段的走向會更偏東南。天空一直被散布的[`卷層雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6hbEGCHVQJKwN58A)和[`積雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d26SpmrumkcZVnv36)所覆蓋。

text: The C38 is yet another indistinct paved northern road with sandy soil, somewhat green vegetation and short grass lining the road. The sky, which is covered with a spotty blanket of clouds, is generally the most distinct clue. The [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SY2Uwe1FJgutDk4QA) is faintly shining through the clouds to the north.
text_zh: C38 是另一條特徵不明顯的北部鋪裝道路，沿路有著沙質土壤、微綠的植被和短草。天空通常是最明顯的線索，上面覆蓋著一塊塊斑駁的雲被。[`太陽`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SY2Uwe1FJgutDk4QA)微弱地透過北方的雲層照射下來。

text: Most of the C39 travels through a wide valley, with small vegetation-covered hills on both sides, which are mostly visible to the [north](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z4Efxbhd9wpBQ5AR7). The N-NE angle and puffy cumulus clouds dotting the sunny sky are also noteworthy.
text_zh: C39 的大部分路段穿過一個寬闊的山谷，兩側都是覆蓋著植被的小山丘，大多可以在[`北方`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z4Efxbhd9wpBQ5AR7)看見。北北東走向以及點綴著晴朗天空的蓬鬆積雲也值得注意。

text: The C40 has a general NW angle going through flat terrain with the usual northern landscape of short grass next to the road, trees further away and some hills further in the distance. Similar to the C39, a lot of cumulus clouds dot the sky, and the closer to Kamanjab you get, the lower the [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3hJec6yLcs49L6SA) sets to the west.
text_zh: C40 具有大致西北走向，穿過平坦地形，沿路有著北部常見的短草地景、較遠處的樹木以及更遠處的一些山丘。與 C39 類似，天空中點綴著許多積雲，而且你離卡曼賈布越近，[`太陽`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3hJec6yLcs49L6SA)在西方落得越低。

text: The C44 is a** wide unpaved sandy road** lined with trees, easily recognised from the general E-SE angle, and the **westbound driving direction**.
NOTE: The [D3301](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wdf7hyQBdEfnhgXr8), a bit further south looks similar, but the soil is generally much redder, and the car is driving east.
text_zh: C44 是一條**寬闊的未鋪裝沙路**，兩旁有樹木排列，從大致的 E-SE 角度以及**西向行駛方向**很容易辨認。
注意：[D3301](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wdf7hyQBdEfnhgXr8) 稍微再南方一點，看起來很相似，但土壤通常紅得多，而且車輛正向東行駛。

text: Gobabis is a big** north-south gridded** city in the desert, with** red soil** permeating the landscape and roads, which are very often unpaved. A faint green ridge is sometimes visible to the north to northwest. The [street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yc9JLDVMMF9166Go7), while rare, are also green, with silver framing on the top and bottom. [Blue bins](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEKjHa3Md6L2VEtr8) are also a good clue for Gobabis.
text_zh: 戈巴比斯 (Gobabis) 是沙漠中一個很大的**南北向網格狀**城市，景觀與道路中充斥著**紅土**，且大多是未鋪裝的泥土路。北方到西北方偶爾可見一道淡淡的綠色山脊。[路標](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yc9JLDVMMF9166Go7)雖然罕見，但也是綠色的，上下有銀色邊框。[藍色垃圾桶](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEKjHa3Md6L2VEtr8)也是判斷戈巴比斯的好線索。

text: Oranjemund is a well-off gridded city with almost exactly east to west streets, with an abundance of** planted vegetation** all around the city. Multiple [Norfolk pines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3Su4Jd2vpxZqgDCA) can be seen almost everywhere. Streets are well organised with E-W avenues and N-S streets, which can be seen written on [small blue markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3pZrSDpLRb4ZCa5E6) next to the gates or on [street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zQgR2ugtF3LkBsoZ7), which have varying designs.
text_zh: 奧蘭治蒙德（Oranjemund）是一座富裕的棋盤狀城市，街道幾乎呈正東西走向，全市周圍有大量**人工植被**。幾乎隨處可見多棵[諾福克島杉](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3Su4Jd2vpxZqgDCA)。街道規劃完善，擁有東西向的大道和南北向的街道，這些名稱可以寫在大門旁或[路標](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3pZrSDpLRb4ZCa5E6)上的[小型藍色標記](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zQgR2ugtF3LkBsoZ7)上，其設計各有不同。

text: Orange coloured **thatched fences**, **walls**, and **huts **are everywhere in the desert town of Aussenkehr, which is built on the [slope](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h6kpwafSqasy6Q7k6) of a hill.
text_zh: 橙色的**茅草圍欄**、**牆壁**和**小屋**在沙漠城鎮奧森凱爾（Aussenkehr）隨處可見，該鎮建立在山丘的[斜坡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h6kpwafSqasy6Q7k6)上。

text: The landscape of Aus is very rocky, with dry hills devoid of vegetation all around. The hills to the north have a fairly [smooth sloped shape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikY4ReviAoc2v2iB9), while the peaks to the south are [more rugged](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vd5ixxRnz7hyxA6q9).
text_zh: 奧斯（Aus）的景觀非常岩石化，周圍都是缺乏植被的乾旱山丘。北部的山丘具有相當[平緩的斜坡形狀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikY4ReviAoc2v2iB9)，而南部的山峰則[更加崎嶇](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vd5ixxRnz7hyxA6q9)。

text: **Orange coloured mountains**, which are covered in** green vegetation** surround the partly hilly town of Opuwo, from where you have a [great vantage point](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwNYhsFjQYfs1DZm9) of the mountains.
text_zh: **橘色的山脈**覆蓋著**綠色植被**，環繞著部分多山的城鎮奧普沃（Opuwo），從那裡您可以擁有[絕佳的視角](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwNYhsFjQYfs1DZm9)欣賞群山。

text: From almost anywhere in Karibib the dark silhouette of [Erongo Mountain](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VZT5WhPkZaDvGadR9) can be seen to the north. Dry [hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ix95xqTwU1d6oC1g7) covered in shrubbery flank the town to the south.
text_zh: 從卡里比卜（Karibib）的幾乎任何地方，都可以看到[埃龍戈山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VZT5WhPkZaDvGadR9)黑暗的剪影位於北方。覆蓋著灌木叢的乾旱[山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ix95xqTwU1d6oC1g7)在南方夾擊著城鎮。

text: Ariamsvlei can be recognised by a single flat-topped hill with rocky ridgelines near the top, and small amounts of green shrubbery dotting the slopes. The hill is either to the north, or east, depending on the part of town. The soil has a dark red tint to it, with lots of bushes and small trees growing around the place.
text_zh: 阿里姆斯弗雷（Ariamsvlei）的識別特徵是附近有一座頂部平坦、稜線多岩石的孤山，山坡上點綴著少量的綠色灌木。根據你所在的城鎮區域，這座山可能位在北方或東方。這裡的土壤帶有深紅色調，四周生長著許多灌木和小樹。

text: The western hills can be recognised by the **dry landscape**, with a lot of exposed hillsides lacking vegetation.
text_zh: 西部山丘的特徵是**乾燥的景觀**，許多裸露的山坡缺乏植被。

text: Japanese cedar trees, which are only found in far eastern Nepal, can typically be recognised by their significant height combined with their narrow, fluffy-looking crowns.
text_zh: 日本柳杉（Japanese cedar trees）僅見於尼泊爾極東部，通常可透過其顯著的高度結合狹窄、蓬鬆外觀的樹冠來辨識。

text: This foggy and gloomy road hosts the only natural forest dominated by east himalayan fir. You can recognise it from all the tall dark trees present around the road. It is located just northwest of Bhimeshwor Municipality, east of Kathmandu.
text_zh: 這條充滿霧氣且陰暗的道路擁有唯一以東喜馬拉雅冷杉為主的天然林。你可以從道路周遭所有高大深色的樹木認出它。它位於比梅什沃爾市（Bhimeshwor Municipality）西北方、加德滿都以東。

text: **Green forests** and trees are found in the southern parts of the Nepalese trekker coverage.
text_zh: **綠色森林**與樹木出現在尼泊爾徒步拍攝範圍的南部。

text: A lot of the coverage in the vicinity of Namche Bazar can be summarised as being sunny, with the trails going **close to the treeline**, meaning you will be either near the top of or just above a forest for most of this coverage. You will generally see barren or snowy mountains in some direction.
text_zh: 南崎巴扎（Namche Bazar）附近的許多街景可以總結為天氣晴朗，小徑**接近林木線**，這意味著在大部分的拍攝範圍中，你不是在森林邊緣就是剛好在森林上方。你通常會在某些方向看到荒涼的山脈或雪山。

text: Pangboche is a fairly large settlement with fairly bright coverage. The surrounding landscape mainly consists of **forested mountains** nearby and some taller mountains in the distance.
text_zh: 龐波契（Pangboche）是一個相當大的聚落，街景相當明亮。周遭景觀主要由附近的**森林山脈**和遠處的一些更高山峰組成。

text: Phorste is a fairly scarcely built settlement with a massive **recognizable mountain** close by. There are a lot of dead-looking trees surrounding the village.
text_zh: 弗斯特（Phorste）是一個建築相當稀疏的聚落，附近有一座巨大的**可辨識山峰**。村莊周圍有許多看起來枯死的樹木。

text: Around the southern tip of the Nepalese trekker coverage, you will get this **dark**, overcast coverage inside a forested valley.
text_zh: 在尼泊爾徒步拍攝範圍的最南端附近，你會在森林山谷中看到這種**昏暗**、陰天的街景。

text: North of Phakding you will get more overcast coverage in the same forest valley, however here the coverage is **far brighter**.
text_zh: 在帕克丁（Phakding）北方，你會在同一個森林山谷中遇到更多陰天街景，不過這裡的街景**亮得多**。

text: The valley by Thamu can be recognised by the generally forested mountainsides, combined with the **angle of the valley**, going northwest to southeast.
text_zh: 塔姆（Thamu）旁的山谷可以透過大體上長滿森林的山坡，結合**山谷的角度**（由西北向東南走向）來辨識。

text: Slightly east of Namche Bazar, you can find this very overcast trail following the mountainside. There are still some trees around, and the trail is noticeably **higher** above the valley than other overcast sections with trees.
text_zh: 在南崎巴札（Namche Bazar）稍東的位置，你可以找到這條沿著山腰、天氣非常陰暗的小徑。周圍仍有一些樹木，而且與其他有樹木的陰暗路段相比，這條小徑明顯**高於**河谷。

text: East of the POI called ‘Deboche’, you get this very **overcast forest coverage**. The dirt here is very bright and sandy, which can help differentiate it from the southern trail.
text_zh: 在名為「Deboche」的地標以東，你會看到這種非常**陰暗的森林覆蓋**。這裡的泥土非常明亮且帶有沙質，這有助於它與南部的小徑區分開來。

text: Many rural roads are **lined by rows of trees**.
NOTE: This is also common in Poland.
text_zh: 許多鄉間道路**兩旁種滿一排排樹**。
註：這在波蘭也很常見。

text: The **Veluwe** area is unusually forested for Dutch standards. Some parts feature a very slight amount of elevation.

Some parts of the Veluwe feature old-growth forest, [heath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heath) or sandy soil. This area can [look odd](https://goo.gl/maps/6pZWyZjMDKwaZoGh6) and unlike the rest of the Netherlands if you have never seen it before.
NOTE: Some other natural areas in the Netherlands can have a similar look, but the Veluwe is by far the largest.
text_zh: 以荷蘭標準來看，**費呂沃** 地區的森林異常茂密。某些部分具有非常微幅的地形起伏。
費呂沃的部分地區擁有原始森林、[荒原](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heath) 或沙質土壤。如果你從未見過，這個地區可能會 [看起來很奇特](https://goo.gl/maps/6pZWyZjMDKwaZoGh6)，與荷蘭其他地區不同。
注意：荷蘭的其他一些自然景區也可能具有相似的外觀，但費呂沃是其中最大的一個。

text: It is very common to see ferns growing in forested areas in New Zealand.
text_zh: 在紐西蘭的森林地區看到蕨類植物生長非常普遍。

text: The flatter parts of the Southland and Otago regions can be recognised by their **cold climate** and **sloping, alpine hills**. The vegetation in this area is often quite stunted due to the climate.
text_zh: 南島南部地區和奧塔哥地區較平坦的地方可以透過**寒冷的氣候**和**傾斜的高山丘陵**來識別。由於氣候關係，這裏的植被通常相當矮小。

text: The Southern Alps, a **large, snowy mountain range,** stretches throughout the majority of the South Island. Vegetation on the mountains becomes rarer the further south it is.
text_zh: 南冰川山脈是一個**巨大且積雪的山脈，**貫穿了南島的大部分地區。越往南走，山上的植被就越稀疏。

text: **Tall hedge and tree rows** are particularly common in the Canterbury region. They are mostly found in the Canterbury plains, which comprises very flat, large fields.
Due to Canterbury’s flat landscape, mountains can often be seen in the distance to the west.
NOTE: Hedges that are even taller are common near [Tauranga](https://goo.gl/maps/dddpunZazZYpVCqd8).
text_zh: **高大的樹籬和樹排**在坎特伯雷地區特別常見。它們主要分佈在坎特伯雷平原，該平原由非常平坦的大片田野組成。
由於坎特伯雷平原坦蕩，往西往往可以在遠處看到群山。
注意：更高大的樹籬在[陶朗加](https://goo.gl/maps/dddpunZazZYpVCqd8)附近很常見。

text: The area around Tongariro National Park is identifiable due to the **low-lying volcanic vegetation** in the area. Mount Ruapehu and Mount Tongariro are in the vicinity, and their tops are often covered by clouds.
text_zh: 東加里羅國家公園周邊地區可以透過該地區**低矮的火山植被**來辨識。魯阿佩胡山和東加里羅山就在附近，它們的山頂經常被雲層覆蓋。

text: Coverage on Mount Ruapehu is easily identifiable due to the **dark volcanic landscape **and distinct lack of vegetation.
NOTE: This type of coverage is limited to the roads around the Whakapapa Ski Village.
text_zh: 魯阿佩胡山上的街景覆蓋很容易識別，因為那裏有**黑暗的火山地貌**以及明顯缺乏植被。
注意：這種街景覆蓋僅限於華卡帕帕滑雪村周圍的道路。

text: Banks peninsula, also sometimes called Akaroa, due to the town, is **rocky with grassy hills,** and small patches of trees.
NOTE: This region can sometimes have [gorse](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LYyGqHwwPSzM7dGU9), which are also commonly found on the Otago peninsula.
text_zh: 班克斯半島，有時也因鎮名而稱為阿卡羅阿，地形**多石且有草地山丘，**並有小片樹林。
注意：這個地區有時可能會有[荊豆](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LYyGqHwwPSzM7dGU9)，這在奧塔哥半島也很常見。

text: The region of northern Marlborough, known as [Marlborough Sounds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marlborough_Sounds), has **densely forested mountains protruding from water**.
NOTE: Northern Marlborough is almost exclusively in Generation 4.
text_zh: 馬爾堡北部地區，被稱為[馬爾堡峽灣](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marlborough_Sounds)，擁有**從水中突出的茂密森林山脈**。
注意：馬爾堡北部幾乎完全是第 4 代相機。

text: State Highway 94 is characterised by its dense** **[**red beech**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nothofagus_fusca)** forest **surrounded by **snow-capped mountains**.
text_zh: 94 號省道（State Highway 94）的特徵是周圍環繞著被**雪山**包圍的茂密[**紅山毛櫸**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nothofagus_fusca)**森林**。

text: Shown is a **Köppen climate map** of Nigeria. The climate ranges from tropical rainforest in the [far south](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvLGJLnQZK4qnzn99), where you can find an abundance of palms with lush, green vegetation, to a more arid, [savannah landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SZQcHSZAonH1A9RD6) in the centre, with more scattered trees. In the far north, it transitions to an [arid steppe](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeiAA6fxzbj3gae47) where the vegetation becomes even more sparse.
NOTE: Due to dry/wet seasons, the coverage may look drastically greener/drier than expected for certain latitudes.
text_zh: 圖中顯示的是奈及利亞的**柯本氣候分區圖**。氣候從[極南方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvLGJLnQZK4qnzn99)的熱帶雨林（那裡有豐富的棕櫚樹與蔥鬱的綠色植被）過渡到中央較為乾旱的[疏林草原景觀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SZQcHSZAonH1A9RD6)（伴隨較為散落的樹木）。在極北方，則轉變為[乾旱草原](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeiAA6fxzbj3gae47)，植被變得更加稀疏。
備註：由於乾季與雨季的緣故，某些緯度的街景覆蓋看起來可能會比預期的還要綠得多或乾得多。

text: Benue state can be recognized by the lush, green **grass covered ground**, with **reddish soil**. The vegetation is somewhat scattered, with the grass making way for taller trees. Shorter trees and shrubs between the grass and taller trees are somewhat uncommon. Thatched huts are also common in comparison to other southern states.
NOTE: An abundance of palms should make you lean toward the [bordering southern states](https://maps.app.goo.gl/N5KTikgLk6PNkL9X8) that can look similar.
text_zh: 貝努埃州（Benue state）可以透過蔥鬱的**草皮覆蓋地面**以及**帶紅色的土壤**來辨識。植被有些散落，草地讓位給較高的樹木。草地與較高樹木之間較矮的樹木和灌木相對少見。與其他南部各州相比，茅草屋也很常見。
備註：大量的棕櫚樹應該會讓你傾向於認為是[鄰近的南部各州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/N5KTikgLk6PNkL9X8)，那些地方看起來可能很相似。

text: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state. It is almost entirely covered by **shitcam**, and can be recognized by the scattered trees, **reddish soil**, and **dry grass**.
text_zh: 尼日州是貝努埃州的糞畫質（shitcam）同等版本。它幾乎完全被**糞畫質**覆蓋，可以透過零星的樹木、**紅色的土壤**以及**枯草**來辨認。

text: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more **open** and **arid** landscape compared to Niger state. The tree coverage becomes even more sparse, or there may [not be trees at all](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A). These states are entirely covered by shitcam.
text_zh: 貫穿西北部凱比州（Kebbi）、索科托州（Sokoto）、扎姆法拉州（Zamfara）和卡齊納州（Katsina）的高速公路，其景觀與尼日州相比更加**開闊**與**乾旱**，因而可以辨識出來。樹木覆蓋變得更加稀疏，或者可能[完全沒有樹木](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A)。這些州完全被 shitcam 覆蓋。

text: A **savannah **landscape combined with **rocky hills** can most commonly be seen in the northeast in the states of Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and the north of Taraba. The hills in the **far east and west **of this region are typically [greener](https://goo.gl/maps/Hmbqtpv3fxcGRKuLA)** **and covered in more vegetation compared to the hills toward the middle of the range.
NOTE: Around the city of Gombe, hills composed of softer, [clay-like soil](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUUBKmdGQFN75eP9) can be seen instead.
text_zh: **疏林草原**景觀結合**岩石山丘**最常出現在東北部的高原州（Plateau）、包奇州（Bauchi）、貢貝州（Gombe）、阿達馬瓦州（Adamawa）以及塔拉巴州（Taraba）北部。與山脈中段的山丘相比，該地區**極東與極西**的山丘通常較為[翠綠](https://goo.gl/maps/Hmbqtpv3fxcGRKuLA)**且覆蓋著更多植被**。
備註：在貢貝市周圍，反而可以看到由較軟的[黏土狀土壤](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUUBKmdGQFN75eP9)組成的山丘。

text: A flat landscape with coastal vegetation and **many palms** can be seen east of Lekki. The ground is very **sandy**. Almost all of the coverage is old Generation 3, with a [silver follow car](https://www.google.com/maps/@6.4185992,4.079123,3a,15y,284.01h,83.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTrh0nQY2S9hrUGN-v1ejng!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 雷基（Lekki）以東可以看到帶有海岸植被與**許多棕櫚樹**的平坦景觀。地面非常**沙質**。幾乎所有的覆蓋都是舊的相機世代 3，並配有一台[銀色跟拍車](https://www.google.com/maps/@6.4185992,4.079123,3a,15y,284.01h,83.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTrh0nQY2S9hrUGN-v1ejng!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: The A121 can be recognized by the lush, **tropical **vegetation surrounding the **divided **highway, with a short, concrete median. Being a major highway, many vehicles, especially trucks, can be seen along it.
NOTE: The A232 heading east of Benin City is also divided, however the median is [noticeably wider](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hbkv1uPKkgqTr3hD9) than that of the A121.
text_zh: A121公路可以透過環繞著**雙向分隔**高速公路的蔥鬱**熱帶**植被來辨識，並帶有短小的混凝土中央分隔帶。身為一條主要公路，沿途可以看到許多車輛，尤其是卡車。
備註：貝寧城（Benin City）以東的 A232 也是雙向分隔的，然而其中央分隔帶[明顯比 A121 更寬](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hbkv1uPKkgqTr3hD9)。

text: Northern Mariana Islands have a **tropical climate** with a lot of dense and somewhat low vegetation.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島屬於**熱帶氣候**，擁有大量茂密且稍微低矮的植被。

text: Royal Poinciana, Flamboyant Tree or Flame Tree ([Delonix Regia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delonix_regia)) is the official tree of the Northern Mariana Islands and very common to see in the territory. Its **wide crown** with **bright red flowers** is easy to recognize.
NOTE: This tree is not common in Guam.
text_zh: 鳳凰木、火焰樹（[Delonix Regia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delonix_regia)）是北馬利安納群島的官方代表樹木，在該領土非常常見。它**寬闊的樹冠**和**鮮紅的花朵**很容易辨認。
注意：這種樹在關島並不常見。

text: The largest concentration of farmland is found in the southeast, in the general vicinity of Oslo. The area is **much flatter** than most of the country, and it is common to get a rolling landscape with smooth, round forested hills in the distance. The area southeast of Oslo is particularly flat.
text_zh: 最大面積的農田集中在東南部，大致位於奧斯陸附近。該地區比該國大部分地區**平坦得多**，且常有起伏的地形，遠處可見平緩、圓潤且長滿樹木的山丘。奧斯陸東南部的地區尤其平坦。

text: Distinct, **sharp, rocky** mountains with few trees can be seen on the Lofoten Archipelago.
text_zh: 在羅浮敦群島上可以看到奇特、**尖銳且多岩石**且樹木稀少的高山。

text: The northeast of Norway can typically be recognized by a somewhat **rolling landscape**, rather than tall mountains, and vegetation mainly consisting of very **small birches** combined with patched grass.
text_zh: 挪威東北部通常可以透過略帶**起伏的地形**來辨認，而不是高山，其植被主要由**小型樺樹**結合散落的草地組成。

text: Barren highlands, with **no trees or bushes**, and often with rocky mountains along the road, are mostly found in the southwest.
text_zh: 貧瘠的高原，**沒有樹木或灌木**，且道路旁常有岩山，主要出現在西南部。

text: **Coastal grasslands** with little to no other vegetation and only somewhat low, distant mountains can be found by coastal roads in the far north.
text_zh: **海岸草原**，幾乎沒有其他植被，只有稍低且遙遠的山脈，可以在極北地區的沿海道路上找到。

text: Along the Russian border you can see this noticeably humid and green-looking road, with very overcast and occasionally [foggy](https://goo.gl/maps/kJpWE2wYp4YCGQF8A) coverage. The trees are somewhat low and mainly consist of thin birches and pines.
text_zh: 沿著俄羅斯邊境，你可以看到這條明顯潮濕且帶有綠意的道路，搭配非常陰暗且偶爾[有霧](https://goo.gl/maps/kJpWE2wYp4YCGQF8A)的街景覆蓋。樹木相對較矮，主要由細長的樺樹和松樹組成。

text: Most of Oman features a **desert landscape** with little vegetation. While the middle and southern half is mostly flat, the north coast features dry mountains similar to those found in the UAE. The southern coast also has mountains, though less dry.
text_zh: 阿曼大部分地區呈現植被稀少的**沙漠景觀**。雖然中部和南部半部大多平坦，但北海岸有著類似阿拉伯聯合大公國的乾燥山脈。南海岸也有山脈，但較不乾燥。

text: The Omani Google car drivers covered a lot of small tracks in the middle of the Omani desert.
text_zh: 阿曼的 Google 車駕駛拍攝了阿曼沙漠中許多的小路。

text: Close to the southern coast, especially around Salalah, you will find a **rolling hills landscape**. The area commonly features [rocky ground](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jScfBdQjFMYqeLA78), [bushes and small trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dHACRg4JwejDadmeA) as well as some fairly [green valleys](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tPNC9mp6zLwKW4d1A).
text_zh: 靠近南部海岸的地方，特別是在薩拉alah（Salalah）周邊，你會看到**起伏的丘陵景觀**。該地區常見[岩石地面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jScfBdQjFMYqeLA78)、[灌木和小樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dHACRg4JwejDadmeA)，以及一些相當[翠綠的山谷](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tPNC9mp6zLwKW4d1A)。

text: Sandy desert with light coloured green and yellow shrubs can be found in northeastern Oman, mainly south and west of Bidiyah.
text_zh: 東北部阿曼可以找到長有淺綠色和黃色灌木的沙質沙漠，主要位於比迪亞（Bidiyah）以南和以西。

text: South of Bidiyah you can find a couple of dirt roads going through a slightly rolling landscape consisting of orange-pink sand and small yellow-ish shrubs. The roads mainly go between long and low sand dunes with a general south-south-west direction.
text_zh: 在比迪亞以南，你可以找到幾條泥土路穿過微幅起伏的景觀，由橘粉色的沙子和黃色小灌木組成。這些道路主要穿梭於長而低矮的沙丘之間，大致呈南南西走向。

text: Masirah Island features a dry and slightly hilly landscape, typically with somewhat grey soil and with [brown shrubs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9) visible. Road 51, which circulates the island, usually only has a white centre road line, which can help in recognising it. The front camera on the island is [slightly smudged](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7).
text_zh: 馬西拉島的特色是乾燥且有些起伏的地形，土壤通常呈灰灰色，並可見[棕色灌木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9)。環島的 51 號公路通常只有白色中央道路標線，這有助於辨識。島上的前鏡頭[有點模糊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7)。

text: **Acacia trees**, recognisable by their relatively short height and umbrella-like flat crowns, are most abundant and common in northern Oman, but can also be found close to the rest of the coast.
text_zh: 以相對矮小且有如傘狀平坦樹冠為特徵的**金合歡樹**，在阿曼北部最為豐富和常見，但在其餘海岸線附近也能找到。

text: **Date palm plantations** are most common along the northern coast.
NOTE: Coconut palms, on the other hand, are usually found near Salalah.
text_zh: **椰棗種植園**在北部海岸最為常見。
注意：另一方面，椰子樹通常分佈在薩拉拉附近。

text: Just north of Adam, you’ll find a flat desert landscape with greyish soil and mountains in the distance, notably [one long ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AFDyzLikH9mg41S79) to the south followed by [two smaller and rounder hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7DcxmRPv7QrxDJo96) to the east and southeast. Other mountains are also visible to the north and west.
text_zh: 就在亞當北方，你會發現平坦的沙漠景觀，土壤呈灰灰色，遠處有山脈，特別是南方有[一道長山脊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AFDyzLikH9mg41S79)，東方和東南方隨後有[兩座較小且較圓的山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7DcxmRPv7QrxDJo96)。北方和西方也能看到其他山脈。

text: Around the town of Ubar, you can find patches of green agricultural land surrounded by desert.
text_zh: 在烏巴爾城鎮周圍，你可以找到被沙漠包圍的綠色農田斑塊。

text: Musandam governorate has more in common with the UAE than most of Oman, due to the even** drier mountainous landscape**, and it often has an orange tone. [Dipping beds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WSXnawCd6epZWmCy7), or mountains with diagonal layers, are common too.
NOTE: Most of mainland Oman is dry but still has [somewhat shrubby mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PDSq6znEJaiB52uy6).
text_zh: 穆桑代姆省（Musandam governorate）比多數阿曼地區與阿拉伯聯合大公國有更多相似之處，因為這裡有更**乾燥的山區景觀**，且通常帶有橘色調。[傾斜岩層](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WSXnawCd6epZWmCy7)，也就是具有對角線層理的山脈，在這裡也很常見。
注意：阿曼本土大部分地區是乾燥的，但仍有[些許灌木叢生的山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PDSq6znEJaiB52uy6)。

text: The road going to Saudi Arabia from Ibri can be recognised by the completely flat desert landscape with bright pink-greyish soil along with the road having** very wide shoulders** and the overall great road condition. The southern portion goes in a straight northeast direction, and the [northern section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DayXLmNREwVVVZpc7) curves more and can have more shrubs.
text_zh: 從伊布里（Ibri）通往沙烏地阿拉伯的道路可以透過完全平坦的沙漠景觀來識別，這裡有明亮的粉灰色土壤，且道路擁有**非常寬的路肩**以及整體極佳的道路狀況。南部路段大致朝東北方向筆直延伸，而[北部路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DayXLmNREwVVVZpc7)彎道較多，可能會有更多灌木。

text: Similar to the previous road, the road west of Fahud goes through a flat desert with pink-greyish soil. The main difference is that the road itself is in poor shape and without roadlines as well as the direction of the road being southeast.
text_zh: 與前一條道路相似，法胡德西側的道路穿過帶有粉灰色土壤的平坦沙漠。主要的區別在於道路本身狀況不佳、沒有道路標線，且道路方向為東南走向。

text: Road 29 south of Ibri features a fairly shrubby landscape, with low and jagged mountains on the eastern side of the road. The** low-lying sun** to the northwest is particularly distinct.
text_zh: 伊布里南側的 29 號公路具有相當多灌木的景觀，道路東側有低矮且鋸齒狀的山脈。西北方**低垂的太陽**特別明顯。

text: The southern section of Road 29 only has a **middle white line**, which along with the greyish and sandy desert landscape makes this road unique.
text_zh: 29 號公路的南部路段只有一條**中間白線**，這點加上灰白色且沙質的沙漠景觀，使得這條道路非常獨特。

text: This long stretch of Road 31 can be recognised by the light-coloured flat desert landscape along with the **wide shoulders** and the often faded road lines. The weather is usually somewhat cloudy.
text_zh: 這段長距離的 31 號公路可以透過淺色的平坦沙漠景觀以及**寬路肩**和經常褪色的道路標線來識別。天氣通常有點多雲。

text: The divided section of Road 31 is the only divided road going through a flat desert landscape.
text_zh: 31 號公路的分隔車道段是穿過平坦沙漠景觀中唯一的雙向分隔道路。

text: Road 32 north of Duqm travels through a **hilly **desert landscape, in a general northern direction.
text_zh: 杜庫姆（Duqm）北側的 32 號公路穿過**丘陵**沙漠景觀，大致朝北方行進。

text: Crossing into the Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate, the shoulders become **wide**, like those on Road 31. However, unlike Road 31, the desert here is darker and has more shrubs and greenery. A long portion of the road also has overcast coverage. The lighter red section is no longer road 32 but still features the wide shoulders. The landscape further north also gets [hillier](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4La4moT9kWDS1Xbq6) and more vegetated.
text_zh: 進入沙奇亞北省（Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate），路肩變得跟 31 號公路一樣**寬**。然而，與 31 號公路不同的是，這裡的沙漠顏色更深，且有更多灌木和綠色植物。道路很長的一部分也有陰天覆蓋。較淺的紅色路段已不再是 32 號公路，但仍保有寬路肩。更北方的景觀也變得更[多山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4La4moT9kWDS1Xbq6)且植被更豐富。

text: Road 35 is surrounded by hills and mountains, and the ground is mostly **covered in green shrubs. **Curved lamp posts are posted at regular intervals on the northeastern side of the road.
text_zh: 35 號公路周圍環繞著丘陵和山脈，地面大多**覆蓋著綠色灌木。**道路東北側固定間距設有彎曲的路燈桿。

text: Road 37 travels in a generally northwest direction through a very generic, flat desert landscape. The angle is one of the best clues for this road. On the southern half, a [big power line](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8) is visible to the northeast, while on the northern half, you can find distinct [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A).
text_zh: 37 號公路大致呈西北走向，穿過非常平淡、平坦的沙漠景觀。角度是這條道路最好的線索之一。在南半部，東北方可見[大型輸電線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8)；而在北半部，則可以找到明顯的[日落街景](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A)。

text: Road 39 is also one of the more generic roads. Probably the best way to recognise it are the **narrow**, or even **non-existent shoulders**. The western parts can get quite [hilly](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dgwhWhWKFo1RSK316), but overall, the desert landscape is flat.
text_zh: 39 號公路也是比較大眾化的道路之一。辨識它最好的方法可能就是**狹窄**、甚至**幾乎沒有路肩**。西半部可能會變得蠻[多山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dgwhWhWKFo1RSK316)的，但整體而言，沙漠景觀是平坦的。

text: Roads 45 and the western stretch of 39 both feature a similar slightly hilly desert landscape, sunny weather, and a general east-to-west direction. What makes them unique is the** **[**light-coloured shoulders**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/81QXr1cqJT9yxvG17)** **the roads share, though it is most pronounced on Road 45. The roads also mostly have a [faded white middle line](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EiBMQQ3bh6DXt6HF8). To tell the 45 and western 39 apart, look at the sun, which is [overhead](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4JtWs2nAKVCEvs7A) on the 39, but [to the west](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MGzB83ntBRbf7KCG8) on 45. The section north of Mudayy is also the 45, but unlabelled on Google Maps.
text_zh: 45 號公路與 39 公路的西部路段都具有類似的微丘陵沙漠景觀、晴朗的天氣，且大致呈東西走向。它們的獨特之處在於兩條路都有**[淺色路肩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/81QXr1cqJT9yxvG17)**，不過在 45 號公路上最為明顯。這些道路也大多有[褪色的白色中線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EiBMQQ3bh6DXt6HF8)。要分辨 45 號和西部 39 號公路，可以看太陽的位置：在 39 號公路上太陽在[正上方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4JtWs2nAKVCEvs7A)，但在 45 號公路上則在[西方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MGzB83ntBRbf7KCG8)。穆代伊（Mudayy）以北的路段也是 45 號公路，但在 Google 地圖上未標示名稱。

text: Patriata, northeast of Islamabad can be recognised by the **hilly forests**, mainly consisting of **tall pine trees**. Interestingly, parts of the coverage were taken from an [aerial lift](https://goo.gl/maps/sa5D6rT9i6EcbGYy8).
text_zh: 伊斯蘭瑪巴德（Islamabad）東北方的帕特里亞塔（Patriata）可以透過**多山森林**來辨識，主要由**高大的松樹**組成。有趣的是，部分街景覆蓋是從[空中纜車](https://goo.gl/maps/sa5D6rT9i6EcbGYy8)上拍攝的。

text: The coverage in Changa Manga Forest Park can be recognised by the path angle being northeastern, and the narrow channel closely following the path, either on the northern or [southern](https://goo.gl/maps/bAPXGSaAF1SUyPun6) side.
text_zh: 昌加曼加森林公園（Changa Manga Forest Park）的街景覆蓋可以透過路徑角度為東北東、以及緊鄰路徑的狹窄水道來辨識，水道位於北方或[南方](https://goo.gl/maps/bAPXGSaAF1SUyPun6)側。

text: The country is generally flat in the east and mountainous in the west. However, an exception is the often flat desert near Piura in the northwest.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 該國東部通常平坦，西部多山。然而，西北部皮烏拉附近常見的平坦沙漠則是個例外。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Peru has a diverse climate, dominated by a [**dry desert**](https://goo.gl/maps/4XWT67dUk3PGbCAo6) in the west, and a [**tropical rainforest**](https://goo.gl/maps/YRV9ZwPAv3LBSqWM9) in the east.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 祕魯氣候多樣，以西部的[**乾旱沙漠**](https://goo.gl/maps/4XWT67dUk3PGbCAo6)和東部的[**熱帶雨林**](https://goo.gl/maps/YRV9ZwPAv3LBSqWM9)為主。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The southwestern landscape of Piura is generally dry, featuring a **low amount of vegetation** with a few shrubs and bushes. The landscape is mostly flat, but you will sometimes see rolling hills.
text_zh: 皮烏拉的西南部地景通常很乾燥，具有**少量的植被**以及一些灌木叢。地景大多平坦，但有時你會看到起伏的山丘。

text: Northwest of the city of Piura lies an area with similar vegetation to the area mentioned previously. However, this area is **noticeably hillier**.
text_zh: 皮烏拉市西北方有一塊植被與前面提及的地區相似的區域。然而，這個地區**明顯更為丘陵起伏**。

text: **Olive tree plantations** can be found in the far southern region of Tacna.
text_zh: **橄欖樹園**可以在最南部的塔克納（Tacna）地區找到。

text: Far north Peru features mountains that are often covered in **shrubby trees and bushes**. Closer to the coast and the Ecuador border, these mountains are often [quite dry](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2sAyUVLu4AdVCyuc7#extra%5Btags%5D=Sandy+Orange&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) in appearance.
text_zh: 祕魯極北部有著經常覆蓋著**灌木狀樹木和灌木**的山脈。靠近海岸和厄瓜多邊界處，這些山脈的外觀通常[相當乾燥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2sAyUVLu4AdVCyuc7#extra%5Btags%5D=Sandy+Orange&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)。

text: **Pine plantations** are typically** **found in higher elevation areas of the country, away from the coastal deserts and Amazonian Regions. The most common types of pine trees planted are [Pinus radiata](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_radiata) and [Pinus patula](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_patula).
text_zh: **松樹林**通常出現在該國海拔較高的地區，遠離沿海沙漠和亞馬遜地區。種植最常見的松樹種類是[放射松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_radiata)和[墨西哥松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_patula)。

text: Areas near the cities of Ica, Arequipa, and Tacna feature** barren and mostly flat desert landscapes** that can resemble areas of [northern Chile](https://goo.gl/maps/LF4MFBiVCeULmxmT7). You can typically see mountains in the distance, primarily while looking to the east.
text_zh: 伊卡（Ica）、阿雷基帕（Arequipa）和塔克納等城市附近的地區具有**荒涼且大多平坦的沙漠地景**，可能類似於[智利北部](https://goo.gl/maps/LF4MFBiVCeULmxmT7)的地區。你通常可以在遠處看到山脈，主要是在向東看的時候。

text: Coastal **agricultural valleys** in the middle and south are commonly sandwiched between **dry mountains with no vegetation**. The general orientation of these valleys are southwest-northeast.
NOTE: Agricultural valleys in the north of Peru can look similar, but often feature more shrubs and trees on the mountains.
text_zh: 中部和南部的沿海**農業山谷**通常夾在**沒有植被的乾旱山脈**之間。這些山谷的整體走向為西南—東北。
注意：祕魯北部的農業山谷看起來可能相似，但山上通常有更多灌木和樹木。

text: The 1S south of the city of Ica is **not divided** and mostly follows the coast. The soil is often red or orange in these areas, and there is little-to-no vegetation. This road is also entirely covered with the **Generation 4** camera.
text_zh: 伊卡市以南的 1S 號公路**沒有分流**，且大多沿著海岸線延伸。這些區域的土壤通常呈紅色或橙色，幾乎沒有植被。這條路也完全被**第 4 相機世代**的相機覆蓋。

text: **Ruta 30C** in eastern Peru uses a white Street View car in Generation 3 between the cities of Planchon and Iñapari. It features dense forest, few villages, and resembles interior areas of Brazil. Some of this area has been overwritten with [Generation 4](https://www.google.com/maps/@-11.5434488,-69.2916923,3a,90y,170.18h,87.56t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sp8bJgFNzPpFzeqeYQxMyJA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). Most of this segment runs north to south.
text_zh: 秘魯東部的 **30C 國道（Ruta 30C）**在普朗雄（Planchon）和伊納帕里（Iñapari）之間的城市之間使用第三代白色的街景車。它具有茂密的森林、稀少的村莊，且類似巴西的內陸地區。這個地區的部分路段已被[第四代](https://www.google.com/maps/@-11.5434488,-69.2916923,3a,90y,170.18h,87.56t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sp8bJgFNzPpFzeqeYQxMyJA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)覆蓋。這段路的絕大部分都是南北走向。

text: The valley connecting the cities of Jauja and Huancayo features a flat plain with **plentiful trees, agricultural areas, and small villages**. North-south oriented mountains can be seen on both edges of the valley.
text_zh: 連接豪賈和萬卡約兩市的河谷有著**豐富的樹木、農業區和小村莊**的平坦平原。在河谷的兩側邊緣可以看到南北走向的山脈。

text: North of the city of Huancayo lies a shallow lake called Lake Chinchaycocha (also referred to as ‘the middle lake.’). This lake is generally** marshy** and a **range of mountains** can be seen to the** east **of the lake. This lake can look similar to Lake Titicaca, but is generally less densely populated and features fewer trees.
text_zh: 萬卡約市以北有一座名為欽柴科恰湖（Chinchaycocha）的淺水湖（也被稱為「中湖」）。這個湖通常是**沼澤地形**，且在湖的**東側**可以看到**一連串的山脈**。這個湖看起來可能與的的喀喀湖相似，但通常人口較少且樹木較少。

text: The forested mountain range in Northern Luzon is characterised by somewhat **dry mountainsides** and an abundance of **pine trees**. You may rarely come across a similar landscape on high-altitude roads in [Mindanao](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dowDy4SWZt1pvxtG9).
text_zh: 呂宋島北部的森林山脈特徵是有些**乾燥的山腰**和大量的**松樹**。你可能很少在[民答那峨](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dowDy4SWZt1pvxtG9)的高海拔道路上遇到類似的景觀。

text: The vast majority of **Oil palm** plantations are found on Mindanao.
text_zh: 絕大多數的**油棕**園都位於 Mindanao。

text: [Moluccan albizia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcataria_falcata) are trees with **light coloured trunks **and [**pinnate leaves**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinnation) near the top of the tree. They are mainly found on Mindanao and are especially common in the eastern and central regions of the island.
text_zh: [摩鹿加合歡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcataria_falcata)是樹幹**顏色較淺**且樹頂附近長有[**羽狀葉**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinnation)的樹木。它們主要分佈在民答那峨，在該島的東部和中部地區尤其常見。

text: Pitcairn Island is a semi-tropical and densely forested island, with most of the coverage being taken on small dirt tracks going through the forest.
text_zh: 皮特肯群島是一個半熱帶且森林密布的島嶼，大部分的街景覆蓋都是在穿梭於森林中的小型泥土小徑上拍攝。

text: Poland is generally a **flat country**, with occasional rolling hills. The country is very green, with a lot of agriculture, and some amount of forest cover.
NOTE: Mountains can be found near the southern border.
text_zh: 波蘭大致上是個**平坦的國家**，偶有起伏的丘陵。這個國家非常綠意盎然，有大量的農業活動，並有一定程度的森林覆蓋。
注意：南部邊境附近可以找到山脈。

text: Many roads in Poland are lined by **rows of trees**.
text_zh: 波蘭的許多道路兩旁都有**成排的樹木**。

text: The main road on the **Hel peninsula** is very recognizable: it is a coastal forest road with a railway track running parallel to it.
text_zh: **海爾半島（Hel peninsula）**上的主要道路非常容易辨認：這是一條沿海的森林公路，旁邊有一條與其平行的鐵路線。

text: **Eucalyptus trees** are very common in Portugal. The only other part of Europe where you’ll commonly see eucalyptus is [northern Spain](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.1615813,-8.7773429,3a,90y,44.89h,89.75t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sC7quFqkQ-yqtdhYH-ACW8w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: **尤加利樹**在葡萄牙非常普遍。歐洲另一個常見尤加利樹的地方只有[西班牙北部](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.1615813,-8.7773429,3a,90y,44.89h,89.75t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sC7quFqkQ-yqtdhYH-ACW8w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: Dense **eucalyptus forests** are mostly found in the northwest.
text_zh: 密集的 **尤加利樹林** 主要分佈在西北部。

text: Forests, or plantations of** Maritime pines **([Pinus Pinaster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_pinaster)) are very common in the northern half of Portugal. You can recognize the tree by its grey bark with red undertones, and fluffy branches that point upwards. Older trees often don’t have any branches in the bottom half of the tree.
NOTE: Plantations of this pine are also common in northern Spain, particularly Galicia.
text_zh: **海濱松**（[Pinus Pinaster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_pinaster)）的森林或人工林在葡萄牙北部非常常見。你可以透過其帶有紅色底色的灰色樹皮以及向上生長的蓬鬆枝條來認出這種樹。較老的樹木通常在下半部沒有任何樹枝。
注意：這種松樹的人工林在西班牙北部也很常見，特別是在加利西亞。

text: Pine forests with extremely **sandy white soil** can be found near the coast between the cities of Setúbal and Sines.
text_zh: 在 Setúbal 和 Sines 兩座城市之間的沿海地區，可以找到擁有極度**帶沙的白土**的松林。

text: In the far southwest of the country you can find a flat uncultivated landscape with very limited vegetation, which typically appears quite dry. There are almost no trees nearby, and only very low bushes and grass.
text_zh: 在該國的極西南端，你可以看到一片平坦且未開墾的景觀，植被非常稀少，通常顯得相當乾燥。附近幾乎沒有樹木，只有非常矮小的灌木和草。

text: Qatar's landscape is **predominantly desert**, with **arid**, and **mostly flat** expanses of sand as far as the eye can see. You will often not see a lot of trees or other greenery.
text_zh: 卡達的地景**以沙漠為主**，有著**乾旱**且**幾乎平坦**、一眼望不到盡頭的廣闊沙地。你通常很難看到大量樹木或其他綠色植物。

text: Réunion is a mountainous volcanic island in the Indian Ocean on a similar latitude to Queensland, Australia. Most roads are along the coast, with lush green mountains visible close by. Vegetation consists of [palms](https://goo.gl/maps/NjLXjEScWkmUzNQ17) and [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/6oLGxZkvfaiTBqZg7), [pine trees](https://goo.gl/maps/J7vpe2wV2kptobfE9) at higher elevation, and [flowering plants](https://goo.gl/maps/zKst3y8NcdYipxtf6) due to the island’s tropical savanna climate.
text_zh: 留尼旺是印度洋上的多火山山岳島嶼，緯度與澳洲昆士蘭相近。大多數道路沿著海岸修建，附近可見蒼翠繁茂的綠色山脈。植被包含[棕櫚樹](https://goo.gl/maps/NjLXjEScWkmUzNQ17)、[蕨類](https://goo.gl/maps/6oLGxZkvfaiTBqZg7)、高海拔處的[松樹](https://goo.gl/maps/J7vpe2wV2kptobfE9)，以及因該島的熱帶莽原氣候而生的[開花植物](https://goo.gl/maps/zKst3y8NcdYipxtf6)。

text: Route du Volcan can be recognized by the **Martian** landscape. The only vegetation is scattered shrubs and the soil is a distinct **brown-red** colour. These [white stones](https://goo.gl/maps/UFYFzYRav6h75Fge8) lining the road are also a good clue.
text_zh: 火山公路（Route du Volcan）可以從其**火星**般的景觀認出。唯一的植被是零星的灌木，土壤則是明顯的**紅褐色**。道路兩旁這些[白色石頭](https://goo.gl/maps/UFYFzYRav6h75Fge8)也是很好的線索。

text: La Route Forestière 58 de la Scierie et du Haut des Makes is a **winding dirt track** that can be recognized by the **dense vegetation** surrounding it, particularly pine trees and eucalyptus. The track itself is also dark in colour, with grass growing in the middle of it.
text_zh: 58 號鋸木廠與上馬克斯森林公路（La Route Forestière 58 de la Scierie et du Haut des Makes）是一條**蜿蜒的泥土路**，其特徵是周圍環繞著**濃密的植被**，特別是松樹和尤加利樹。路面本身顏色偏暗，中間長著草。

text: The eastern region of Réunion is the least densely populated, evident by the eastern part of the N2, which is a single carriageway passing through [somewhat dense vegetation on both sides](https://goo.gl/maps/1vJBXBfvwwi8YyB37), or a [vast landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/dCWLTzJzexxtujih9) with little to no trees.
text_zh: 留尼旺東部地區人口最稀少，N2 的東部路段即是明證：這是一條單車道公路，穿過[兩側相當茂密的植被](https://goo.gl/maps/1vJBXBfvwwi8YyB37)，或是幾乎沒有樹木的[廣闊景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/dCWLTzJzexxtujih9)。

text: The Romanian landscape ranges from tall forested mountains and hills in the centre to flat or rolling agricultural landscapes in the south, west and east.
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞的地貌從中央高聳的森林山脈與丘陵，到南部、西部和東部的平坦或起伏農業景觀不等。

text: Sovetskaya Gavan and Vanino in eastern Khabarovsk have winter coverage, somewhat similar to Vorkuta.
NOTE: While Vorkuta and Vanino have similar coverage types, Vorkuta is noticeably flatter, having lower vegetation and a more barren landscape.
text_zh: 哈巴羅夫斯克東部的蘇維埃港和瓦尼諾有冬季街景，與沃爾庫塔有點相似。
注意：雖然沃爾庫塔和瓦尼諾有類似的街景類型，但沃爾庫塔明顯更為平坦，植被較低且地貌更為荒涼。

text: The road to Okha in northern Sakhalin is unpaved, revealing its very **sandy soil**. The road is surrounded by **short, stunted bushes and trees**.
text_zh: 通往薩哈林北部奧哈的道路未鋪 asfalt，露出了其非常**沙質的土壤**。道路周圍環繞著**矮小的灌木和樹木**。

text: In the desert-like region west of the Caspian Sea, this completely flat and rural Generation 4 coverage on small poorly-tracked dirt roads can only be found in northern Dagestan and southwestern Astrakhan Oblast.
text_zh: 在裡海西部的沙漠般地區，這種完全平坦且鄉村風貌、位於小型泥濘土路上的相機世代 4 街景，只能在達吉斯坦北部和阿斯特拉罕州西南部找到。

text: **Tropical plants** in Russia such as palm trees are only found on the Black Sea, most commonly around Sochi.
text_zh: 俄羅斯的**熱帶植物**（如棕櫚樹）僅見於黑海沿岸，最常見於索契周邊。

text: The landscape mainly consists of flat or rolling **grasslands**. The coast will be visible more often than not.
text_zh: 地貌主要由平坦或起伏的**草原**組成。通常海岸隨時可見。

text: This rural trekker in the far north can be recognized by the **rolling, grassy** landscape. The trekker can also be seen walking on a wooden path, with trees on either side.
text_zh: 這個位於極北處的鄉村徒步拍攝可以透過**起伏、長滿草**的景觀來辨識。也可以看到徒步拍攝走在木棧道上，兩側都有樹木。

text: The rural trekker on Saint Pierre island has a more **rocky** landscape. The trekker also walks on a path with trees on both sides.
text_zh: 聖皮耶島上的鄉村徒步拍攝具有較多**岩石**的景觀。徒步拍攝也走在兩側有樹木的小徑上。

text: The landscape of San Marino largely consists of smooth **agricultural hills**, with many small winding roads. The vegetation is distinctly **Mediterranean**, and normally appears quite lush.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾的景觀大多由平緩的**農田山丘**組成，有許多小型蜿蜒道路。植被具有明顯的**地中海**特色，通常看起來相當茂盛。

text: The landscape north of The Gambia and for Senegal generally is a **flat, arid, savannah-desert** landscape with sparse trees. The trees themselves will be somewhat short and have leaves that are faded in colour.
text_zh: 甘比亞以北以及整體塞內加爾的景觀是**平坦、乾旱的稀樹草原-沙漠**景觀，樹木稀疏。樹木本身會有點矮小，且葉子顏色較褪色。

text: The vegetation in the region south of The Gambia is more lush and green compared to the rest of Senegal, and palm trees can be seen closer to the coast.

NOTE: Coverage toward the west will also be [especially tropical](https://goo.gl/maps/52g1NQ7hwGZtNejD8). In addition, make sure not to confuse the south with some coverage near Dakar, which can look deceivingly green. However, here the vegetation will look a lot more [low and coastal](https://goo.gl/maps/oouBBYadRN3oiSRi8).
text_zh: 甘比亞以南地區的植被與塞內加爾其餘地區相比更加繁茂翠綠，且靠近海岸的地方可以看到棕櫚樹。
注意：朝西的覆蓋也將[特別具有熱帶風情](https://goo.gl/maps/52g1NQ7hwGZtNejD8)。此外，切勿將南部與達卡附近的一些覆蓋混淆，那裡看起來可能會綠得令人產生錯覺。然而，那裡的植被看起來會更偏向[低矮的海岸植物](https://goo.gl/maps/oouBBYadRN3oiSRi8)。

text: Diourbel Region is the only region in Senegal with extensive **rural coverage**. The coverage in the region will look like this, with the Google Car driving on a sandy road with sparse trees. Some of the coverage extends to the west in the Thies region up to Babou.
NOTE: The sand in the coverage around Touba tends to be more [grassy](https://goo.gl/maps/BWCDdy4HBumDShTx9).
text_zh: 迪烏爾貝勒區（Diourbel Region）是塞內加爾唯一擁有廣泛**鄉村覆蓋**的地區。該地區的覆蓋看起來會像這樣，Google 車行駛在長有稀疏樹木的沙路上一部分覆蓋延伸到了西邊的捷斯地區，一直到巴布（Babou）。
注意：圖巴（Touba）周邊街景中的沙子往往[草木較多](https://goo.gl/maps/BWCDdy4HBumDShTx9)。

text: The N2 between Richard Toll and Matam is a wide road going through a flat desert landscape with very sparse trees. It can be recognized by the **bright blue skies** with **no clouds**. The road itself goes east-west and northeast-southwest.
NOTE: The higher the sun is, the more east you are.
text_zh: 理查托爾和馬塔姆（Matam）之間的 N2 公路是一條寬闊的道路，穿過樹木非常稀疏的平坦沙漠景觀。它的特徵是**晴空萬里**且**沒有雲**。道路本身呈東西走向以及東北-西南走向。
注意：太陽越高，代表你越往東邊。

text: A flat, **slightly marshy** landscape with low vegetation can be seen on a few sections of roads in the Saloum River Delta.
text_zh: 在薩盧姆河三角洲（Saloum River Delta）的幾個道路路段上，可以看到平坦、**微帶沼澤**且植被低矮的景觀。

text: The white road in the Forest of Thies can be recognized by the **dry**,** slightly hilly** landscape with brown vegetation. The road itself is made of bright orange dirt. There is also a noticeably haze in the coverage.
text_zh: 捷斯森林（Forest of Thies）中的白色道路可以透過帶有褐色植被的**乾燥**、**微帶丘陵**景觀來辨認。道路本身是由鮮豔的橘色泥土組成。覆蓋中也有明顯的霧霾。

text: **Rain trees** are seen all around Singapore, and are often planted along main roads.
text_zh: **雨樹（Rain trees）**在新加坡各地隨處可見，經常被種植在主要道路沿線。

text: The Generation 3 **trekker on Pulau Ubin** can be identified by the unusually rural forest coverage and the camouflage-type hat sometimes visible when looking down.
text_zh: 烏敏島（Pulau Ubin）上的第 3 代**徒步拍攝**可以透過異常鄉村化的森林覆蓋，以及向下看時有時可見的迷彩帽來識別。

text: **Pine forests** are common in the westernmost part of the country.
text_zh: **松樹林**在該國最西部地區很常見。

text: The Slovenian landscape is generally very **hilly and forested**, with occasional agriculture.
_For exceptions to this, see the region guessing section._
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的地貌通常非常**多山且森林密布**，偶有農田。
_關於此規則的例外，請參見地區猜測章節。_

text: A very significant portion of the coverage in Slovenia was taken on small roads deep **inside forest**.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞很大一部分的街景拍攝於**森林內部**的小路。

text: Near the coast you get a landscape similar to the rest of the Adriatic coast; **white cliffs** with bushy vegetation, vineyards and Mediterranean architecture.
text_zh: 靠近海岸處，你會看到類似亞得里亞海其他地區的景緻；帶有灌木植被、葡萄園和地中海式建築的**白色懸崖**。

text: The northeast of the country can look very dry and somewhat barren, with a lot of orange or red soil. You will often see hills or mountains covered in shrubs.
NOTE: Depending on the season, the coverage can change drastically from [dry](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XsQme5RXp7jB2U1p6) to [very green](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hLARbuFeBKWx6hot7).
text_zh: 該國東北部看起來可能非常乾燥且有些荒涼，帶有大量橙色或紅色土壤。你經常會看到覆蓋著灌木叢的山丘或山脈。
註：根據季節不同，街景覆蓋可能會從[乾燥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XsQme5RXp7jB2U1p6)急遽轉變為[非常綠意盎然](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hLARbuFeBKWx6hot7)。

text: Uniquely tall **Cook pine trees** are found mostly between the cities of East London and Durban along the southeastern coast.
NOTE: These are planted and not native, so they can be found anywhere along the coast.
text_zh: 外形獨特的很高 **庫克南洋杉** 主要分佈在東倫敦與德班兩市之間的東南沿海一帶。
注意：這些是種植的而非原生植物，因此沿海各地都有可能看到。

text: **Tree plantations** that consist mostly of pine** **are common to the west of Eswatini, and some to the south in KwaZulu-Natal.
NOTE: Pine tree plantations are typically seen within the country of Eswatini itself.
text_zh: 主要由松樹組成的**人工林**** **常見於史瓦帝尼以西，夸祖魯-納塔爾省南部也有一些。
注意：松樹人工林通常位於史瓦帝尼國內。

text: The landscape near the Mozambique border in the highlighted area is noticeably **flat**, with green subtropical vegetation.
text_zh: 莫三比克邊境附近的景觀在突顯區域內明顯**平坦**，並有綠色的亞熱帶植被。

text: The landscape around Kruger National Park is generally flat, with a **savannah **climate and dry vegetation. You will not see any agriculture and the vegetation is mostly made up of grasses, with small trees dotting the landscape. Red soil can also be seen below the grass.
In addition, this distinctive [directional waystone](https://goo.gl/maps/C4VRQ6v1PyAStJUz7) is commonly found at many junctions.
NOTE: Within the coverage of the park, you will mostly find unpaved gravel roads or small and paved roads without road lines.
text_zh: 克魯格國家公園周邊的景觀通常很平坦，具有**稀樹草原**氣候與乾燥的植被。你看不到任何農業活動，植被主要由草地組成，並散布著小樹。草地下方也能看到紅土。
此外，這個獨特的[方向石碑](https://goo.gl/maps/C4VRQ6v1PyAStJUz7)常見於許多交叉路口。
注意：在公園的街景覆蓋範圍內，你主要會看到未鋪柏油的碎石路，或是沒有道路標線的小型鋪面道路。

text: The section of the **R360 north of Bokspits**, next to the Botswana border, has asphalt with a recognizable reddish tint. The landscape is arid and features dry greyish trees, shrubs and long golden grass. The road runs in a general north to south direction.
NOTE: Asphalt with a reddish tint can be found on other roads and the southern part of the R360. However, the landscape north of Bokspits looks predominantly like this.
text_zh: 位於波斯皮茨以北、鄰近波札那邊境的**R360**路段，其柏油路面帶有明顯的 reddish 泛紅。景觀屬於乾旱型，帶有乾枯的灰綠色樹木、灌木和長長的金色牧草。道路大致呈南北走向。
注意：其他道路以及 R360 的南部路段也可能出現帶有紅調的柏油。然而，波斯皮茨以北的景觀主要就是長這樣。

text: Spain has **highly diverse landscapes**, ranging from [lush Atlantic forests](https://goo.gl/maps/U8Vp3k1yGrLdVQANA) to [bone-dry semideserts](https://goo.gl/maps/PwTpyn5Lw6DMApWGA). Elevation is also varied: highland plateaus interspersed with [rolling hills](https://goo.gl/maps/hDzbVSrJbPSPQVnJ7) are common, but you might also encounter jagged mountain ranges and [very flat lowland](https://goo.gl/maps/kgiM3UXvKiQAcToWA) areas.
text_zh: 西班牙擁有**高度多樣化的地貌**，從[綠意盎然的大西洋森林](https://goo.gl/maps/U8Vp3k1yGrLdVQANA)到[極度乾燥的半沙漠](https://goo.gl/maps/PwTpyn5Lw6DMApWGA)應有盡有。海拔高度也變化多端：夾雜著[起伏丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/hDzbVSrJbPSPQVnJ7)的高原很常見，但你也可能會遇到綿延險峻的山脈和[非常平坦的低地](https://goo.gl/maps/kgiM3UXvKiQAcToWA)地區。

text: While there is not one single definitive Spanish landscape, most of the country has a somewhat dry, **Mediterranean** climate, with matching vegetation and agriculture.
text_zh: 雖然西班牙沒有單一最具代表性的地貌，但全國大部分地區都屬於稍微乾燥的**地中海**氣候，並有著相應的植被和農業。

text: The **Pyrenees** is a large mountain range on the border between Spain and France. Its mountains are some of the highest in all of Spain. It can be recognized by its light grey rock and abundance of pine trees. Local architecture features many [rock walls](https://goo.gl/maps/F67y544xPUyR5ypo7).

NOTE: Andorra and the French part of the Pyrenees look very similar in terms of landscape and architecture. Also consider that the exclave of [Llívia](/images/spain/spain_pyreneesllivia.png) is part of Spain.
text_zh: **庇里尼亞山脈（Pyrenees）**是位於西班牙和法國邊境的大型山脈。其群山是全西班牙海拔最高的一些山脈。它可透過淺灰色岩石和大量的松樹來辨識。當地建築特色包含許多[石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/F67y544xPUyR5ypo7)。
注意：安道爾和庇里牛斯山的法國部分在景觀和建築上看起來非常相似。同時也要考慮到[利維亞](/images/spain/spain_pyreneesllivia.png)飛地是西班牙的一部分。

text: Thick forests of **tall pines** can be found all throughout the Pyrenees. When encountered in smaller mountains in between grazing fields or agricultural land, it will most likely be in the Basque Country or Navarra.
text_zh: 在整個庇里尼亞山脈都可以找到**高大松樹**所組成的茂密森林。如果在放牧田或農田之間較小的山脈中遇到，那很可能是位於巴斯克自治區或納瓦拉。

text: Starting in Navarra and cutting across the middle of Aragón, there is a strip of semi-desert landscape on both sides of the Ebro river basin. Light sandy soil and **small shrubs** growing on **small hills** are common in this area.
text_zh: 從納瓦拉開始並橫穿亞拉岡中部，在埃布羅河流域兩側有一條半沙漠地貌的帶狀區域。淺色沙質土壤和生長在**小山丘**上的**小灌木**在該地區很常見。

text: Castilla la Mancha can have **completely flat landscapes**, which are not that common in Castilla y León. Half of Spain’s wine is produced in this region, so vineyards are fairly common.
In the western provinces of Ciudad Real and Toledo, it is very common to see olive tree plantations, generally in flatter ground than those found in Andalusia.
text_zh: 卡斯提亞-拉曼查可能擁有**完全平坦的地貌**，這在卡斯提亞-雷昂並不常見。西班牙一半的葡萄酒都是在該地區生產的，因此葡萄園相當普遍。
在雷亞爾城和托雷多的西部省份，看到橄欖樹種植園非常普遍，通常位於比安達魯西亞更平坦的地面上。

text: Open fields sparsely populated with **holm oaks** ([Quercus ilex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quercus_ilex)) and **cork oaks** ([Quercus suber](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quercus_suber)) are very common in Extremadura and neighbouring regions. These species of oaks tend to be on the smaller side, and have a Mediterranean look. Be careful not to confuse them with olive trees, as they can look superficially similar to the untrained eye.
North of Cáceres the vegetation is [more lush](https://goo.gl/maps/c2eY7SkHd8KcXn69A) and winter and spring coverage is more common.
text_zh: 稀疏分佈著**冬青櫟**（[Quercus ilex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quercus_ilex)）和**栓皮櫟**（[Quercus suber](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quercus_suber)）的開闊田野在埃斯特雷馬杜拉（Extremadura）及鄰近地區非常常見。這些櫟樹種類偏向小型，且具有地中海風情。小心不要把它們與橄欖樹混淆，因為在外行眼中，它們表面上看起來可能很相似。
卡塞雷斯以北的植被[更為繁茂](https://goo.gl/maps/c2eY7SkHd8KcXn69A)，且冬季和春季的街景覆蓋更為常見。

text: In the southeast of Spain, especially in Murcia, you can find a rather **arid landscape**, with very sandy soil and **medium sized mountains** surrounding.
Small shrubs and small plantations of fruit trees and olive trees are a common sight around rural roads.
text_zh: 在西班牙東南部，特別是在穆爾西亞，你可以找到相當**乾旱的地貌**，有著非常沙質的土壤，周圍環繞著**中等大小的山脈**。
小灌木以及小型的果樹和橄欖樹種植園是鄉村道路周圍常見的景象。

text: Mountains in this area, especially Murcia and the south of Alicante have a very distinct look.
They are quite **rugged**, usually lacking in vegetation. This region commonly features a **hazy** look, making mountains in the distance look like they are behind a sort of mist.
text_zh: 這一地區的山脈，特別是穆爾西亞和阿利坎特南部，有著非常獨特的外觀。
它們相當**崎嶇**，通常缺乏植被。該地區通常帶有**霧濛濛**的外觀，使得遠處的山脈看起來像是處於某種薄霧後方。

text: **Olive trees** are one of the main crops planted in Spain, they can be commonly seen in more than half of the country.
text_zh: **橄欖樹**是西班牙種植的主要農作物之一，它們在全國一半以上的地區都能普遍看見。

text: Around Córdoba and Jaén, you can find massive **olive tree plantations** growing over **rolling hills** and going as far as the eye can see.
The bigger and more remote plantations are usually only covered in [Generation 2](https://goo.gl/maps/kpRdHCFYG9cevzqG6).
text_zh: 在科爾多瓦和哈恩周圍，你可以找到綿延至視野盡頭的廣闊**橄欖樹種植園**，生長在**起伏的丘陵**上。
更大且更偏遠的種植園通常只被[第 2 代街景](https://goo.gl/maps/kpRdHCFYG9cevzqG6)涵蓋。

text: South of Madrid, olive tree plantations are usually in small or medium sized fields, in mostly flat terrain and commonly accompanied by red soil.
text_zh: 馬德里以南的橄欖樹種植園通常位於中小型田野中，多處於平坦地形，且通常伴隨著紅土。

text: When you encounter **eucalyptus trees in a dry environment**, you will most likely be in the province of Huelva. You can find them more rarely in Extremadura in the north and up until Córdoba in the east.
text_zh: 當你在**乾燥環境中遇到尤加利樹**時，你最有可能身處韋爾瓦省。你可以在北部的埃斯特雷馬杜拉更罕見地找到它們，一直延伸到東部的科爾多瓦。

text: On the east coast of Spain, you can find many **orange tree plantations**. They are usually in small valleys, and if they are in flat land you can usually see mountains to the west, north or south.
text_zh: 在西班牙東海岸，你可以找到許多**橘子樹種植園**。它們通常位於小山谷中，如果位於平坦土地上，你通常可以看到西側、北側或南側有山脈。

text: **Stone pines** ([Pinus pinea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone_pine)) can be recognized by their fluffy leaves, and compact bulbous crown that is wider than it is tall.
Forests of exclusively stone pines in a flat area are very common around Valladolid and Huelva. It is common to see them in the mountains close to Barcelona in residential areas.
text_zh: **石松** ([Pinus pinea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone_pine)) 的特徵是毛茸茸的葉子，以及緊密且呈球根狀的樹冠，其寬度大於高度。
由純粹石松組成的平坦森林在瓦 Valladolid 和烏爾瓦 Huelva 一帶非常普遍。在巴塞隆納附近山區的住宅區也很常見。

text: **Maritime pines** ([Pinus Pinaster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_pinaster)) has two variants in Spain, near the Atlantic coast, it has grey bark with red undertones, and fluffy branches that point upwards. Older trees often don’t have any branches in the bottom half of the tree.
NOTE: Plantations of this pine are extremely common in north and central Portugal.
text_zh: **海濱松** ([Pinus Pinaster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_pinaster)) 在西班牙有兩種變體：靠近大西洋海岸的品種擁有帶紅色調的灰樹皮，以及向上生長的毛茸茸樹枝。較老的樹木在樹幹下半部通常沒有任何樹枝。
注意：這種松樹的人工林在葡萄牙北部和中部極為常見。

text: In the rest of Spain you can find the Mediterranean variant of the tree. It still has a grey bark with red tones, and it is usually very fissured.
You can find the tree in most of the mountain ranges in central and southern Spain. Extensive plantations in flat ground can be found North of [Segovia](https://goo.gl/maps/i6S6jEeFsbjheYQe6).
text_zh: 在西班牙的其他地區，你可以找到這種樹的地中海變體。它依然保有帶紅色調的灰色樹皮，且通常有許多裂縫。
你可以在西班牙中部和南部的多數山脈找到這種樹。平坦地面上的廣大人工林則可在[塞哥維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/i6S6jEeFsbjheYQe6)北方找到。

text: The **Balearic islands** have a recognizable, coastal Mediterranean look. Somewhat dry looking forests of Aleppo pines cover most of the hills, and small patches of agricultural land, mainly with fruit trees and olive trees, cover the flatter areas between towns.
text_zh: **巴利阿里群島**具有可識別的地中海沿岸外觀。看似有些乾燥的阿勒坡松森林覆蓋了大部分山丘，而平坦的地區（介於城鎮之間）則被小塊的農田覆蓋，主要種植果樹和橄欖樹。

text: The small island of Formentera frequently features low **coastal shrubs**. It is common to be able to see the mountains of Ibiza from Formentera’s north coast.
text_zh: 小島福門特拉島經常出現低矮的**海岸灌木**。從福門特拉島的北海岸通常可以看到伊比薩島的山脈。
