text: The Canaries have **extremely diverse landscapes**, including [steep mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/rfH1kBDye8h9rWaS6), [pine forests](https://goo.gl/maps/Bn6ErCKJ3sfiUaUa8), [volcanic soil](https://goo.gl/maps/6JqQk3AxRiRF3WoDA), and [extreme aridity](https://goo.gl/maps/4fdpWvUUTJYxJMEd7). You can also encounter [more normal landscapes](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYFchUyxrDQ7uyx5) that can look more like mainland Spain.

NOTE: Because of its diversity, it is hard to pin down the average landscape in the Canaries. A more useful strategy is to focus on whether it looks unique and unlike anything that you would find in mainland Europe: if meta matches with Spain, but something is “off” in terms of vibe, consider the Canaries.
text_zh: 加納利群島擁有**極其多樣化的景觀**，包括[陡峭的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/rfH1kBDye8h9rWaS6)、[松樹林](https://goo.gl/maps/Bn6ErCKJ3sfiUaUa8)、[火山土壤](https://goo.gl/maps/6JqQk3AxRiRF3WoDA)以及[極端的乾旱景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/4fdpWvUUTJYxJMEd7)。你也可以遇到[更正常的景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYFchUyxrDQ7uyx5)，看起來更像西班牙本土。
注意：由於其多樣性，很難確切指出加納利群島的平均景觀。一個更有用的策略是關注它看起來是否獨特，並且不像你在西歐本土會找到的任何東西：如果特徵線索符合西班牙，但在氛圍方面有某種「怪異之處」，請考慮加納利群島。

text: The island of **Fuerteventura** in the Canary Islands is characterised by a very arid landscape with little to no vegetation. Orange soil is very common, and within the Canary Islands archipelago essentially unique to this island.
text_zh: 加納利群島的**富特文圖拉島**的特徵是極度乾旱的景觀，幾乎沒有植被。橘色土壤非常普遍，在加納利群島群島中基本上是該島特有的。

text: You will find a **mountainous, mediterranean** landscape in Ceuta, featuring a mix of eucalyptus trees and pines.
text_zh: 你在 Ceuta 會找到 **多山的地中海** 景觀，融合了尤加利樹與松樹。

text: Sri Lanka is a **tropical** country. It usually has very lush, green vegetation. It is densely populated and many parts are covered in a patchwork of agricultural fields.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡是一個 **熱帶** 國家。它通常擁有非常茂盛的綠色植被。它人口稠密，許多地方都被拼布般的農田所覆蓋。

text: **Palm trees** are very common in Sri Lanka, more so than many other Asian countries.
NOTE: Palm trees are also very common in the Philippines.
text_zh: **棕櫚樹** 在斯里蘭卡非常普遍，比許多其他亞洲國家更常見。
注意：棕櫚樹在菲律賓也非常普遍。

text: The southwest of Sri Lanka has a more **wet climate** that is characterised by lush, dense vegetation. Deep green tones dominate the landscape.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡西南部擁有更 **濕潤的氣候**，其特徵是繁茂、濃密的植被。深綠色調主導了地景。

text: Conversely, the rest of the country has a slightly more **dry climate**. The vegetation is often lower and more open. The landscape usually has a mix of brown and green tones.

Note that the difference is not extreme, as the landscape in Sri Lanka never truly gets downright arid. However, with some practise, you can often learn to tell the difference. Your mileage may also vary depending on the season, local forest cover, or coverage type (Generation 3 often tends to make the landscape look more arid than it really is).
text_zh: 相反地，該國其餘地區擁有稍微更 **乾燥的氣候**。植被通常較低且較為開闊。地景通常融合了棕色和綠色調。
請注意，這種差異並非極端，因為斯里蘭卡的景觀從未真正變得完全乾旱。然而，經過一些練習，你通常可以學會分辨其中的差異。你的體驗也可能因季節、當地森林覆蓋率或街景類型而異（第三代街景通常會讓景觀看起來比實際更乾燥）。

text: **Tea plantations** are found in the central and southwestern parts of the country. They are most common in the area just west of Nuwara Eliya.
Tea plants look like small, compact shrubs with bright green leaves. They are usually planted in organised rows or clusters on hillsides.
text_zh: **茶園** 分布在中部和西南部地區。它們在努沃勒埃利耶正西方的地區最為常見。
茶樹看起來像是小型、緊密的灌木，有著鮮綠色的葉子。牠們通常以整齊的行或叢狀種植在山坡上。

text: **Horton Plains National Park **has a very distinct and bait landscape, consisting of hilly plains covered in long grass. In the distance, you can see forests, but most of the park’s roads meander through a wide open landscape.
text_zh: **霍頓平原國家公園**有著非常獨特且具標誌性的地貌，由長滿長草的丘陵平原組成。在遠處可以看到森林，但公園的大多數道路都蜿蜒穿過寬廣開闊的地貌。

text: The general landscape consists of **barren, treeless** mountains. Trees and greenery are a very rare sight, with the majority of vegetation consisting of moss and grasses. The sky is also often overcast, with a gloomy look to the coverage.
text_zh: 整體景觀由 **荒涼、無樹** 的山脈組成。樹木和綠意非常罕見，大部分的植被由苔蘚和草組成。天空也經常陰沉，街景覆蓋呈現陰暗的外觀。

text: Sweden has a varied landscape, with a lot of **boreal forests**, small to medium-sized farmlands and many lakes. The northern and western parts of the country are quite mountainous, with long, narrow lakes and rivers, while the southern and eastern parts are generally flatter.
text_zh: 瑞典的地貌多變，有大量的**北方針葉林**、中小型農田以及許多湖泊。該國北部和西部山巒起伏，有長而狹窄的湖泊與河流，而南部和東部則通常較為平坦。

text: This type of traditional wooden fence, made out of thin spaced out vertical tree trunks and slightly diagonal trunks stacked on top of each other, is commonly found in Sweden.
NOTE: Similar fences can be found in other Nordic countries, particularly in Norway near the Swedish border, but are significantly less common.
text_zh: 這種傳統的木柵欄由間距均勻的細直樹幹和稍微對角堆疊的樹幹組成，在瑞典很常見。
註：其他北歐國家也能找到類似的柵欄，特別是在靠近瑞典邊境的挪威，但明顯較少見。

text: **Broad leafed trees**, other than birches, only grow naturally in the southern half of the country, and become increasingly common the further south you get.
text_zh: 除了樺樹之外，**闊葉樹**僅在該國南部半境自然生長，且越往南越常見。

text: While it is possible to see forested mountains in several regions in the country, mountains with **no trees at the top** can only be found in the northwestern parts of the country.
text_zh: 雖然在該國的多個地區都可以看到有森林的山脈，但**山頂無樹**的山脈僅能在該國的西北部地區找到。

text: This type of vegetation, consisting of thin, **weak-looking boreal trees** and somewhat sandy soil can be found in the far north of Sweden.
text_zh: 這種由纖細、**看起來生氣薄弱的針葉樹**和略帶沙質的土壤組成的植被，可以在瑞典的最北部找到。

text: **Beech forests**, which can generally be recognised by the barren ground covered in brown leaves, are mainly found in the far south.
text_zh: **山毛櫸林**主要分佈在最南部，通常可以透過覆蓋著褐色落葉的貧瘠地面來辨認。

text: It is very common to see exposed, often somewhat round, **rocks **on the Swedish west coast. They will often have lower vegetation, such as small bushes, growing on them.

NOTE: Exposed rocks around Stockholm are also fairly common, however these typically look [sharper](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.3837168,18.0424028,3a,44.4y,62.73h,90.73t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sCabggp4A7W2US1vJztCj2Q!2e0!5s20160501T000000!7i13312!8i6656) than rocks on the west coast, and commonly have [thick moss](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.3134085,18.2804435,3a,39.9y,131.81h,84.85t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sLZhqq7pkOrOKpJvCNamlNg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) growing on them.
text_zh: 在瑞典西海岸看到裸露且通常略呈圓形的**岩石**非常普遍。它們上面通常會生長著較矮小的植被，例如小灌木。

注意：斯德哥爾摩周邊裸露的岩石也相當常見，不過這些岩石通常看起來比西海岸的岩石[更尖銳](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.3837168,18.0424028,3a,44.4y,62.73h,90.73t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sCabggp4A7W2US1vJztCj2Q!2e0!5s20160501T000000!7i13312!8i6656)，且表面通常長有[厚厚的苔蘚](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.3134085,18.2804435,3a,39.9y,131.81h,84.85t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sLZhqq7pkOrOKpJvCNamlNg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: In Skåne you will find the **most open agricultural landscape** in Sweden. It is the only region where, rather than a dense forest in the distance, you can get only a few small patches of trees strewn across the fields. On top of that, crops are often [more diverse](https://goo.gl/maps/iSRTHpPv8DEZyymX7) than the [cereal crops](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cereal), which are typical for the rest of Sweden.
text_zh: 在斯科讷（Skåne），你會找到瑞典**最開闊的農業景觀**。這是唯一一個遠處不是茂密森林，而只有幾小片樹木散落田野間的地區。除此之外，農作物通常也比瑞典其他地區典型的[穀物作物](https://goo.gl/maps/iSRTHpPv8DEZyymX7)[更具多樣性](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cereal)。

text: The area surrounding lake Mälaren can often be recognized by the fairly **flat** ground with medium sized agricultural fields, forests beyond them, and small “islands” of bushes and trees in the middle of the fields.
text_zh: 梅拉倫湖（lake Mälaren）周邊地區通常可以透過相當**平坦**的地面來辨識，這裡有中等大小的農田、遠處的森林，以及田野中間由灌木和樹木組成的小「島嶼」。

text: The agricultural landscape of Västergötland and Östergötland is mostly flat, similarly to the landscape around lake Mälaren. The two most consistent differences is that this landscape is **more open** and has lots of **wind turbines**. While you can almost always see a forest in the distance, it will typically be much further away than around Mälaren.
text_zh: 韋斯特吉特蘭（Västergötland）和東吉特蘭（Östergötland）的農業景觀大多很平坦，與梅拉倫湖周邊的景觀類似。兩個最一致的區別是，這裡的景觀**更為開闊**且擁有許多**風力發電機**。雖然你幾乎總能在遠處看到森林，但它通常會比梅拉倫湖周邊的森林還要遠得多。

text: On the west coast, and particularly in Halland, you will see a lot of flat agricultural fields with small, round, **forested hills** in the distance. Generally, the hills get larger and the fields get smaller further north. The area also has more precipitation than most of the country, and as such it typically looks very lush.
text_zh: 在西海岸，特別是在哈蘭（Halland），你會看到許多平坦的農田，遠處有圓滾滾的**森林小丘**。一般來說，越往北走山丘越大、農田越小。該地區的降雨量也比國內大部分地區多，因此通常看起來非常翠綠。

text: The landscape around the High Coast in Västernorrland can be recognised by the many **forested, rocky mountains** surrounding agricultural valleys. The valleys are rarely straight and the mountains are of varying heights and shapes.
text_zh: 西諾爾蘭省（Västernorrland）高海岸（High Coast）周圍的景觀，可以透過環繞著農業山谷的許多**多林岩山**來辨識。這些山谷很少是筆直的，山峰的高度和形狀也各不相同。

text: Agricultural fields in and around Södermanland very often go through **small valleys**, with forests up on the sides of the valleys. The fields are typically medium to small sized.
text_zh: 瑟德曼蘭（Södermanland）內及其周邊的農田經常穿過**小山谷**，山谷兩側長滿森林。田地通常為中小型。

text: Traditional Swedish fences are typically made of thin round tree trunks and branches. However, on Gotland these fences are typically made of larger trunks that have been cut into **sharp-looking wedges**.
text_zh: 傳統的瑞典柵欄通常由細圓樹幹和樹枝製成。然而，在哥特蘭島上，這些柵欄通常由被砍成**看起來很尖銳的楔子**的大樹幹製成。

text: Dirt roads which have a **deep grey colour** and are aligned with low, **green grassy vegetation** on either side are commonly found in the northern half of Jämtland. This is mostly found in Generation 4 summer and [Generation 3 fall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UNRUBAG7jXLcoATR6) coverage.
text_zh: 具有**深灰色**且兩側排有低矮**綠色草本植被**的泥土路，常見於耶姆特蘭的北部地區。這主要出現在第 4 代夏季和[第 3 代秋季](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UNRUBAG7jXLcoATR6)街景覆蓋中。

text: Öland is an **extremely flat** island with a somewhat barren south half with many small bushes, while the [north](https://goo.gl/maps/ptcEZutfK6f7jTEu7) is typically slightly lusher with fewer, but larger bushes and some trees. The island also contains a very large number of small rock walls.
text_zh: 厄蘭島（Öland）是一個**極其平坦**的島嶼，其南部有些荒涼，有許多小灌木叢，而[北部](https://goo.gl/maps/ptcEZutfK6f7jTEu7)通常稍微翠綠一些，灌木較少但較大，並有一些樹木。該島還包含大量的小石牆。

text: Many roads in western Dalarna and nearby regions have a very noticeable **red colour**.
NOTE: Forests in the region predominantly consist of thin pines, which, in combination with the red roads, is a very good indication of the region.
text_zh: 達拉納（Dalarna）西部及鄰近地區的許多道路都有非常明顯的**紅色**。
注意：該地區的森林主要由細長的松樹組成，結合紅色的道路，是判斷該地區非常好的線索。

text: The E10 between Kiruna and the Norwegian border is a major road which can be recognised by the vegetation mainly consisting of **small birches**, occasionally with some [pines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r2w5fSrjknpLRGbg9) strewn in, combined with snow covered mountains, which can typically be seen in the distant west close to Kiruna, and in all directions when you approach the border. A [major lake](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5ufEBehSjqCDNzoB8) can also be seen to the north on the western half of the road.
text_zh: 基律納（Kiruna）與挪威邊境之間的 E10 是一條主要道路，其特徵是植被主要由**小型樺樹**組成，偶爾參雜一些[松樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r2w5fSrjknpLRGbg9)，並結合積雪的山脈；這些山脈通常可以在靠近基律納的遠處西方看到，而在你接近邊境時則四面八方都能看到。在道路的西半部北方，也可以看到一個[大湖泊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5ufEBehSjqCDNzoB8)。

text: The northern section of road 99 can usually be recognized by its grey **sandy ground** with brown-green moss, the noticeable ditch following most of the road and its fairly low, dense forest with a mixture of birches, pines and spruces.
Beware that the most recent coverage on much of the road was taken during [early spring](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9gtEq3acTzBodXfJ8), which makes some of these features harder to recognise.
text_zh: 99 號公路的北部路段通常可以透過其帶有褐綠色苔蘚的灰色**沙質地面**、沿著大部分道路的明顯水溝，以及混合了樺樹、松樹和雲杉的相當低矮且密集的森林來識別。
請注意，該道路大部分路段最近的街景覆蓋是在[初春](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9gtEq3acTzBodXfJ8)拍攝的，這使得其中一些特徵更難以辨認。

text: Most mountain roads in Sweden have been built below the treeline, resulting in small trees being visible on almost all coverage. The only paved road in Sweden above the treeline, with **no visible trees**, can be found on the border between Jämtland and Västerbotten, near the Norwegian border. The coverage was taken during fall, giving the limited vegetation a yellowish brown colour.
text_zh: 瑞典的大多數山路都是在樹木線下方建造的，導致幾乎所有街景覆蓋中都能看到小樹。瑞典唯一一條位於樹木線上方的鋪面道路、且**沒有可見的樹木**，可以在耶姆特兰（Jämtland）和西博滕（Västerbotten）之間的邊境、靠近挪威邊境處找到。該街景覆蓋拍攝於秋季，使得有限的植被呈現黃褐色。

text: In the town of Gällivare you can often see a mountain with a **smooth slope** and a **low tree line **to the southwest. No other town in Sweden has a natural treeless mountain in such close proximity.
text_zh: 在耶利瓦勒（Gällivare）鎮，你經常可以在西南方看到一座擁有**平緩山坡**和**低樹木線**的山。瑞典沒有其他城鎮能在如此近的距離內擁有天然的無樹山脈。

text: If you are surrounded by flat agricultural fields, with a single **forested hill range** to the **west**, you are likely to be east of Omberg in western Östergötland.
text_zh: 如果你的周圍是平坦的農田，且**西方**只有一條**森林山脈**，你很可能位於西約特蘭（Östergötland）西部翁貝里（Omberg）的東側。

text: The island of Visingsö in the middle of Lake Vättern can often be recognised by the agricultural fields with the lake being visible both to the **northwest and southeast**, with forested hills at the shore of either side of the lake.
text_zh: 位於韋特恩湖（Lake Vättern）正中央的維辛索島（Visingsö）通常可以透過農田來辨認，湖泊在**西北方和東南方**皆清晰可見，湖岸兩側則有森林山丘。

text: Following the northern west coast of Öland you will find this small coastal road, with a **rocky beach** and low, **bushy vegetation**.
text_zh: 順著厄蘭島（Öland）的北部西海岸走，你會找到這條小小的海岸公路，這裡有**岩石海灘**和低矮的**叢生植被**。

text: The stretch of the **E4 between Umeå and the Finnish border** is one of very few roads in the northern parts of the country which is large enough to normally have either a wide ditch or a barrier between the carriageways. The area is fairly flat and the road is mainly surrounded by forests, mostly consisting of thin birches and pines, which get lower further north.
text_zh: **于默奧與芬蘭邊境之間的 E4 公路**路段是該國北部極少數足夠寬、通常在車道之間設有寬水溝或護欄的道路之一。該地區相當平坦，道路周圍主要是森林，主要由纖細的樺樹和松樹組成，越往北走樹木越矮。

text: The stretch of the E45 going between Orsa and Älvros can be recognised by the **brown-red wet pavement** with forest consisting of thin pines and birches along the roadside.
text_zh: 奧爾薩（Orsa）和埃爾夫罗斯（Älvros）之間的 E45 公路路段可以透過**棕紅色濕潤路面**來識別，路旁有由細松樹和樺樹組成的森林。

text: While the southern half of Switzerland is extremely mountainous, with long, thin valleys between the mountains, the northern half mostly consists of large farmlands on either flat ground or rolling hills, typically with forested hills in the distance.
text_zh: 瑞士南部半境極為多山，山與山之間有著狹長的山谷，而北部半境則大多由平地或緩丘的大片農田組成，遠處通常能見到長滿森林的山丘。

text: A fairly flat landscape with a long chain of medium-sized, forested mountains northwest means you are likely south of the Jura Mountains.
text_zh: 如果地勢相當平坦，且西北方有一長串中等高度、長滿森林的山脈，意味著你很可能位於汝拉山脈以南。

text: **Exposed limestone rocks**, protruding from forested hills, are commonly found in the Jura mountains.
text_zh: **裸露的石灰岩**自森林山丘中突顯出來，這在汝拉山脈一帶很常見。

text: The valley of Martigny has the highest density of **fruit plantations** in the country. It can easily be recognized by the many small fruit trees in combination with the wide, flat valley with large mountains on either side.
text_zh: 馬蒂尼山谷擁有全國最高的**果園**密度。透過許多小型果樹結合寬闊平坦的山谷以及兩側的高山，可以輕易辨認出這裡。

text: Apart from the valley of Martigny, the most likely area to find **fruit trees** is near Lake Constance, followed by the area northwest of Lake Geneva.
text_zh: 除了馬蒂尼山谷外，最有可能找到**果樹**的地區是在博登湖附近，其次是日內瓦湖西北方的地區。

text: You can find **oil palm plantations** in southern São Tomé.
text_zh: 你可以在聖多美南部找到**油棕櫚園**。

text: The central-eastern region that covers two-thirds of Taiwan consists of **forested mountains**.

The central mountain range that runs all the way to the south of the island is made up of tall mountains and rugged valleys. At high elevations, the vegetation can look **less tropical** and feature temperate or even coniferous trees.
text_zh: 佔全島三分之二面積的中東部地區則是**森林覆蓋的山地**。
貫穿至島嶼南端的中央山脈由高山與陡峭溪谷構成。在高海拔地區，植被會顯得**不那麼熱帶**，可見溫帶甚至針葉樹種。

text: The **Hualien-Taitung Valley** is a thin and long valley located on the east coast of the island passing from Hualien City at the north to Taitung City at the south. It is very recognizable as it consists of flat gentle plains surrounded by densely-forested mountains to the east and west.
NOTE: Most of the coverage on the east coast lies within this valley.
There are also other valleys in central Taiwan that can look similar.
text_zh: **花東縱谷**是位於東海岸的狹長谷地，北起花蓮市、南至台東市。特徵非常明顯：平緩的平原地帶，東西兩側被密林覆蓋的山脈夾住。
註：東海岸大部分的街景覆蓋都落在這條縱谷內。
台灣中部也有其他外觀相似的谷地。

text: The island of Kinmen can be recognized by these trees with **fuzzy leaves** lining the road and **red-tinged** soil.
NOTE: There is no Generation 4 coverage in Kinmen.
text_zh: 金門可由路旁這種**葉形蓬鬆**的樹木以及**偏紅**的土壤辨識出來。
註：金門沒有第四代街景覆蓋。

text: Miaoli and Hsinchu share a landscape of **low rolling hills** and winding roads as well as sparse farmland with vegetation that can look messy and unkempt.
text_zh: 苗栗與新竹同樣是**低矮起伏丘陵**加蜿蜒道路的地貌，農田分布零散，植被常顯得雜亂未經整理。

text: [Areca catechu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Areca_catechu), also known as **areca palms** or betel nut palms, are extensively found in central and southern Taiwan.
Areca palms are most common in the **mountainous** regions of Taiwan, you can still see dense areca palm patches in northern counties but they are few and far between.
text_zh: [檳榔](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Areca_catechu)，也就是**檳榔樹**，在中南部大量分布。
檳榔樹最常出現在台灣的**山區**。北部縣市雖然仍有成片檳榔園，但相當零星少見。

text: **Norfolk island pines** ([Araucaria heterophylla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Araucaria_heterophylla)) are extremely common in the county of Penghu, especially in tightly-packed rows next to roads.
NOTE: While these trees can be found on the main island as well, they are usually never found in such close proximity.
text_zh: **小葉南洋杉**（[異葉南洋杉](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Araucaria_heterophylla)）在澎湖極為常見，尤其是路旁密集成排的種法。
註：本島雖然也有這種樹，但幾乎不會種得這麼密集。

text: These **leafless** trees are most frequently seen in Penghu.
text_zh: 這種**光禿無葉**的樹木最常見於澎湖。

text: These **areca palm plantations** are mostly found in the county of Pingtung.

NOTE: Plantations in Pingtung are mainly found in neat, organised rows like these, in the flat plains. While in most central and southern counties, they will be found in the mountainous areas. Additionally, the counties further north will also rarely have areca palms in the flat plains of the west coast.
text_zh: 這種**檳榔園**主要出現在屏東。
註：屏東的檳榔園多半像這樣整齊排列在平原上；而中南部其他縣市的檳榔園則多位於山區。此外，越往北的縣市，西部平原上幾乎看不到檳榔樹。

text: This open landscape with forests of **short trees** surrounding a narrow **grassy road** can be found in Hualien in the flat parts of Guangfu and Fenglin. This area can be distinguished due to it being commonly covered in Generation 2; however, you can find [similar landscapes in Generation 3 and 4](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6277781,121.4209628,3a,90y,116.32h,95.59t,0.07r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sKO9EMyTVK1jlvcEvATqKog!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 這種開闊地景 —— 狹窄的**雜草路面**兩旁圍繞著**矮樹林** —— 出現在花蓮光復與鳳林一帶的平坦地區。該區多為第二代街景覆蓋，可作為判斷依據；不過[第三代與第四代也找得到類似地景](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6277781,121.4209628,3a,90y,116.32h,95.59t,0.07r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sKO9EMyTVK1jlvcEvATqKog!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: A **green train car** can be found in east Chiayi around Alishan National Forest.
text_zh: 嘉義東部阿里山國家森林一帶可以看到一節**綠色火車車廂**。

text: Higher up on the hills, the forest becomes more open and you will see **savannah-like trees** around you.
text_zh: 在較高的山坡上，森林變得較為開闊，周圍會出現**類似熱帶稀樹草原的樹木**。

text: On top of the hills, the trees make way for a bare **grassland** landscape. Here, you have breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape and Lake Tanganyika.
text_zh: 在山頂上，樹木讓位給光禿禿的**草原**景觀。在這裡，你可以欣賞到周圍景觀和坦干依喀湖的壯麗景色。

text: There is a **boat trekker** in Lake Tanganyika, that hugs the coast very closely, next to Gombe National Park. The coast is always to your east. You will see hills that are mostly covered in tropical forest, with some bare and grassy hilltops.
You can see the boat through the blur: it is painted **olive green and white**, and has some people in it. The boat and people are always pixelated due to the blur.
NOTE: Do not confuse this boat trekker with the [boats in Madagascar](https://www.plonkit.net/madagascar#3).
text_zh: 在坦干依喀湖中緊貼著海岸、鄰近貢貝國家公園的地方，有一個**船隻徒步拍攝**（boat trekker）。海岸始終位於你的東側。你會看到主要被熱帶森林覆蓋的山丘，伴隨著一些光禿和長滿草的山頂。
你可以透過模糊效果看到這艘船：它被漆成**橄欖綠與白色**，上面有一些人。由於模糊效果，船隻和人員總是呈現像素化的狀態。
註：切勿將此船隻徒步拍攝與[馬達加斯加的船隻](https://www.plonkit.net/madagascar#3)搞混。

text: Low, smooth and forested mountains can be found in the centre-north of the country.
text_zh: 低矮、平緩且有森林覆蓋的山脈可以在該國的中北部找到。

text: **Rubber wood plantations** are typically seen in Thailand. Most of them are located in the** **south. You can recognize them by the small, black taps on the bottom of the tree's trunk.
text_zh: **橡膠木園**在泰國很常見。它們大多位於**南部**。你可以透過樹幹底部的黑色小切口來辨認它們。

text: Over 90% of the palm oil in Thailand is produced in the south. This means that **palm plantations** are most often seen in southern Thailand.
text_zh: 泰國超過 90% 的棕櫚油都是在南部生產的。這意味著**棕櫚園**最常出現在泰國南部。

text: **Durian plantations** are most common around Chanthaburi, but can be found around the peninsula and other areas. When they are young, they can be identified by their cone-shaped appearance. When [fully grown](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3TtjWxAX8eC8m72f7), durian trees can be identified by their dark bark, branches that nearly reach the ground, and oblong leaves with pointed tips.
text_zh: **榴槤園**最常見於尖竹汶周邊，但在半島和其他地區也能找到。當它們還年輕時，可以透過其圓錐形的外觀來識別。當[完全長成](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3TtjWxAX8eC8m72f7)時，榴槤樹可以透過深色樹皮、幾乎垂到地面的樹枝以及帶有尖端的長橢圓形葉子來識別。

text: [Tectona grandis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teak), also known as **teak**, is most commonly found in high densities in the north. It can be recognized by its large leaves and yellow flowers.
NOTE: Teak trees are often used for decoration along [highways](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8ZVapgFjkxUqz6UB8).
text_zh: [柚木](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teak)（Tectona grandis）最常以高密度分佈在北部。它以大片葉子和黃色花朵而聞名。
注意：柚木樹經常沿著[高速公路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8ZVapgFjkxUqz6UB8)用作裝飾。

text: **Pine trees**, specifically [Pinus latteri](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_latteri), or Tenasserim pines, are more or less exclusive to the north and northwest of the country.
text_zh: **松樹**，特別是[卡西亞松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_latteri)（Pinus latteri，又稱丹那沙林松），幾乎只存在於該國的北部和西北部。

text: **Deep red fields** with cassava and rubber trees can be found in Kanchanaburi.
text_zh: 長滿木薯和橡膠樹的**深紅色田野**可以在北碧府（Kanchanaburi）找到。

text: The province of Mukdahan features many **long, low hills** among fields of rice, sugarcane, cassava and rubber trees.
text_zh: 莫拉限府（Mukdahan）的特色是在稻米、甘蔗、木薯和橡膠樹田之間有許多**長形且低矮的丘陵**。

text: Western Rayong province features a **northeast-southwest grid** filled with modern and industrial buildings among fields of rubber trees, cassava, and pineapple.
text_zh: 羅勇府（Rayong）西部擁有一個**東北-西南走向的網格**，裡面充滿了現代化和工業建築，周圍則是橡膠樹、木薯和鳳梨田。

text: A **smudge **on the** front left **of the camera can be seen on the densely forested road going through Khao Yai National Park. This smudge can also be found in nearby areas of Nakhon Nayok and Prachin Buri.
NOTE: Other smudges may rarely exist [elsewhere](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GYwj41y21n9awFLT6) in the country.
text_zh: 穿過拷艾國家公園的濃密森林道路上，可以看到相機**左前方**有一個**汙漬**。這個汙漬也可以在鄰近的那空那育府和巴真府地區找到。
注意：其他汙漬很少可能存在於該國[其他地方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GYwj41y21n9awFLT6)。

text: These **olive tree plantations** can often be found along roads. They consist of nicely arranged rows of olive trees on an often raked, weedless soil.
text_zh: 這些**橄欖樹園**經常可以在道路旁找到。它們由整齊排列的橄欖樹組成，生長在通常經過耙地、沒有雜草的土壤上。

text: The large middle region between Hammamet and Gabes is very flat, and more arid. Olive tree plantations are common and the more south you go, the drier the landscape becomes.
text_zh: 哈馬馬特和加貝斯之間的大片中部地區非常平坦且更加乾旱。橄欖樹園很常見，而且越往南方走，地景就越乾燥。

text: South of Gabes is where the landscape changes into something more akin to a desert. A lot more rubbish and small white rocks can be found along the roads. Olive tree plantations are still somewhat common. A mountain range far in the distance is often visible to the southwest.
text_zh: 加貝斯以南的地形轉變為更類似沙漠的風貌。道路沿線可以發現更多的垃圾和白色小碎石。橄欖樹園仍然隨處可見。遠方地平線常可見到綿延的山脈。

text: The island of Djerba can sometimes have a distinct vibe. There tend to be a lot of palm trees. Whitewashed, traditional buildings with blue doors and windows are common.
NOTE: Not all locations on the island will have this distinct vibe. A lack of a follow car is another good way to confirm that you are on Djerba.
text_zh: 傑爾巴島有時會給人一種獨特的氛圍。這裡往往有許多棕櫚樹。塗白、帶有藍色門窗的傳統建築很常見。
注意：島上並非所有地點都有這種獨特的氛圍。沒有跟拍車是確認你身處傑爾巴島的另一種好方法。

text: If you see **a large amount of palm trees** in a single place, you are probably in Gabes.
NOTE: While Djerba also has many palm trees, the towns and surrounding area tend to look more rural.
text_zh: 如果你在單一地點看到**大量的棕櫚樹**，你可能就在加貝斯。
注意：雖然傑爾巴島也有許多棕櫚樹，但那裡的城鎮和周邊地區通常看起來更具鄉村風情。

text: An offroad from road P12 southwest of Sousse can be recognised by the dark pavement surrounded by bright sandy soil combined with the east-west road angle. The eastern part of the road is fairly vegetated, with large numbers of prickly pears, while the western part of the road is [very arid](https://maps.app.goo.gl/W7Q3a5DgLqsJuio59) with little to no vegetation.
text_zh: 從蘇薩西南方的 P12 公路岔出的非鋪裝道路，可以透過明亮砂質土壤環繞的深色路面，結合東西走向的道路角度來辨識。道路東半部植被相當茂盛，有大量的仙人掌，而道路西半部則[非常乾燥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/W7Q3a5DgLqsJuio59)，幾乎沒有植被。

text: The Turkish landscape ranges from arid in the [southeast](https://goo.gl/maps/LjNc6hYmCyfbay51A) to a Mediterranean landscape in the [southwest](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzXWMtN6TYYx4GG7). In the [north](https://goo.gl/maps/odAj9owBhLGwSmBH7) you will often find a more forested and lush landscape. The most typical landscape is semi-arid, either rolling or flat, with vast agricultural fields, containing very limited vegetation other than crops.
Beware that Turkey is a very naturally diverse country with many landscapes that are not mentioned in this tip.
text_zh: 土耳其的地景從[東南部](https://goo.gl/maps/LjNc6hYmCyfbay51A)的乾燥荒漠跨越到[西南部](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzXWMtN6TYYx4GG7)的地中海風貌。在[北部](https://goo.gl/maps/odAj9owBhLGwSmBH7)，你經常會發現森林密布且草木蔥鬱的地景。最具代表性的地景是半乾燥的起伏地形或平原，擁有廣闊的農田，除了農作物之外幾乎沒有什麼植被。
請注意，土耳其是一個自然多樣性極高的國家，有許多本提示未提及的地景。

text: Northern Turkey tends to be significantly **lusher** and **more forested** than the rest of the country.
text_zh: 土耳其北部通常比該國其他地區明顯**更為翠綠**且**森林更茂密**。

text: In the northeast you will find **uncultivated grasslands** in valleys surrounded by round hills. Trees are very limited in the region. In Generation 3 the area has an extremely distinct look, with deep green grass covering the hills. It is significantly more difficult to recognise in Generation 4, where the grass has a more arid look.
text_zh: 在東北部，你會在被圓山環繞的山谷中發現**未開墾的草原**。該地區的樹木非常稀少。在 Generation 3 中，該地區有著極具特色的外觀，深綠色的草覆蓋著群山。在 Generation 4 中要認出它則困難得多，那裡的草看起來更為乾燥。

text: **Olive trees** are mainly found on the Mediterranean coast.
text_zh: **橄欖樹**主要分佈在地中海沿岸。

text: Lake Van is by far the biggest lake in Turkey and has a semi-arid landscape, being surrounded by dry grassy hills and occasional trees and [agricultural fields](https://goo.gl/maps/LCwckUWMg8zV8yrX7) near the shore.
text_zh: 凡湖是土耳其最大的湖泊，擁有半乾旱景觀，岸邊環繞著乾燥的草地山丘、零星的樹木以及[農田](https://goo.gl/maps/LCwckUWMg8zV8yrX7)。

text: The islands other than the Midway Atoll can generally be characterised by three things. Firstly, the **Generation 3 trekker** coverage. Secondly, the low, **bushy** vegetation, and thirdly, the presence of numerous **birds**.
text_zh: 除了中途島之外，其他島嶼通常可以用三件事來特徵化。首先是**第三代徒步拍攝**街景。其次是低矮、**多叢的**植被，第三則是存在著大量的**鳥類**。

text: East Island is the **smallest** island in the chain. There is barely any vegetation and you can see the ocean in all directions.
text_zh: 東島（East Island）是這一連串島嶼中**最小的**島嶼。幾乎沒有任何植被，放眼望去各個方向都能看到海洋。

text: The National Park is located in the northeastern parts of the country and mostly consists of a large savannah with **mountains** being visible in most directions. The most recognizable mountain range can be seen to the east and is visible in most of the coverage.
text_zh: 該國家公園位於該國東北部，主要由大片稀樹草原組成，多數方向都 **看得到山脈**。最容易辨識的山脈位於東方，在多數街景中都看得到。

text: The southern half of the north road in Kidepo is somewhat **forested**, and as such it may occasionally be hard to see the various mountains.
text_zh: 基代波北部道路的南半部有些許 **森林**，因此偶爾很難看見各個山脈。

text: The northern half of the north road in Kidepo is located in a savannah and can be easily recognised by the **wide mountain** to the north.
text_zh: 基代波北部道路的北半部位於稀樹草原中，透過北部的 **寬闊山脈** 可以輕易辨識。

text: The National Park is located by the northern end of Lake Albert and can commonly be recognized by the low** dirt barriers** along the side of the roads. A savannah can be seen in the western part, while the eastern parts contain many small trees and bushes. Apart from a fairly low and wide mountain range far away to the west, there are no mountains in the vicinity.
text_zh: 該公園位於阿爾伯特湖的北端，通常可以透過道路兩側低矮的 **泥土護欄** 來辨識。西部可以看到稀樹草原，而東部則包含許多小樹和灌木。除了遠處西方一處相當低矮且寬闊的山脈外，附近沒有其他山脈。

text: The National Park has three types of coverage, the first of which is a very **wide dirt road** going through a dense, tropical forest. It is by far the widest dirt road in the country outside of Kampala with Street View coverage.
text_zh: 該國家公園有三種街景類型，第一種是穿過濃密熱帶雨林的 **寬闊泥土路**。它是坎帕拉以外烏干達國內擁有街景覆蓋的最寬泥土路。

text: The second type of coverage in Kibale is on a **small forest road**, which is still large enough to be covered using a car. The forest appears to be quite dense, however it is typically not very dark. The area is mostly flat.
text_zh: 基巴萊的第二種街景位於 **小林道** 上，其寬度仍然大到足以用汽車行駛。森林看起來相當濃密，但通常不太昏暗。該地區大致平坦。

text: The final type of coverage is a number of **tiny forest paths**. The coverage is somewhat dark, with the sun shining through every so often.
text_zh: 最後一種街景是許多 **極窄的森林小徑**。街景有些昏暗，陽光不時穿透灑落。

text: The park is located west of lake Victoria and has by far the **driest coverage** in the country. The grass is almost always completely dried out, which is normally enough to recognise it. Bushes and trees along the road also typically look very dry. The area is quite hilly, but not mountainous.
text_zh: 該公園位於維多利亞湖以西，擁有該國 **最乾燥的街景覆蓋**。草幾乎總是完全枯死，這通常足以識別它。路旁的灌木和樹木通常也看起來非常乾燥。該地區相當多山丘，但不到群山起伏的程度。

text: The coverage in the national park consists of two small forest paths running parallel to each other. The forest appears very humid, and on much of the coverage, **drops of water** can be seen on the camera lens.
text_zh: 國家公園內的街景由兩條互相平行的狹窄森林小徑組成。森林看起來非常潮濕，在許多街景中，可以在相機鏡頭上看到 **水滴**。

text: The national park is located near the Kenyan border and has two stretches of paths covered, the first of which is in a **forest **with a fairly steep slope heading upwards to the east. The dirt typically has a very dark red colour.
text_zh: 該國家公園靠近肯亞邊境，有兩段覆蓋的步道，第一段位於 **森林** 中，東側有一段相當陡峭的上坡路段。泥土通常呈非常深的紅色。

text: The eastern stretch of path covered is easily recognized by its small **palm-like** trees on an open hilly field and a man following the photographer, who is dressed in green and holding a **rifle**.
text_zh: 覆蓋的東側步道很容易辨識，其特徵是開闊起伏的原野上有小型 **似棕櫚** 的樹木，且有一名穿著綠色衣服、手持 **步槍** 的男子跟在拍攝者後面。

text: On top of the brown dirt, the national park also contains **large cacti** with many branches going almost straight upwards, resembling the shape of trees.
text_zh: 除了棕色的泥土之外，這個國家公園裡也生長著許多**大型仙人掌**，有著許多幾乎筆直向上生長的枝條，形狀神似樹木。

text: This is the **stereotypical rural round** in Ukraine:
- Generally bad road quality.
- A landscape that is usually flat or slightly hilly.
- A line of trees or bushes next to the road, with wide open agricultural fields beyond that.
- A lack of road infrastructure or buildings, until you reach the next urban area.
- Low amount of traffic.
text_zh: 這是烏克蘭**典型的鄉村街景**：
- 通常很差的道路品質。
- 通常平坦或微幅起伏的地形。
- 道路旁有一排樹木或灌木叢，再過去則是開闊的農田。
- 缺乏道路基礎設施或建築物，直到你到達下一個市區。
- 車流量低。

text: These **tall poplar trees** are common in many parts of the country.
NOTE: They can be found in some regions of Russia, but most of the country completely lacks them.
text_zh: 這些**高大的楊樹**在該國許多地區都很常見。
備註：它們可以在俄羅斯的某些地區找到，但該國的大部分地區完全沒有這種樹。

text: Five major cities were covered in 2011, years before the rest of the country was covered: Kyiv, Lviv, Kharkiv, Odesa and Donetsk.
This coverage was made during autumn, meaning that the trees have distinct **fall colours** and people are dressed for colder weather.

In Kyiv, Lviv and Kharkiv, almost all of this coverage has been overwritten by the newer summer coverage. However, in all of Donetsk, and most of Odesa, it is still intact. In Donetsk specifically, there is no newer coverage at all.
text_zh: 五個主要城市在 2011 年就被拍攝覆蓋，比該國其他地區早了多年：基輔、利維夫、哈爾科夫、奧德薩和頓內次克。
這種覆蓋是在秋季拍攝的，這意味著樹木有明顯的**秋季色彩**，人們也穿著較保暖的衣服。
在基輔、利維夫和哈爾科夫，幾乎所有這些覆蓋都已經被較新的夏季覆蓋覆蓋掉了。然而，在整個頓內次克以及奧德薩的大部分地區，它仍然完好無缺。特別是在頓內次克，完全沒有較新的覆蓋。

text: The [Carpathian Mountains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukrainian_Carpathians) is an area in western Ukraine that is significantly **hillier** than the rest of the country, in some places bordering on mountainous. It is also much more forested, with very little agriculture, and a lot of pine trees. The roads going through it tend to be more curvy, rather than the straight highways found in the rest of the country.
text_zh: [喀爾巴阡山脈](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukrainian_Carpathians)是烏克蘭西部的一個地區，其**地形比該國其他地區起伏得多**，某些地方甚至接鄰山區。這裡的森林也茂密得多，幾乎沒有農業活動，並有大量的松樹。穿過它的道路往往比較彎曲，而不像該國其他地區那樣是筆直的高速公路。

text: Forests with **Baltic pines** ([Pinus sylvestris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris)) are most commonly found in the north, most often near the border with Belarus. Baltic pines are usually tall and have orange-red bark.
While some of these forests consist solely of this species, many of them are a mix of Baltic pines and broadleaf trees.
NOTE: Note that the Carpathians are also covered in a lot of pine forests. They are noticeably hilly however, allowing you to distinguish this area from the very flat north.
text_zh: 長有**波羅的海松**（[歐洲赤松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris)）的森林最常見於北部，多數靠近白俄羅斯邊境。波羅的海松通常很高，樹皮呈橘紅色。
雖然其中一些森林完全由這種樹種組成，但許多森林是波羅的海松和闊葉樹的混合林。
備註：請注意，喀爾巴阡山脈也有許多松樹林。然而它們有明顯的起伏地形，這能讓你將此地區與非常平坦的北部區分開來。

text: Towards the south, the climate becomes **warmer and drier**. The landscape is more arid. Forests are considerably more rare, and make way for shrubs and open fields. The difference is not extreme, but can become noticeable after some practice.
text_zh: 向南走，氣候變得**更暖和、更乾燥**。景觀更加荒涼。森林相當稀少，取而代之的是灌木叢和開闊的田野。這種差異並不極端，但在經過一些練習後會變得明顯。

text: The UAE typically features a flat **desert landscape**.
text_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國通常具有平坦的**沙漠景觀**。

text: This rare white Google car with visible side mirrors and sparse vegetation is found on **Sir Baniyas** Island.
text_zh: 這輛罕見的白色 Google 車帶有明顯的側視鏡且植被稀疏，出現在**薩爾巴尼亞斯**島（Sir Baniyas）。

text: The Scottish Highlands can be distinguished by the semi-barren, very **mountainous** landscape.
NOTE: A lot of Generation 4 coverage in the Highlands is from (early) spring, meaning that the vegetation often looks brown and yellow.
In addition, some of the most mountainous parts of [Wales](https://goo.gl/maps/DZCbKEo8L9PGxqDG9) and [Northern England](https://goo.gl/maps/RdTAYzq7X8exyYGx7) can look similar.
text_zh: 蘇格蘭高地可以透過半荒蕪、非常**多山**的景觀來辨識。
注意：高地上的許多第 4 代街景覆蓋來自（初）春，這意味著植被通常看起來呈棕色和黃色。
此外，[威爾斯](https://goo.gl/maps/DZCbKEo8L9PGxqDG9)和[英格蘭北部](https://goo.gl/maps/RdTAYzq7X8exyYGx7)的一些多山地區看起來可能也很相似。

text: The main island of Dry Tortugas National Park, west of Key West, can be identified by the **hexagonal brick structure** and the surrounding moat.

The Loggerhead Lighthouse, situated on the Loggerhead Key, has a brown top-half and a white bottom. The path on which the trekker walks on is also made of bright concrete, and many palm trees can be seen around the lighthouse.
text_zh: 位於基韋斯特（Key West）西側的乾龜群島國家公園（Dry Tortugas National Park）主島，可以透過 **六角形磚造結構** 以及周圍的護城河來辨識。
位於 Loggerhead Key 的 Loggerhead Lighthouse，其燈塔上半部為棕色，下半部為白色。拍攝用的徒步拍攝所行走的步道也是由明亮的混凝土製成，燈塔周圍可以看到許多棕櫚樹。

text: Big Bend National Park is located along the Mexico border in Southwest Texas. It can be identified by its **dry, rocky peaks and shrubby foliage**. This park is adjacent to the Chihauhan desert, so plants such as yucca and prickly pear cactus are common.
text_zh: Big Bend National Park 位於美國德州西南部與墨西哥的邊界沿線。其特徵為**乾燥、多石的山峰與灌木叢生的植物**。這座公園鄰近奇瓦瓦沙漠（Chihuahuan Desert），因此絲蘭和刺梨仙人掌等植物相當常見。

text: Theodore Roosevelt National Park features similar, **sand-brown**, eroded rock formations to Badlands National Park. The rock formations in this park tend to have more trees on them. Additionally, almost all coverage has **fall colours** visible.
NOTE: Similar formations can be seen in far eastern Montana as well.
text_zh: Theodore Roosevelt National Park 的特色是擁有與 Badlands National Park 相似的、**沙棕色**的受侵蝕岩層。這個公園裡的岩層往往長有較多樹木。此外，幾乎所有的**街景覆蓋**都能看見秋天色彩。
注意：在蒙大拿州極東部也能看到類似的岩層。

text: This is the stereotypical Uruguay round. The coverage often, but not always, features **overcast** weather. Most of the landscape consists of open grasslands with gentle hills. Occasionally, you might see separated tree plantations. Roads are generally in worse condition than in neighbouring countries.
text_zh: 這是典型的烏拉圭回合。街景經常（但不總是）帶有**陰天**的天氣。大部分的景觀由帶有平緩丘陵的開闊草原組成。偶爾你會看到分離的樹木人工林。道路狀況通常比鄰國來得差。

text: Occasionally, you might see **palm trees**. These short and stocky species of palm tree are particularly common.
text_zh: 偶爾，你會看到**棕櫚樹**。這些矮胖的棕櫚樹品種特別常見。

text: The landscape near the town of Minas is recognizable: some of the **tallest hills** in the country, with lots of **exposed rocks**, and often [heavy bushland vegetation](https://goo.gl/maps/1ZNebpfyoL27cq6C9).
The image shown here is a fairly extreme example of this landscape, used for illustration purposes – usually it is more subtle. However, the exposed rock is always a good clue.

NOTE: The landscape in the Quebrada de los Cuervos nature reserve, situated further north, [can look similar](https://goo.gl/maps/eaDMYgJxi43cnmJK9). In addition, there are also very tall hills in the north of the country. However, these look different (see the tip below).
text_zh: 米納斯鎮附近的景觀很好認：擁有國內一些**最高的小山**，帶有許多**裸露的岩石**，且通常有[濃密的灌木叢植被](https://goo.gl/maps/1ZNebpfyoL27cq6C9)。
這裡展示的圖片是這種景觀相當極端的例子，僅供圖解說明之用——通常沒那麼明顯。不過，裸露的岩石始終是一個很好的線索。
注意：位於更北邊的烏鴉峽谷（Quebrada de los Cuervos）自然保護區內的景觀[看起來很相似](https://goo.gl/maps/eaDMYgJxi43cnmJK9)。此外，該國北部也有非常高的小山。然而，這些山看起來不一樣（見下方的提示）。

text: You can also find tall hills in the north of the country. These can be recognized by their noticeably **darker soil**. These hills also typically do not have the exposed rocks that are visible in the Minas hills.
The vegetation tends to be natural, and you will often see **tree plantations**.
This specific landscape tends to be most noticeable very close to the Brazil border, on Route 30 near Tranqueras.
text_zh: 你也可以在該國北部找到高山。這些山可以透過明顯**較黑的土壤**來辨識。這些小山通常也沒有米納斯山那種可見的裸露岩石。
植被傾向於自然生長，你經常會看到**植樹林**。
這種特定的景觀往往在非常靠近巴西邊境的地方最為明顯，也就是特蘭克拉斯（Tranqueras）附近的 30 號公路。

text: **Tree plantations** are a defining feature of much of Uruguay’s countryside, but they are especially common in two areas in the north and northwest.
Note that the highest density of plantations is in these areas, but more isolated plantations can be found all over the country.
text_zh: **植樹林**是烏拿圭鄉村的大部分地區最具代表性的特徵，但在北部和西北部的兩個地區特別常見。
請注意，植樹林密度最高的是這些地區，但在全國各地也能找到比較孤立的植樹林。

text: **Punta del Este** is a seaside resort town with a recognizable look. It is an affluent and touristic place with a developed downtown that consists of many tall, modern apartment buildings. Its main attraction is its large, sandy beach.

Further away from the downtown area, you will see less highrises, but still a lot of expensive-looking villa neighbourhoods. Here, you will often see distinctive [tall pine trees](https://goo.gl/maps/9cKem7TVVuhbksbE8).
text_zh: **埃斯特角城**是一個具有獨特外貌的海濱度假小鎮。這是一個富裕且具觀光性質的地方，擁有開發完善的市中心，由許多高大的現代公寓大樓組成。它主要的吸引力在於其大型的沙灘。
離市中心較遠的地方，你會看到較少的高樓大廈，但仍然有很多看起來很昂貴的別墅社區。在這裡，你經常會看到獨特的[高大松樹](https://goo.gl/maps/9cKem7TVVuhbksbE8)。

text: Vanuatu is a tropical island chain, with a significant part of the coverage being taken in a **dense tropical forest**.
text_zh: 萬那杜是一個熱帶島嶼群，其中相當一部分街景是在**濃密的熱帶雨林**中拍攝的。

text: The Mekong Delta is an exceedingly flat, water-rich area. It is traversed by numerous very **straight canals**, often flanked by linear villages. It is one of the most densely populated parts of Vietnam, with cultivated fields essentially everywhere. The area is even more tropical than the rest of Vietnam, with lots of [palm trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EGM3APVzRnWeDun1A)** **and lush wetland vegetation.
text_zh: 湄公河三角洲是一個極其平坦、水資源豐富的地區。這裡縱橫交錯著許多**筆直的運河**，兩旁通常伴隨著線狀村莊。這裡是越南人口最稠密的地區之一，基本上到處都是耕地。該地區比越南其他地方更加熱帶，有著許多[棕櫚樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EGM3APVzRnWeDun1A)** **以及鬱鬱蔥蔥的濕地植被。

text: The **Central Highlands** region tends to have a landscape with a somewhat distinct vibe: often hilly with distant mountains, red soil, and often fairly dry, rolling agricultural fields. Additionally, the vegetation is a bit drier than in the rest of Vietnam (depending on the season).
text_zh: **中央高地**地區的風景往往帶有略微獨特的氛圍：通常是多山丘且遠處有山脈、紅土，而且通常是相當乾燥的緩坡農田。此外，植物比越南其他地區稍微乾燥一些（取決於季節）。

text: **Rubber tree plantations** are primarily found in the provinces to the north of Ho Chi Minh City, as well as in several parts of the Central Highlands.

Rubber trees can be recognized by their thin trunks. In Vietnam, it is typical for a section of the tree trunk to be wrapped in a piece of plastic. These trees tend to be neatly organized in a dense grid-like pattern.
text_zh: **橡膠樹園**主要分佈在胡志明市以北的各省，以及中央高地的幾個地區。
橡膠樹可以透過它們細長的樹幹來辨認。在越南，樹幹的一部分通常會被一塊塑膠包裹著。這些樹木通常整齊地排列成密集的網格狀圖案。

text: **Black pepper** plantations are common in the area in and around the Central highlands. Black pepper is a type of vine that is cultivated on tree trunks: the pepper plants shroud these trees with a dense cover of downward-pointing leaves, completely obscuring the tree’s trunk.
text_zh: **黑胡椒**種植園在中部高地及其周邊地區很常見。黑胡椒是一種藤本植物，種植在樹幹上：胡椒植物用濃密的下垂葉片覆蓋這些樹木，完全遮蔽了樹幹。

text: The Đồng Văn Karst Geopark in northern Hà Giang province, in the extreme northernmost tip of Vietnam, is characterized by a very distinct landscape: **rounded, pointy mountains** with relatively sparse vegetation, exposing the **very dark rocks** underneath.
NOTE: The broader region of northern Vietnam is also characterized by pointy mountains. The Geopark is unique because of the exposed rocks.
text_zh: 位於越南最北端的河江省北部同文岩石高原地質公園，其特徵是非常獨特的景觀：**圓形、尖銳的山峰**且植被相對稀疏，露出了底部的**極深色岩石**。
注意：較廣泛的越南北部地區也以尖山為特點。該地質公園的獨特之處在於外露的岩石。

text: The island of Phú Quốc is found in southern Vietnam near Cambodia. Phú Quốc only has Generation 3 coverage and has a lot of dark red soil. You may sometimes see a large forested ridge, which sits northeast on the island.
text_zh: 富國島位於越南南部靠近柬埔寨的地方。富國島只有第 3 代街景覆蓋，並且有大量的深紅土。你有時可能會看到一個位於該島東北部的大型森林山脊。
